157857.description: Manfred von Karma was a renowned prosecutor who went undefeated for 40 years, earning him numerous "King of Prosecutors" awards, before finally meeting his match in Phoenix Wright. He was Miles Edgeworth's mentor, responsible for teaching him everything about prosecuting until 2016. He was also the father and mentor of Franziska von Karma. For all the cases he took on until Robert Hammond's murder case, only one was left unsolved, and all of the defendants that he prosecuted were convicted.

157961.description:
__Height:__ 135 cm (4'5")

Mimi is one of Anastasia Hoshin's followers and is one of three vice-captains of the mercenary group Fang of Steel.

158164.description:
Tiger Ozaki is the Bantamweight Japanese National Boxing Champion.

The Japanese Boxing Commision's heads covertly organized a match between Joe and Tiger without the knowledge of Danpei as a way to crush the up and coming Japanese boxer, believing that giving Joe the title shot early in his career would be too much too soon putting a halt to his momentum.

Tiger is first physically seen when Joe Yabuki is invited to train at the Daito Club Boxing Gym. He and his team set up a camera to record Joe's sparring matches there to prepare for their upcoming match with the rising bantamweight star. Joe notices this upon walking into the gym and immediately takes out all of his sparring partners quickly, even fouling the final one. Joe, upset about being spied on then rushes up stairs to the mezzanine to fight Tiger then and there. They are both held back by their trainers and Tiger leaves just as a brawl breaks out between Joe and the Daito Club boxers.

~!In his bout with Joe, Tiger starts off getting the better of Joe by cleanly parrying Yabuki's body blows and countering with punches of his own. Towards the end of the round he is knocked down after biting on an apparent feint upstairs from Joe, before being hit by a crushing shot to the solar plexus, sending the Japanese Champ crashing down to the canvas.!~

~!Tiger then wins all the remaining rounds, him and his team figuring out that Joe is unable to throw a significant punch at his head. Tiger wins by TKO in round 6 when Joe's team throws in the towel. He is next seen in Ryu Harajima's corner during Harajima's fight with Yabuki, instructing him on how to easily beat Joe.!~

~!Tiger's next appearance is in his match against Carlos Rivera, the fighter ranked 6th in the world. Tiger expects an easy fight, thinking that Carlos' wins against the #1 and #2 ranked Japanese fighters were flukes, won only by lucky punches. He is then proved wrong, with Carlos skillfully knocking him out 14 seconds into the first round with an uppercut followed by a hidden elbow strike. This is the last Tiger is seen in both the anime and manga.!~

158988.description:
Rokusuke Kouenji is one of the students of class 1-D. He came from a well-known family of scholars. However, he ended up in D-Class for his egotistical behavior.

~!In Year 1, Volume 11, he watches a scuffle between [Hirata](https://anilist.co/character/123218/Hirata-Yousuke) and [Mii-Chan](https://anilist.co/character/136233/Wang-MeiYu), which ended with Hirata pushing a desperate Mii-Chan, who was trying to help him, on the ground. Kouenji then intervenes and states his annoyance at Hirata "for treating a girl wrong" referring him as "like a fly, very irritating". His friendship with Mii-Chan is then showed to progress in Year 2, Volume 5, when they are seen walking together often, and Mii-chan referring to him as "someone easy to talk to" when asked about their relationship by [Satou](https://anilist.co/character/163519/Satou-Maya) and [Matsushita](https://anilist.co/character/191401/Matsushita-Chiaki).!~

~!During the Second Year Uninhabited Island Special Exam, he strikes an agreement with [Suzune Horikita](https://anilist.co/character/123213/Horikita-Suzune), in which he would try for a first-place finish and Suzune would reward him with complete protection from class vote expulsion until graduation and exempt him from being forced to co-operate with the rest of the class, which he wins.!~

159627.description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

Kakeru Ryuuen is the class representative of class 1-C and is known for being an infamous delinquent. He does not lead his class by trust, but rather by fear. He has a group of henchmen who do his dirty work, which contributes to his fearsome reputation.

159629.description:
Ichika Amasawa is one of the first-year students of Advanced Nurturing High School. She is a student of Class 1-A.

~!She is considered to be the second White Room student to have been introduced into the story and enrolled in Advanced Nurturing High School.!~

159849.description:
Born from the Ant Queen on Jeju Island, The Ant King becomes the main threat during the Fourth Jeju Island Raid.

~!Single-handedly responsible for the deaths of over 8 of the 16 S-Rank Hunters during the raid.!~ 

~!After being killed by [Sung Jin-U](https://anilist.co/character/129928/Seong-Jin-U), the Ant King was revived as one of his shadow soldiers, and was given him the new name of Beru.!~

160036.description:
__Species:__ Giant Panda

As a panda, Meimei is spoiled and is used to get everything she wants and is treated nicely by anyone.

~!When she meets Jin, he is the first person to treat her badly, but surprisingly, she starts to enjoy being abused and offended by him.!~

160044.description: Haumea is a Third Generation pyrokinetic and a member of the White-Clad. She possesses the Adolla Burst and is known as the Second Pillar.

160339.description: Nyaos was first seen to be afraid of Kaos-chan. Though when she picked her up, she became calm and collected and eventually, Kaos adopted her to be the dorm pet. She shares a lot of personality with Kaos, from her characteristics to her personality.

160506.description:
One of Uka's familiars who are older than Kon. They often stay close by Uka, who tends to have them transform into games consoles.
It is then shown that Uka simply has them fetch video games for her, a task that they are shown to not enjoy as they tearfully complained to Miya that Uka never gives them any meaningful work. 

Both ShiShi and RoRo look like normal foxes, they have a blue fox flame at the end of their tails.

160507.description:
One of Uka's familiars who are older than Kon. They often stay close by Uka, who tends to have them transform into games consoles.
It is then shown that Uka simply has them fetch video games for her, a task that they are shown to not enjoy as they tearfully complained to Miya that Uka never gives them any meaningful work. 

Both Shishi and Roro look like normal foxes, they have a blue fox flame at the end of their tails.

160508.description: One of Inari's best friends and a fujoshi, known as Maru for short. She has trouble opening up to others due to her unique tastes, but is befriended by Inari and becomes friends with Keiko and Akemi too.

161367.description:
__Height:__ 172cm

A young man who came to Academy Island In order to search for someone.
~!He accidentally beats Saironji Sarasa in a game, and through taking her red star, pretends to be a 7-star!~

161479.description: An adorable baby that gets attached to Latina a lot.

161789.description: A veteran player who has top class combat ability. He defeats the last boss in the online game "The New Gate" and releases tens of thousands of players that had been trapped inside. After defeating the last boss, he gets swallowed up by a strange light and he finds himself inside the game, 500 years into the future.

161803.description: Laura Satii is a bronze tier adventurer. She forms an adventurer group with Raiz Dunner.

161804.description: Raiz Dunner is a bronze tier adventurer. He forms an adventurer group with Laura Satii.

161811.description: Sheila Ibarss is one of Maalt Town adventurer guild member.

name.native: ロレーヌ・ヴィヴィエ

161812.description: Lorraine Vivie is a genius scholar who studies monsters and magics.

161813.description: Rina Rupaage is a beginner adventurer from the capital city of Kingdom of Yaaran. She moved to Maalt Town for progressing her career as an adventurer and escaping from her personal issues.

161814.description: Rentt is a bronze-class adventurer who never managed to climb higher in the ranks in over 10 years. One day, he has an unfortunate run-in with a dragon and ends up being turned into a skeleton.

161843.description:
Yamano Mitsuha is a Japanese High-schooler that fell off a cliff and was subsequently transported to another world, gaining a special ability in her new world.

Mitsuha is an intelligent person. She uses her intelligence to solve her and others' problems, with answers and solutions unbefitting of her age, to others' surprise, as they still think Mitsuha is very young with Mitsuha's short stature. Not only is she a great actress. She is also very cunning, as she avoids tough situations by twisting others' words to fit her situation.

162041.description: He is a boy who stands out due to his lemon colored hair and pierced ears, and he became the center of a group of popular people. He acts coldly to almost everyone, but for some reason he cares about [Uka.](https://anilist.co/character/182176/Uka-Ishimori)

name.native: カイン・フォン・シルフォード

162043.description:
An average Japanese teenager with very little going on in his life in the past, and the third son of a noble family with a strong fixation with fantasy and high talents in magic and swordsmanship in the present - Cain is a carefree individual who likes taking things at his own pace. Despite being an aristocrat, he doesn't evaluate people by their status and often hates when others start abusing their titles, showing his cheeky side when necessary. While he knows it's better to hide his true powers, his ardent temperament often takes better of him, resulting into all kinds of troubles and funny situations.

~!Cain has received the maximum level blessings from all the 7 Gods, making him the current strongest human being in the kingdom. He was given a mission to defeat the Entertainment God, who was sealed away 300 years ago.!~

162134.description: He is the main protagonist of TenPuru.

162135.description: She is one of the main female characters of TenPuru. She is the 3rd daughter of the Mikazuki Temple and the youngest of the Aoba sisters. The two other Aoba sisters are Yuzuki Aoba and Tsukuyo Aoba.

162136.description: She is one of the main female characters of TenPuru. She came to Japan with Kagura Baldwin, they have been best friends since childhood.

162137.description: She is one of the main female characters of TenPuru. She is the 1st daughter of the Mikazuki Temple and oldest of the Aoba sisters. The two other Aoba sisters are Tsukuyo Aoba and Kurage Aoba.

162138.description: She is one of the main female characters of TenPuru. She is the stand-in priestess of the Mikazuki Temple.

162139.description: She is one of the main female characters of TenPuru. She is the 2nd daughter of the Mikazuki Temple and the middle child of the Aoba sisters. The two other Aoba sisters are Yuzuki Aoba and Kurage Aoba.

name.native: カグラ・ボールドウィン

162140.description: She is one of the main female characters of TenPuru. She came to Japan with Mia Christoph, they have been best friends since childhood.

162311.description: Captain of Code Zero and the “most powerful human."

162312.description: A veteran vampire since the Edo era.

162313.description: A D-class vampire and mad scientist with an immortal brain.

162314.description: An A-class vampire and rookie on the squad.

162370.description:
__Birthday:__ November 11 (Scorpio)

Chihiro, known as Hiro to his friends, is one of the minor characters along with Sakura and Nanami that were trapped in the Underground Channels after being penalized in the White Room. He was also part of the 11th Avenue.

His personality seems to be that he is very protective of Sakura, but it is also hinted that he may have some feelings for Sakura and greatly misunderstands Onigasaki's intentions towards her. He also the "Easy to Rile Type" according to Onigasaki's first impression of him.

The only thing known about his background was that he was trapped in the 11th Avenue along with Sakura, and then tried to get himself penalized so he could get to the White Room to accompany Sakura and together find a way out of here. Then, he and Sakura presumably found the tunnel and met Nanami; staying down there ever since.

162374.description:
A part of The Underground Comrade and is Zakuro's younger sister.

Sakura is shown to be quiet, kind and caring and very considerate of other people, but is usually scolded because she wanders off on her own a lot to get stuff for other people. She is also shown to be very guilty of hurting Zakuro once in the past and doesn't want to be a burden to her brother any more. Thus, she asks Kaikoku to not tell her brother she was in the Underground.

She was also once a gamer and then was put in the game as part of the 11th avenue, but then got penalized and sent to the White Room. There, she was united with Chihiro who tried to get himself penalized as well to keep each other company and find a way out of there. After finding the secret passage, they meet Nanami and the three stayed underground for the rest of the following years until Kaikoku found the tunnel and was brought to their underground shelter, finding out her brother was in this game as well.

162770.description: ~!Shirou Inukai is a mysterious Bushi and a member of the Obsidian Eight. He chases the Obsidian Goddess in order to achieve the strongest Kitetsu Sword.!~

162898.description: Comes from an alternate world and knows about Souta's powers and his connection to her world. Her title is number 7 of the House of Shigitoku.

162899.description:
A middle school girl who is introduced as a popsicle vendor at the beach. She feels guilty that her parents were part of the crew of the Premium Anberial.

When she and Souta are trapped in a cave, Kurumiko loses hope, but Souta saves her by inviting her to live at the dorm as his younger sister. She becomes the clergy character in Souta's party, and her flag is usually one of story advancement.

162902.description:
Introduced as an archery girl to help Quest Dorm in the athletic festival.

She is friends with Kikuno and reveals that she has a boy childhood friend named Souda whom she keeps in contact by email. However, when she discovers Souta is that person, she retreats in embarrassment and occasionally reveals a yandere flag.

163518.description:
Hiyori Shiina is one of the students of Class 1-C who is a loner.

She's a quiet girl, though sometimes she is seen occasionally smiling. She always carries books with her in her bag in case she meets someone who shares the same interest in literature as her. Since nobody in class 1-C is into literature, she doesn't have anyone to talk to. She always speaks politely. She dislikes how the classes are competing with each other, wanting everyone to be friends.

~! She encounters Kiyotaka in the library, and they find themselves having the same taste in books. As she always wanted a friend who has similar interests as her, their friendship gradually blossoms and she refers to him as her "reading buddy". She slowly starts developing romantic feelings for Kiyotaka.!~

name.native: ティサリア・スキュテイアー
アラーニャ・タランテラ・アラクニダ

164675.description: Esil Radiru, or Elisa Radiru, is a daughter of the Radiru chief and an Aristocratic Demon found at the S-Rank Demon's Castle Instant Dungeon.

name.native: エムリス・イェイエル・フレメヴィーラ

165362.description: A spirited female knight wielding the mythic Spear of Arvess. Zeta is a member of the shadowy group known as The Society alongside Beatrix, Vaseraga, Eustace, and Ilsa. Eyes glittering sharp and blue, she proves her strength by pursuing only the most dangerous of prey. No wall nor enemy can stand up to her steely will and burning spear.

alternative: ミハイル・ド・ロマノフ
レン・ド・クロレンス
クリス・ド・クロレンス

166979.description:
Mu Qing is a supporting character in Heaven Official's Blessing.

Mu Qing is a Martial God who oversees the southwest. Eight hundred years ago, he was the personal attendant of Xie Lian. He abandoned the Prince to take care of his mother when Xie Lian descended from Heaven for the first time.

166980.description:
Feng Xin is a supporting character in Heaven Official's Blessing. 

Feng Xin is a Martial God who oversees the southeast. Eight hundred years ago, he was the imperial bodyguard of Xie Lian and later, the first general of the Crown Prince's Palace Hall.

166994.description:
She is in charge of planning in the 'Second Development Section' and has been with the company for three years. [Shinozaki](https://anilist.co/character/166995/Shinozaki-Takuma), who works in the same team, is the 'only junior staff member' for her and she cares about her in some way.

Her favourite animal is a cat. She is somewhat cat-like herself, and often "catnames" people she likes when she gets close to them or when a tasty-looking meal is brought to her.

She is a reliable older woman who cooks and does her housework well. However, she has never had a boyfriend = she has always been old enough to have one.

166995.description:
He is a first year in the company that is in charge of planning in the 'Second Development Section'.

He is shy about love, and although he is interested in [Shiori](https://anilist.co/character/166994/Katase-Shiori), he is unable to talk about the distance between them; he is healed and thrilled on a daily basis.

He used to go to the arcade when he was in high school and is good at crane games. However, he is of an age where he has never had a girlfriend

166996.description:
She's a new employee joined in the same period as [Shinozaki](https://anilist.co/character/166995/Shinozaki-Takuma). 

She's in charge of design in the 2nd Development Section. She and Shinozaki grew up close to each other and attended the same preschool, elementary school and junior high school. She has a refreshing personality and a clear-cut way of saying things.

Although she keeps it a secret from all her colleagues except Shinozaki, she has geeky hobbies and enjoys cosplay.

168629.description: Kuon Ohara is Rinne's mother, a shut-in and always covered with a hood; she also communicates with a note that has a heart mark.

168729.description: Midoriko is the first LRIG of Hitoe.

168733.description: Chiyori's LRIG in Selector Infected WIXOSS.

168738.description: Yuzuki's LRIG. Hanayo seems to have a calm and a composed personality. She supports Yuzuki in times of need, this is seen when she told Yuzuki that there was nothing wrong with her wish. Hanayo seemed to have some knowledge about Tama which is not yet revealed up to this point.

169142.description: Sakurako Gotou sits near Rumi and Seki during art class and becomes Rumi's friend. She assumes Seki and Rumi are lovers because of the way they interact in class.

169775.description: A highly skilled young knight who serves Noah. He is very quiet and outwardly stoic, particularly with those he does not trust. He is very gullible and likes sweets.He is discriminated against for his Alasa heritage.

169777.description: [Kuroe's](https://anilist.co/character/138874/Akashi-Kuroe) devoted mother, Rinko is shown to be there for her daughter against judgmental people knowing full well that she is a Kaiju. She is a big fan of the singer Ayumi Hamasaki.

169778.description: Arata is a popular guy in [Kuroe's](https://anilist.co/character/138874/Akashi-Kuroe) school who starts getting model offerings. He takes interest in Kuroe, revealing that he too wants to be out of the spotlight, and lost a lot of weight to become the person he is known as. This quickly irritates the other jealous school girls crushing on him who cannot understand what he sees in Kuroe.

170333.description: __Species:__ Humanoid Shuuki __Peach Ability:__ I am the Older Sister, "Invincible" __Affiliation:__ Hidden Village Aoba Wakura is the older sister of [Yuuki Wakura](https://anilist.co/character/170329/Yuuki-Wakura) who'd taught him about being a proper young man, but later went missing at least six years prior in a Mato Disaster

170337.description: __Species:__ Human __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") __Peach Ability:__ Eastern Time, "Golden Hour" __Affiliation:__ Anti-Demon Corps (6th Unit Vice-Chief) Older sister of [Himari Azuma](https://anilist.co/character/170335/Azuma-Himari)

171138.description: A 35-year-old novelist who lives alone. She is deeply introverted, and has not communicated with her relatives for a long time due to arguments with her [mother](https://anilist.co/character/387235) and [sister](https://anilist.co/character/363293). Took in her sister's orphaned daughter, [Asa](https://anilist.co/character/189957).

171748.description:
A second-year student in class D. A bright, positive, and excellent student, she has been given details about [Ayanokoji](https://anilist.co/character/123212/Ayanokouji-Kiyotaka) by [Tsukishiro](https://anilist.co/character/288362/Tsukishiro-Tokinari), and has information about the White Room and other things that only a select few know.

~!At the end of Y2V2, it is revealed that she has been working under Tsukishiro's orders to get Ayanokouji Kiyotaka expelled.!~

171782.description:
Mikage Sakurako is a shy classmate and childhood friend of [Takeru Kakuryuu](https://anilist.co/character/191059/Kakuryuu-Takeru) and [Ayumu Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/127464/Tanaka-Ayumu). She spends a lot of time with Kakuryuu Takeru.

~!She was confessed by Takeru and he is now her boyfriend.!~

171898.description:
__Type:__ Second Generation 

Charon is a member of the White-Clad, that serves as the Second Pillar's guardian. He appears to be a devoted member of the White-Clad with a strong loyalty to the Evangalist. He takes his role as a guardian very seriously with protecting pillars at even risking the cost of his life. Charon has taken care of [Haumea](https://anilist.co/character/160044/Haumea) since she was young although she doesn’t seem to appreciate his efforts. He is very durable and is a expert in hand to hand combat with being very confidence and cunning in his battles.

172724.description: The prettiest girl in class. Various things happened between her and Wataru, leading to her being Tsundere only around him.

172725.description: Wataru is in love with Aika. However one day suddenly things start to change...?

172759.description:
__Height__: 151 cm (4'11")

She's an idol and lead of B-Komachi, an idol group affiliated with Strawberry Productions. Her life took a turn when through an undetermined amount of time, she became pregnant with twins. Not wanting to squander her reputation, she and her team decide to hide this fact; having to play the role of idol and mother.

173635.description: Toshio is a young organic farmer. He is friend along with Taeko and drives until to Yamagata with her journey. (Source: Ghibli Wiki)

173763.description:
__Type:__ Druggie
__Occupations:__ Third-Year High School Student, Chemistry Club President
__Debut:__ Chapter 10

**Girlfriend No. 005**

Kusuri is energetic and ingenuitive; she is capable of creating a drug for almost anything. She doesn't tend to be concerned about the dangers of the drugs she makes, and will often happily force them upon others or take them herself without hesitation.

173812.description:
__Type:__ MILF
__Occupation:__ High School Chairwoman
__Debut:__ Chapter 17

**Girlfriend No. 006** 

[Hakari](https://anilist.co/character/173759/Hakari-Hanazono)'s mother.
Hahari appears as a very mature and sophisticated woman, until she sees something cute. She has an uncontrollable love for cute things, including children, as well as Rentarou and his family. When she sees something she finds cute, she may start drooling. Like her daughter, she is also a pervert towards Rentarou as she is shown to have perverted fantasies about him. 
She is incredibly wealthy, and willing to throw her money around to get what she (or Rentarou) wants. Although she fell in love with Rentarou, Hahari still deeply loves her deceased lover. She feels guilty about falling in love again until Rentarou comforts her and assures her that there is nothing wrong with loving more than one person.

~!When she was very young, Hahari fell in love with a sickly boy her age. He did not have long to live, and because of how much she loved him, she made arrangements with doctors to artificially inseminate herself with his genes in order to leave "proof of his existence". She gave birth to Hakari when she was 13 years old. The boy she loved passed away before they could even kiss.!~

name.native: ライ・バテンカイトス

174097.description: Rye Batenkaitos is a Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult, representing the gourmet aspect of gluttony.

174120.description: He is a student in the architecture department at Jae Won high school and Vice-leader of Burn Knuckle.

174620.description:
Nagato serves as the Admiral's Secretary Ship with [Mutsu](https://anilist.co/character/212208/Mutsu) always alongside her. 

She is calm and collected and carries a serious, intimidating air about her wherever she goes, making sure the other fleet girls abide by the Navy's rules. She apparently has a thing for squirrels and can't stand spicy food.

174689.description: Ayane is the student council secretary.

174691.description: Member of the public morals committee.

174901.description: Shiki is an oni whose powers manifest after an attack by the Momotarou results in the death of his adoptive father. Biologically, he is one of the eight children of Kishin and inherits the Fire elemental attribute. His Blood Eclipse Release manifests as various guns, a reflection of his past interest in them. The tremendous output of his power generates severe aftereffects, such as causing blood to rain from the sky.

alternative: Danblf Ganadore (ダンブルフ・ガンダドア)

175253.description:
Mira or Sakimori Kagami is a player of the VRMMORPG Ark Earth Online and is the foremost expert in the area of Summoning Magic.

His character, Danblf Ganadore is considered one of the expert class players who stands at the height of magic. After putting a lot of effort into using a cash item called the Vanity Case, he accidentally turned his character into a little girl.

This just happened to be when he was brought into the Second World where Ark Earth Online became the reality. As a result, he was forced to profess himself as the disciple of the Wiseman, Danblf Ganadore, (or himself) to hide his identity.

175317.description:
__Height:__ 130 cm
__Race:__ Draph

A no-nonsense swordsman charged with Drang's protection, Sturm lives her life by the sword. She rarely shows interest in other more trifling matters unless she feels her personal code has been violated. If that ever happens, you better watch out. Willing to take on any job for money, no matter how dirty, Sturm meets her clients expectations exactly, making her something of a famous mercenary in less scrupulous circles. Accompanied by Drang, Sturm currently works for the empire.

alternative: Lord Wind Master Qingxuan (风师青玄)

175354.description:
He is one of the Five Elemental Masters in the Heavenly Court. Since he is often worshiped as a female version of himself and often transforms into a woman, he was given the nickname.

He is the younger brother of the Shi Wudu and one of the Four Famous Tales - "The Young Lord Who Pours Wine" (少君倾酒).

name.native: メィリィ・ポートルート

175577.description:
One of the children that lives in the village within [Roswaal](https://anilist.co/character/90182)'s region. She's timid, though is friendly, such as when she introduces a small dog to [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573). 
~!Meili Portroute is a Demon Beast User.!~

175582.description: Rui Arneb is a Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult, representing the satiation aspect of gluttony. Unlike Roy and Lye, Rui doesn't care much about what she eats, putting more emphasis on who she eats with. Rui believes life is unfair and her ideology is trying to find a life that will satisfy her. Rui does not think fondly of her brothers despite them bringing her food and to some degree caring for her.

name.native: スカディ・ドラーゲンフェルト

176990.description: Lingwen is the foremost Civil Goddess in the Heavenly Court and one of the notorious Three Tumors.

name.native: スカーレット・フェアチャイルド

179022.description: Scarlett is a charming young girl with golden-yellow cat-like eyes. She has long red hair which are usually in a long ponytail with black ribbon keeping it in place. She has a tight and slender body which is according to Kizuna is like steel spring with well-shaped bust. After coming to Ataraxia she starts wearing school uniform and stylish casual clothes like top and miniskirts in her free time.

179109.description: She initially acts tough and makes Nobuaki use the -san suffix when addressing her but slowly opens up.

179625.description:
__Level:__ 1100
__Race:__ High Elf
__Title:__ Skill Master No.3

Fell into the VR world of Leadale after her life support began to fail. Since her days in the hospital, she spent most of her time in the VRMMORPG. She is naturally kind to children and to the elderly because of her life experience at the hospital.

Cayna had submitted a total of three sub-characters from the Foster System (NPC Compensation Program), two of which she’d purchased in-game. At the time, she had decided all three would be her children. Skargo, the eldest of the three, was an elf and priest type who was highly skilled in the healing arts. Next was her daughter, Mai-Mai, Skargo’s younger sister and also an elf. Finally, Cayna’s youngest, Kartatz was “adopted” even in the conventional sense. ~!Her level later raises to 1109 after breaking the limits of the system.!~

name.native: ゼニス・グレイラット

179855.description:
Zenith Greyrat is the wife of [Paul Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88347) and the mother of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348) and [Norn Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145458/Norn-Greyrat).

~!Zenith was born in the Holy Country of Milis, as the second daughter of an earl of Milis. She grew up following the Milis Church religion, never breaking the rules, getting good grade in school, and had nickname Milis young lady standard. But, when Zenith reached the age of 15, she rebelled against her parents and ran away from home.

While trying to find a job as a Healer, she was a solo adventurer for a time. However she was frequently conned out of a large amount of money due to the little knowledge she had on how expensive healer's are, but was saved by Paul Greyrat. She then join Paul's party, the Fangs of the Black Wolf, as a healer. She spent a long time in the party as a healer and gradually began to fall in love with Paul and wanted to marry him. However Paul was a womanizer who frequently slept with multiple women and she didn't want to be with someone like that so she told him if he promised to be faithful to her then she would sleep with him, to which he agreed.
Shortly after, she became pregnant with Rudeus and as a result both her and Paul retired from adventuring and settled down in the countryside.!~


__Light Novel Volume 13 Spoiler__
~!After being freed from the Teleport Labyrinth, she does not express emotions actively since she sees the world around her as if she were in a trance or dream. Occasionally she will display actions that show her emotions, such as when she smiled at Norn or hit Rudeus when he said he was going to add Eris to his family as a wife, which shows signs of her personality basically unchanged but hidden and suppressed by her dream state caused by her Miko Powers.!~

180548.description:
Keiji is a man who cares about his fellow crew members, who he wants to protect at all costs, as well as humans in general. The latter is shown when he jumped to save Hong , his enemy, when she was being attacked by a Terraformar inside the Annex I.

Different from his fellow crew members Marcos E. Garcia and Akari Hizamaru Keiji is rather prudish around women as he was visibly uncomfortable with the prospect of drinking Echdina milk from Peggy Fortie's stomach and visibly embarrassed by the sight of a nude Xi Chun-Li. He also refuses to hit people, keeping those words even when Xi damaged his ribs as well as one of his testicles, such belief coming from his father, teaching him how he must be strong in order to help anyone, even those who don't have anything left but violence to go forward in life.

180693.description: Mina is a very talented member of the Defense Force and an extremely talented marksman. She is the captain of the Defense Force's Third Division. When she was a child, she and [Kafka](https://anilist.co/character/180692/Kafka-Hibino) met each other after a Kaiju attack, swearing that they will both join the Defense Force and fight Kaiju alongside each other.

181025.description: Shuichi's father. One day he stopped going to work to study "the art of the spiral", creating an abnormal obsession with that shape.

181035.description: A news reporter from Toyo TV.

181036.description: Kirie's childhood classmate. Had fallen in love with Yoriko Endo.

181042.description:
One of Kirie Goshima's school friends.
~! After Kirie's hair was affected by the spiral in 'Medusa', Kyoko becomes obsessively jealous from all the attention Kirie was getting, leading to Kyoko to spiral her own hair. !~

181313.description: [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru)'s Earth Dragon that he officially received from [Crusch Karsten](https://anilist.co/character/90185/Karsten-Crusch) for his efforts in the Hakugei battle. Despite being of a species known for being feisty, Patrasche is extremely loyal to Subaru, as she is willing to put her life on the line for him.

181336.description:
A classmate of [Shiki](https://anilist.co/character/174901/Ichinose-Shiki) at Rasetsu Academy. He's short-tempered, but has a pure side when it comes to love.

(Source: Official Site)

181338.description: A student in Shiki's class, as well as his love interest. In her past, she was heavily abused by her parents, leaving her constantly apologetic and self-deprecating. Her Blood Eclipse Release manifests as the "Blood Titan", a gargantuan, ghoul-like representation of her sister, who used to protect her from their parents before being killed by their father.

181339.description: The teacher of Shiki's class. A taciturn, strict man, he is a highly-skilled fighter respected as such by both the oni and the Momotarou. He often travels on roller skates instead of walking. His Blood Eclipse Release manifests as an umbrella.

181340.description: A student in Shiki's class and his roommate. His father is a Momotarou who previously attempted to kill Jin after he discovered his son was an oni, leaving Jin with scars and stitches all over his body. His father also killed his mother and sister for the same reason. As a result, Jin seeks little else but to eventually get powerful enough to kill his father, often brushing off Shiki and the others. His Blood Eclipse Release manifests as buzzsaws that pop out from his wounds.

181480.description:
Shouma Toriashi is an old friend of [Yoshino's](https://anilist.co/character/127205/Somei-Yoshino) and his adopted relative. Currently he's a university student.

~!He was abandoned by his biological father in middle school, and became an orphan. He was then adopted by Yoshino's grandfather Somei Renji.!~

181708.description: A beautiful elf [Zagan](https://anilist.co/character/181709/Zagan) bought for one million gold coins. She is wary of him at first but later on feels comfortable by his side, and is able to understand him despite when he cant properly express his feelings.

181709.description: A young but powerful mage who is one of the candidates to be a "demon lord." He is a handsome eighteen-year-old, that later on buys an elf slave due to falling in love with her at first sight.

181710.description: Zagan's partner in crime, that is to say, his only friend. He is also as powerful or even more than Zagan. He too is a candidate of becoming a demon lord.

181711.description: A clerk at the store where Nephelia and Zagan buy clothes. She has an easygoing personality.

181712.description: A young dragon who attacked Zagan to steal his powers because she desires strength.

name.native: シャスティル・リルクヴィスト

181713.description: A woman who is a member of the Angelic Knights, a force of the Chivalric Order that dispenses justice against sorcerers in the name of God.

182176.description: In middle school she was given the nickname "stone" and afterwards she became a withdrawn girl who had forgotten how to cry or laugh. By coincidence, she met [Kai](https://anilist.co/character/162041/Kai-Miura) after enrolling at Hachimitsu High School.

182333.description:
__Type:__ Hangry
__Occupation:__ Third-Year Middle School Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 24

**Girlfriend No. 007**

Kurumi absolutely loves food and possesses an extremely high metabolism. As such, she's almost constantly hungry, and she grows extremely cranky if she isn't eating the certain food that she happens to be craving for at the moment. Kurumi has a strong word-association when it comes to food. Almost anything can remind her of food, at which point she has to eat that food or else she will become irritable.

183497.description:
One of Kuromine Asahi's close friends. He is portrayed as stoic and cool. He also plays a large part in pushing Asahi towards Shiragami.

~!He harbours a crush on Akemi Mikan since middle school!~

183606.description: He was supposed to have died at the age of 18 due to an incurable disease, but he will be reincarnated in a different world similar to the strategic class SLG "Eternal Nations" that he was enthusiastic about during his life.

183607.description: The hero unit that [Takuto](https://anilist.co/character/183606/Ira-Takuto) used in "Eternal Nations". Determined to build a country again with Takuto.

184312.description: Dwarf warrior who was a part of the Hero's party, later became a mentor to [Stark](https://anilist.co/character/184313/Stark).

184458.description: Shaula is the overseer of the Pleiades Watchtower created by Flugel. She is tall, has dark green eyes and long brown blackish hair. Her outfit has a similar color scheme to that of Subaru. It is noted that the design for her outfit came from Flugel and her mother. Shaula is seen as empty-headed and unconcerned, yet Shaula has been shown to show deep emotion in certain situations especially with Subaru.

184956.description: A shadow Sung Jin-Woo gained after entering the Red Gate. ~!Before being reawakened as a Shadow he was Chul Kim (김철), an A-Rank Hunter of the White Tiger Guild.!~

186479.description:

Scientist and leader of the American Colony. Similar to [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Ishigami-Senkuu), Xeno is brilliant when it comes to science. He is very observant, somewhat eccentric, and has a penchant for stating the word "Elegant."

186483.description: Stanley is a tall, well-built man with very feminine facial features.

name.native: エリナリーゼ・ドラゴンロード

alternative: The Great Empress of the Demon Realm

186588.description:
Kishirika Kishirisu is The Great Empress of the Demon Realm. She is the demon empress known for her demon eyes' powers and the ability to bestow others with demon eyes. She is engaged to [Badigadi](https://anilist.co/character/262620/Badigadi), the demon lord of immortality.

__Light Novel Volume 4 Spoiler__
~!Kishirika Kishirisu is the person that is responsible for giving [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) his demon eye, among other favors!~

alternative: アイリーン・ ホルトン

187029.description: Irene Holton is the only daughter of the Holton Family. She was known as the Monarch of Destitution. Irene is an innocent girl that is at first reluctant to do anything. During the fight against the relic Hand of Midas, with the help of Seo Joo-Heon, she gained confidence and dominated the relic and seized complete control over it. After this event, she would gain more confidence and start to help Seo Joo-Heon in his every task.

187178.description:
Before the time rewind, he was (and still is) a specialist in relic restoration. He became known as the Fraud King, something which Chairman Kwon eventually became aware of. Jae-Ha met Joo-Heon through being on the same raiding team.

~!When Joo-Heon tries to seek him out in order to repair his relics, Irene informs him that he is 'dead'. She then recounts that he had sold her brother, George Hilton, a false painting. He was caught for the fraud and was presumed dead after his car fell down a cliff.He's later discovered to be alive when Edward called him on behalf of Chairman Kwon. Since he'd damaged his relic and needed it to be repaired. Something he agrees to.

Joo-Heon lures him out by requesting a relic restoration. His high-ranking relics making Jae-Ha try to scam him with false ones, running away with the real ones. He fails to do so, being caught by Joo-Heon's rope relic.

He is then approached to sign a 'slave contract' which is then reformed to an 'exclusive contract'. In order to rope him in, Joo-Heon offers an explanation for how Richard Chang (his tutor) stole Jae-Ha's art style. In addition to giving him back the elements of art and reputation that Richard had stolen from him.!~

187179.description: Jullian Miller was framed by Seo Joo-Heon as the culprit and blackmailer attempting to steal the Julius Caesar relic.

name.native: リニア・デドルディア

187380.description:
Linia Dedoldia is the granddaughter of the Village Chief, Gustav, of the Doldia Tribe.

~!She later becomes the slave of Rudeus Greyrat for buying/saving her from the slave trader.!~

name.native: プルセナ・アドルディア

187381.description: Together with Linia Dedoldia they are the two troublemakers in Ranoa Magic Academy, but when it comes to fulfilling her dreams of becoming the Village Chief she will do her best. She likes eating meat.

187382.description:
Orsted is the current Dragon God, 2nd-ranked of the 7 World Powers, and the sworn enemy of [Hitogami](https://anilist.co/character/211165/Hitogami). Similar to other Dragon Race people such as [Perugius](https://anilist.co/character/209572/Perugius-Dola), he has silver hair and golden sanpaku eyes with an overpowering look. He carries no visible equipment and wears a white coat adorned with fur.

Orsted has a curse that makes every living being feel an overwhelming fear just from being within his presence. Strangely enough, this curse does not affect [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) or [Nanahoshi](https://anilist.co/character/137816/Nanahoshi-Shizuka).

187710.description: Zanoba Shirone is a doll loving prince of Shirone. When he was three years old, he killed his brother, the Fourth prince, as if his brother was a doll. When he was 15 years old, he killed his wife, as if she was a doll.

188521.description:

__Occupation:__ Personal Maid
__Debut:__ Chapter 30

**Girlfriend No. 008**

The personal maid of [Hahari Hanazono](https://anilist.co/character/173812/Hahari-Hanazono). Mei is polite and proper, rarely showing strong emotions. She is loyal to Hahari above all else, and is unlikely to do anything unless given permission or ordered to by Hahari specifically. Mei's fanatical loyalty to the Rentarou Family and the Hanazono Family results in her gladly offering to "eliminate" people that threaten, insult, or even mildly inconvenience [Rentarou](https://anilist.co/character/173758/Aijou-Rentarou), Hahari, or the other girlfriends.

Mei is an all-around maid. It seems that she can do nearly everything, including driving, cooking, shooting, and even nursing. Mei is also shown to exceed her already exceptional abilities if ordered to do so by Hahari.

189689.description: A wee little manager who runs a Knickknack Shack for skyfarers. She is extremely confident that she can ease any traveler's worries. She also offers jobs and human resource services in addition to running an inn and bar. Whew!

189957.description: After the passing away of her parents, she was adopted by her [Aunt Makio](https://anilist.co/character/171138). She now faces the hardship of adapting to a new environment, while sorting the emotions within herself.

190563.description:
Dolph is Scarlet's obsessive ex-boyfriend, he fist appears in Season 2, Episode 10. He also pilots a giant black mecha that vaguely resembles the C.O.R.E. from the Gogol Empire.

(Source: Space Dandy Wikia)

Poe is the consciousness of Planet Limbo, she makes her first debut in Season 2, Episode 8.

Yoko's new boyfriend who is rude to Carpaccio. He is presumable killed by the sun when it burned the planet.

190578.description:
A homely female student at Andromeda Academy's Baberly Hills School. Dandy uses her to try to find the unregistered alien species on the planet, unaware that she is in fact said the Pureness Alien he seeks.

(Source: Wikipedia)

190582.description:
L'Delise is a fisherman on planet Kaiyu seeking to catch the legendary Munagi.

(Source: Wikipedia)

190673.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm
__Race:__ Erune

Manipulator of foxflame, Yuel searches for the remnants of a thousand years of history. As the inheritor of an ancient ancestral power, Yuel is determined to restore her family's royal lineage. Though it is questionable whether an heir still exists, she continues to travel the Skydom and experience much on her travels. Full of curiosity about the world, Yuel often finds herself off-track, but she views such moments as only minor setbacks

190912.description:
__Type:__ Masochist
__Occupations:__ First-Year High School Student, Baseball Club Member
__Debut:__ Chapter 33

**Girlfriend No. 009**

Iku loves baseball, to the point of spending hours recruiting for her team when it's on the verge of being disbanded. She is determined to do her best no matter what; because of this she's described as the embodiment of "stoicism" by Rentarou. Iku is also wildly masochistic, going so far as to train for hours until her body is in agony so she can enjoy the pain.

191059.description:
Takeru is a childhood friend of Ayumu Tanaka and Mikage Sakurako, whom he spends a lot of time with.
~!He confesses to [Sakurako](https://anilist.co/character/171782/Sakurako-Mikage) in chapter 141, and now they are a couple.!~

191060.description: Urushi's Best Friend. She constantly teases Urushi when it comes to Ayumu.

191061.description:
Rin Kagawa is a junior (kouhai) of Tanaka Ayumu, Kakuryuu Takeru and Mikage Sakurako. She attends the same middle school as all of her seniors, and also in high school. She was in the former Kendo Club in middle school and joins the Shogi club due to following Ayumu's steps. She loves to compete in any competition especially Shogi and Kendo with her senpais, especially Ayumu and Takeru.
~!She is in love with [Ayumu](https://anilist.co/character/127464/Ayumu-Tanaka) but she will only confess to him when she lands a point on him in Kendo.!~ ~!Even though she loves Ayumu she helps Ayumu to get better in shogi so that he can defeat Urushi and confess to her!~

191539.description:
A talented detective and the student with the highest grades in Detective Training Academy BLUE's history. As his detective license was revoked after an incident five years ago, he has partnered up with [Totomaru Isshiki](https://anilist.co/character/193587/) to still be able to solve cases.

~!Later, it is confirmed that Ron Kamonohashi isn't the true culprit behind the Bloody Field Trip, but "Shachi". It was to ruin his detective life.!~

192778.description: __Species:__ Human __Height:__ 155 cm __Peach Ability:__ Golden Xing Yi Quan, "Beast Power" __Affiliation:__ Anti-Demon Corps (1st Unit Chief) Konomi Tatara is the Anti-Demon Corps' 1st Unit new Chief after the previous Chief, [Riu Myouga](https://anilist.co/character/266765/Myouga-Riu) stepped down from her position.

192781.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm

192783.description:

**Peach Ability:** "Vairocana"
**Affiliation:** Anti-Demon Corps (Anti-Demon Unit Commander & 10th Unit Chief)

Ren Yamashiro is the Anti-Demon Unit Commander and 10th Unit Chief. She had an upbringing where she succeeded in anything and everything that she did, whether it was mock exams, sports competitions, or leading the student council. Having eaten a Peach from Mato and receiving powerful abilities, she has been described by the previous president as "life's apex."

192784.description:

193863.description:
An apprentice knight—though in reality, she is a man who once made a name for himself as the Hero-King. Reincarnated as a lovely young girl, she hones her skills with the sole aim of becoming stronger.

Nothing pleases her more than battling formidable opponents. Lacking the official qualifications to become a knight, she volunteers to serve her childhood friend, [Rafinha](https://anilist.co/character/193864/Rafinha-Bilford), as a squire. She regards Rafinha like a granddaughter and keeps a watchful eye on her, always on guard to ensure no "bad influences" get too close.

194086.description: Rafael is The Eldest Son Of Marquis Bilford's House.

194088.description: Irina is Selena's Sister and Marquis' Wife.

196166.description:
**Height:** 158 cm (5'2")

At school, Renako acts bright and sociable. However, while she enjoys talking with her classmates, this is only a front, and her "true self" is gloomy and negative.

In middle school, Renako declined an invitation to go out with her classmates, causing them to reject her. Renako spent the rest of middle school as a hikikomori as a result of this. Because of what happened to her in the past, she has trouble declining invitations and requests from her classmates.

196167.description:
**Height:** 167 cm (5'6")

Mai is gifted academically and athletically, and [Renako](https://anilist.co/character/196166/Amaori-Renako) describes her as the pinnacle of beauty. Mai is arrogant and forthright, owing to her status as the school's Madonna. Though she is polite in general, when she is alone with Renako, she is very open and persistent with her desires. She has a tendency to act on a whim. 

The day after meeting Mai, she confesses to Renako. Renako declines, but Mai persists. They both agree that when Mai wears her hair down, they are in "lovers mode," and when she ties it up, they are in "friends mode."

Mai's mother is an internationally renowned fashion designer, and Mai is one of her models. As a result, her family is very wealthy.

196376.description: Likes: Glass molding A neighbor of Takuya from his hometown.

197584.description: Kinji Hakari is a character in the Jujutsu Kaisen series. He is a third-year student at Tokyo Jujutsu High who is currently suspended for clashing with authority. While away from the school, Kinji is running a fight club between sorcerers for money.

197921.description:
__Type:__ Narcissist
__Occupation:__ Second-Year High School Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 39  

**Girlfriend No. 010**

Mimimi is very haughty and narcissistic, constantly complimenting herself and talking about her beauty. Despite her appearance of a naturally-beautiful rich girl, Mimimi actually works incredibly hard to provide for herself and keep herself beautiful. She works for herself to earn money, is frugal where appropriate so she can afford expensive, gorgeous clothing, and puts significant effort into her appearance. Though she puts a lot of value on outward appearances, Mimimi also recognizes inner beauty when she sees it.

198451.description: Hiroshi Yuuki, with the player name of Hiro, is a high school boy who loves to play virtual reality MMORPGs. When a game store manager named [Reona Kisaragi](https://anilist.co/character/198454/Kisaragi-Reona) forces him to buy the game Kiwame Quest, he soon discovers that it is not what it seems. Unlike regular games, it is a game that tries to pursue realism to a fanatical point. As such, Hiroshi struggles to eke out a niche. Along the way, he meets many girls who all want something from him.

198452.description: He was Hiroshi's best friend in "Kiwame Quest" and worked as a farmer at an apple farm.

198453.description: She was the sister of [Martin](https://anilist.co/character/198452/Martin) and the childhood friend of [Hiro](https://anilist.co/character/198451/Yuuki-Hiroshi) in "Kiwame Quest".

198454.description: Reona is the manager of the desolate game store Kisaragi. She is a beautiful woman with clear silver hair and a great sense of style, but she forcefully sells [Hiroshi Yuuki](https://anilist.co/character/198451/Yuuki-Hiroshi) the VRMMORPG game "Kiwame Quest".

198455.description: She works as an inquisitor in the City of Ted.

198456.description: Kaede is Hiroshi's younger sister in the real world.

198660.description: Mamoru Aoyama was an inmate at the juvenile detention center. Often picked on by the other inmates due to his short stature and feeble nature, he received some training from Danpei, who teaches him dodging techniques that make him a hard opponent to fight against, even managing to score a win against one of the toughest inmates during the juvie boxing tournament.

name.native: ディラン・ターグ・ララトイア

200241.description: Igarashi is Kokoro's manager and an agent from the modeling agency Bon Rouge. Igarashi is a former model and Shizuku's friend and colleague, having worked with her at Bon Rouge as teenagers.

200245.description: Yuriko is the kind and loving mother of Ikuto, Honoka, Aoi, and Ichika. Ever since her husband died when her children were young, Yuriko has been the sole provider for her family and her tendency to overwork herself has led her to be hospitalized many times. Despite the hardships she endures, Yuriko remains positive for her children's sake and maintains a playful sense of humor, especially towards Ikuto.

200246.description: Chiyuki's father. He is the owner of Mille Neige and is also the one who recognized Tsumura's talent

200710.description: Michiru Saruwatari is a young Bushi girl who was saved by Musashi when she was about to be eaten by an Oni.

201283.description: Naotora Takeda is the captain of the Takeda Bushi and one of the Five Grand Generals.

201284.description:
Nanao Inusaka is a Bushi.

~!She fights alongside the Onis. She is a member of an unknown organization, who wants to capture the Obsidian Goddess.!~

alternative: The Ruler of the Kitetsu Sword

201285.description:
~!Kokuyou no Megami is a mysterious entity that hides in Musashi's body. She is chased by Shiro Inukai and Nanao Inusaka.

Previously she was hosted by Jisai Kanemaki.!~

201286.description: Tatsuomi Uesugi is one of the Five Grand Generals of Hi no Moto and the captain of the Uesugi Bushi. He also leads the Uesugi Alliance during the fight against the green Kishin, Yamata no Orochi.

201311.description: Reid Astrea was the first Sword Saint and a key figure in the sealing of the Witch of Envy 400 years ago.

201741.description: A child-like werewolf who lives with Reiji. She usually takes on a human form.

201743.description: Mina is a Ghost that lives at Kirio Drugs that denies being a ghost as she calls herself the house’s protective deity.

201744.description: A corporate drone who wakes up in another world with the "Medicine Making" skill.

201745.description: Captain of the Red Cat Brigade.

name.native: エレイン・フェーン・ドラン・バルガス

201746.description: Elaine Fen Dran Valgas is the daughter of Casty and Flam Fen Dran Valgas. After meeting Reiji she starts hanging around Kirio Drugs and even works in the store.

202401.description:
She was the Imperial Preceptor of the fallen Banyue kingdom. She was claimed a traitor by its people after allowing the invading army into the city.
~!She had first met Xie Lian over 200 years ago. He took care of her as she was an orphan as a child!~

202488.description: Kiryuuin Fuuka is a student in Class 3-B. She is the only student in Advanced Nurturing High School to have an A+ in both Academic and Physical Abilities, shown in the OAA app. She was described by Kiriyama as a 'Female Kouenji'.

202982.description:
A close friend of AA2153, they faced certain challenges together as newbies in the horrifying situation of the body they work in. Unlike his friend, he often runs away from these situations, to put his mind at ease, but is encouraged by AA2153 to work and push forward together.

~!His story sadly ends when he sacrificed himself by pushing AA2153 out of stomach acid, but in turn, fell into it.!~

203438.description: She runs a modeling agency and is friends with [Yukino Koizumi](https://anilist.co/character/55095/Yukino-Koizumi).

204443.description:
__Height:__ 140cm

Shii is in the same class as [Koguma](https://anilist.co/character/133946/Koguma) and [Reiko](https://anilist.co/character/133947/Reiko). During the cultural festival, she had troubles with some equipment they needed to move as the teacher's car wasn't available. Per Koguma's desire, Koguma and Reiko helped her using their Cubs. The Cubs piqued Shii's interest and she started to hang out with them. 

She runs a bakery at her home, which Reiko and Koguma often visit.

205434.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

A girl who strived to become an idol at a young age, but due to her family situation, made sacrifices that ultimately ended with her becoming too old to become one. She is a YouTuber. 

~!Mem-cho's real age is 25, and she is later recruited as the third member of the re-formed B-Komachi idol group.!~

205447.description: Atena grew up sheltered from boys. As a result, she can't handle being near them and will get a severe nosebleed if she touches one.

205448.description:
Mineru is a fourth year student who lives in the Seikan's "Goddess Dormitory."

Mineru is a researcher who loves working with toxic gas, but due to that she often fails her experiments.

205449.description: Serene is mysterious, easy-going and docile. She usually doesn't leave the dorm other than for school, but with Koushi's help, she managed to go out on a trip with everyone. Her room is filled with trash that she claims can suck the moon energy needed to help her with her lunar technology.

205450.description: Kiriya was raised in a martial arts dojo alongside her three brothers. She bought a shoujo manga for the first time in college and was instantly hooked. But she often gets too excited reading these love stories. This leads to her breaking walls with her martial arts. She also has the habit of tossing and turning a lot in her sleep. Because of her stoic personality at school, she secretly feels pressured to set a good example around the other students. ~!After Koushi started treating her like a girl and not a tomboy, she begins to grow feelings towards him. This leads her to acting more embarrassed and girly in his presence.!~

205451.description:
Koshi is quite responsible and mature for his age. Even after being abandoned by his father, he fell into depression and tried to look for a job. When he started to work as dorm mother, even though the girls were older than him, he didn't hesitate to scold them. He even tries to warn them to be more aware of how they act and dress as he is still a boy and has desires.

On his birthday, Koshi's house burns down, and having no money, his father decides to abandon and leave. Roaming the streets, he falls exhausted from hunger. [Mineru Wachi](https://anilist.co/character/205448/Mineru-Wachi) finds him and takes him to her dorm, where she gives him food. There he meets the other members in the dorm. Learning about Koshi's situation, Mineru proposes he lives there and works as dorm mother. Only [Atena Saotome](https://anilist.co/character/205447/Atena-Saotome) is against it as she can't handle being close to men. Koshi decides to turn the offer down as he doesn't want to make Atena not feel at ease at her home. Seeing how considerate he is, Atena decides to accept him and allows him to be the dorm mother.

Koshi then starts doing daily chores, but while doing so, he often runs into the troubling members. Mineru often works with poisonous experiments and walks naked. [Frey](https://anilist.co/character/205452/Frey) likes to cosplay and forces Koshi to be her model. [Kiriya Sensho](https://anilist.co/character/205450/Kiriya-Senshou) is a martial artist who gets excited while reading shoujo manga and relieves stress by punching the walls. And [Serene Hozumi](https://anilist.co/character/205449/Serene-Hozumi) who uses him as a servant.

205452.description: As a fashion aficionado, Frey loves to make dresses and is an avid cosplayer. She is bashful and happy. Though, she can be strong headed and stubborn at times (as shown in her making people wear an outfit no matter what).

205453.description:
Sutea is a childhood friend of Koshi Nagumo.

She has a crush on Koushi and easily gets worried about him, but acts like she isn't. She has a heat sensitive body and dislikes being touched. ~!When she revealed that to young Koushi, he ended up cooling his hands with ice before touching her.!~

205579.description:
__Height:__ 171 cm

Soushirou is a Vice-Commander of the Defense Force's Third Division. Despite his laid back nature, he is shown to be very powerful, specializing with bladed weapons.

Soushirou comes from a family of Kaijuu slayers dating back to the Muromachi Period.

205771.description:
**Type:** Self-Conscious 
**Occupation:** First-Year High School Student
**Debut:** Chapter 45

**Girlfriend No. 011**

Meme is extremely shy, to the point of wearing masks to hide her face in order to avoid drawing attention to herself. She strives to keep her face hidden no matter what. Meme also enjoys knitting, and spends time knitting a lot of little stuffed animals. She uses these stuffed animals for "misdirection", in which she runs away quickly and leaves a stuffed animal as a distraction so no one sees where she went. Meme wears a modest turtleneck beneath her school blazer, and dark pantyhose. She also wears a minimizing bra to conceal the size of her chest.

205878.description:
__Height:__ 169.5 cm

A first year student in high school. Known as the female prince of the school. She works at her family's ramen shop.

206062.description:
The Judge who presides over almost all of Phoenix's cases. The Judge, though well meaning, is naive and very gullible. Not the brightest bulb.

No one knows the Judge's real name (Phoenix gets the Judge's business card in JFA, but cannot make it out).

206067.description: Umeyo Shouchiku is a witness in the murder of Mia Fey. She accused Mia's sister, Maya, for this crime.

206074.description: Natsumi Oosawagi is a fiery-tempered photographer who appeared as a witness in several of Phoenix Wright's cases, with much of the photographic evidence in said cases coming from her.

name.native: ギレーヌ・デドルディア

206392.description: __Ghislaine Dedoldia__ is the daughter of Gustav the former Doldia village chief, and the mentor of [Eris](https://anilist.co/character/88349/Eris-Boreas-Greyrat) and she is also the student of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) in magic and other subjects. She is one of the few people who have become a Sword King.

206604.description:
Sara was born in Asura in the Milbotts Region ruled by the Notos Greyrat Family. Her father was a hunter from whom she learned how to use the bow. Now a prodigy for her talent with the bow, she is an A-ranked adventurer and member of the party Counter Arrow. 

~!When a horde of monsters attacked her hometown, the Notos family refused to send their soldier, because of that she lost her father, which lead to her hatred of the nobility in general. Suzanne who was helping in the subjugation of the monsters, picked up Sara. After some years, she became a official member of the party Counter Arrow.!~

207214.description:
__Ability__: Quintuple her physical abilities

She is a second year high school student.

207262.description: A woman who meets [Gonda](https://anilist.co/character/180081) on an online dating app. She is a fan of idol Mikki from group Am7. ~!She is a single working mother.!~

207492.description: Mrs Park or known as Daniel's Mother supports Daniel throughout the story. Although Daniel is originally blind to her love and sacrifice for him, he later realizes how hard she's worked to provide for him and help him, and hence, works to give back to her.

208058.description:
__Ability__: To create torture instruments out of her body fluid.

Rin Kashii is a character in Battle in 5 Seconds After Meeting series. She was previously an Office Lady.

208062.description:
__Ability__: To become invincible for 2 seconds.

Kumagiri Shin is a pro wrestler.

208077.description: Rio is a high school student who is [Ichika](https://anilist.co/character/141687/Arima-Ichika)'s best friend and is in the same class as her. She is a member of the tennis club and is also [Ryou](https://anilist.co/character/141688/Amakusa-Ryou)'s younger sister.

208078.description: [Ryou](https://anilist.co/character/141688)'s high school friend and a photographer.

208079.description:
She works at the same company as [Ryou](https://anilist.co/character/141688). She is a hidden closet nerd who is a fan of *Forward World*.

~!She develops feelings for Ryou and decides to confess to him.!~

208080.description: He is [Ichika](https://anilist.co/character/141687) and [Rio's](https://anilist.co/character/208077) classmate. He is a ghost member of the literary club. He likes to read light novels, which he often shares with Ichika.

208204.description: Naoya Zenin is one of the sons of [Naobito Zenin](https://anilist.co/character/188432/Zenin-Naobito) and believes himself to be the true heir of the Zenin Family.

208618.description: Ever-popular and a natural flirt, Saku is the star of the show at Fuji High School.

208619.description: A girl in [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/208618/Saku-Chitose)'s friend group and a member of the girl's basketball team. With good looks, a carefully crafted image and her flirty personality, Yuzuki is noted to be the one in Team Chitose who thinks the most like Saku. She's a very close friend of [Haru Aomi](https://anilist.co/character/208621/Haru-Aomi)'s.

208620.description: A girl in [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/208618/Saku-Chitose)'s friend group and the vice president of their class. Yuuko is somewhat of an airhead who's oblivious to her own charms, but she is highly fashionable and very attached to Saku.

208621.description: A girl in [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/208618/Saku-Chitose)'s friend group and a member of the girl's basketball team. Haru is very comfortable talking to boys due to her aligning interests with them. She is very athletic, an excellent basketball player and a very close friend of [Yuzuki Nanase](https://anilist.co/character/208619/Yuzuki-Nanase)'s.

208622.description: A girl in [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/208618/Saku-Chitose)'s friend group. Known to be more of a "self-made" popular girl, she became acquainted with Team Chitose later than the rest. Yua is very kind and polite, but knows when to put her foot down.

208902.description: She heads the "Fourth Peacekeeper Squad," or "K4." Though she is open-minded, mild-mannered, and sweet, Nana has an uncanny ability to disarm anyone with stealth that one would expect from her.

208909.description:
Mari is member of the OJT who joins a month after Naoto Takayama joins. She works as a maid in the cafe where the Fourth Vigilance Squad dine.


Her sense of hearing is impeccable that she could describe anything she hears with precise details.

208914.description: The fiendish instructor and commander of the Tokyo Security Force's mobile units. Despite being sometimes harsh, she deeply cares for the safety of the passengers.

210789.description:
**Height:** 176 cm

Minato Kiyoumizu is former water polo player who quit the sport after an injury. He is forced by [Eitarou Oka](https://anilist.co/character/210791/Oka-Eitarou) and [Jou Joujima](https://anilist.co/character/210790/Joujima-Jou) to join Yamninami High School's water polo club.

210790.description:
**Height:** 177 cm

Jo is the captain of the water polo team in which Minato plays for while he's in high school. He was the one to recruit Minato for the team.

210791.description:
**Height:** 170 cm


Eitarou Oka is Minato Kiyomizu's junior from the same junior high school. He is a person who knows about Minato's past. Due to his admiration for Minato, Eitarou entered Yamanami High School.

210792.description:
**Height:** 165 cm

Chinu Kawakubo is a famous water polo player who is featured in the media. She knows about Minato Kiyomizu's past.

210905.description: Soichirou is a young city councilor with a promising future. He used to be an extremely skilled full-dive RPG gamer and he is the only player to have conquered the "Kiwame Quest". His player name is Kamui (カムイ).

212393.description:
__Height:__ 171 cm (5'7")

Heir to house Ulster, a renowned line of fire mages. He has one younger sister. Following a certain incident during his first year at the academy, he became painfully aware of Will and began to see him as a rival.

name.native: エドワルド・セルフェンス

212395.description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'9")

An ascendant who made it to the top of the Tower, earning the qualification to become Magia Vander, before being defeated by another candidate. He now works as a professor at Regarden Magical Academy, where he teaches Dark Magic and History and Origins of Magic. Ten years ago, he was one of a group of problem children who enlisted to fight in the Great War despite still being students.

212439.description: A medical oni initially the main force behind the medical wing of the oni's Kyoto branch, but later becoming Rasetsu Academy's personal doctor. His Blood Eclipse Release grants him the ability to perform miraculous blood transfusions that can even restore lost limbs, although he can only do a certain amount at a time. Though often called out for being lecherous, he has a deep care for his patients.

213616.description:
Tama is a doll-obsessed cat god who adores Kohina because of her expressionless demeanour. She's the face of her restaurant and behaves like a cat be it chasing a toy or not liking the presence of water bottles.

(Source: Gugure! Kokkuri-san Wiki)

214287.description:
Kwon Tae-Jun is the main villain of Tomb Raider King.

He is CEO of TKBM Company and TKBM Excavation Team. In previous life, he became the strongest relic user with the help of Seo Ju-Heon and his team.

214580.description:
__Type:__ Cousin 
__Occupation:__ First-Year Middle School Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 51

**Girlfriend No. 012**

Chiyo is reliable and tidy which led to her becoming class president. But, she secretly dislikes the high expectations others place on her. When she takes her glasses off, she becomes anxious and begins crying uncontrollably.

215388.description: Yuu's best friend since junior high school. She is good at manipulating people to make them do things she wants, and she is an honor student at school and the daughter of a good family.

216128.description: Hinata Tachibana is a beleaguered 32-year-old office worker, and he and his handsome best friend Tsukasa Jinguuji were summoned to another world by a naked goddess. However, because of the goddess's mischief, Tachibana was turned into a beautiful girl. To get his body back, he has to go on a journey with his best friend to defeat the demon king.

216129.description: Hinata's best friend who was transported to the fantasy world along with him.

216690.description: A mysterious researcher who seemed to have knowledge about the Pupa virus and is currently doing experiments regarding it.

216692.description:
Shuugo is a student at Yamanami High School. He was a swimmer when he was in middle school.

He is talented and cool.

216693.description:
**Height:** 178 cm

Takekazu Ejiri is a student at Yamanami High School. He is noisy, hot-blooded, and quick to fight. He belonged to the baseball club in junior high school.

216694.description:
**Height:** 188 cm

Yutaka Babayaro Inomata is a student at Yamanami High School. His father is Nigerian. He has a gentle personality.

216695.description:
**Height:** 168 cm

Yoshiharu Ushimado is a student at Yamanami High School. He's not good at expressing himself due to his withdrawn personality.

217230.description: The motorcycle shop owner who lets Koguma get her Super Cub for cheap.

name.native: ダンカ・ニール・メープル

219083.description: He is an elf warrior from the Great Canada Forest.

220378.description: The child of Ares, the god of war, and Otrera, a priestess of Artemis. She was the Queen of the Amazons, who was slain by Heracles on his quest to steal her sash. She was also the older sister of Penthesilea and many other amazons.

220769.description: She's the second princess of Roden.

220792.description: He's the assistant who assassinated the second prince [Dakares](https://anilist.co/character/220767/Roden-Ollavu-Dakares-Shishie-Kallen)

220916.description: He's one of the six ninja's. He has inherited the name 'Sasuke'. Despite not being blood-related he's like a brother to [Chiyome](https://anilist.co/character/194356/Chiyome).

221413.description: The daughter of Marelle and helps her run the inn.

221474.description: Daughter of a restaurant owner. After seeing Youhei punch another beastfallen for not paying, she tried using him to chase away other beastfallen. It is revealed right after that that her mother was eaten alive by a starving beastfallen.

221476.description: Nanako and Hiro's father. He is often paranoid about his daughter's wellbeing.

221839.description:
Philia is an Einzbern homunculus involved in the False Holy Grail War of Fate/strange fake. 

~!As of the summoning of True Berserker, her body has been possessed by the goddess Ishtar.!~

(Source: TYPE-MOON wiki)

223321.description:
__Ability__: Cannon
~!To create illusions to fool others!~

She is the observer in the program.

223322.description:
__Ability__: Copying 1/10th of the other person's ability.

She is a third year high schooler.

223323.description:
__Ability__: To turn a stick into a sword that can slice through anything.

He is a third year high schooler.

223871.description:
Frill Shiranui is a student in Ruby Hoshino's class. She is a multi-talented performer who can sing, dance, and act. At first, Ruby is in awe of her, yet they eventually become friends. 

 ~!She is the younger sister of [Koromo Shiranui](https://anilist.co/character/212391/Koromo-Shiranui) from [Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Tensaitachi no Renai Zunousen](https://anilist.co/manga/86635/Kaguyasama-wa-Kokurasetai-Tensaitachi-no-Renai-Zunousen/).!~

224357.description:
__Height__ 171cm

Was Minato's junior high water polo teammate, and is now currently the ace of Shogakunan High School Water Polo Team.

224520.description: An energetic, sprightly, incredibly strong girl. Has more power than she knows what to do with. Boxxo's partner.

224521.description: A former vending machine maniac. All movement depends on Lammis, who carries him. He can sell any product he bought in his past life.

225558.description:
The leader of the touring boxing group. He used to be a challenger for the Japanese featherweight title. He later became the only person who understands Joe within the touring boxing group. 

He urged Joe to go back to Danpei and his friends and to try to get back into the boxing world. He convinces Joe who then leaves the match that they are having. The people watching the match then gets really angry but inaba and the other boxers start fighting them and they make them say ''Banzai!'' to Joe before he leaves.

227073.description:
__Type:__ America
__Occupation:__ Japanese Language Teacher
__Debut:__ Chapter 57

**Girlfriend No. 013**

Nadeshiko has a very freedom loving and stereotypically American personality due to her fascination with the United States, this was due to her finding and watching a VHS tape of a group of American Children acting in contrary to her family's strict traditional Japanese customs. She does not seem to be able to speak English despite her love of America.

name.native: レギーナ・メルセデス
ブラッカス・シャドウプリンス
シャーリ・シャドウアサシン
レオニス・デス・マグナス

228799.description: The reincarnated Undead King and strongest Dark Lord.

name.native: エルフィーネ・フィレット
リーセリア・レイ・クリスタリア

228895.description:
The king of Arkite Kingdom, and another player character, just like Dunbulf, who he trusts a ton.

When in front of his subjects, Solomon acts as a dignified leader, but he's actually a pretty friendly person, cares about his kingdom and is generally spending his time handling geopolitical conflicts and dealing with monsters.

228896.description: One of the Nine Wise Men of Arkite, and is also a player character who is old friends with Dunbalf and Solomon. She's a super powerful sorcerer who's scored the nickname 'Luminaria the Calamity,' though she's pretty casual and touchy-feely when around Mira.

228898.description: Meyrin is one of the Nine Wise Men who, like Mira, has moved to the world of Ark Earth Online. She is the Wise Man of the Tower of Daoism.

228901.description: A girl from the fairy tribe who serves as Mira's aide.

228902.description: The eldest of the seven Valkyrie sisters that Mira can summon.

228903.description: A maidservants working at the royal castle of the Kingdom of Arkite.

228905.description: The deputy commander of the chariot corps of the Kingdom of Arkite.

228906.description: A boy with adventurer parents, who joins Mira on a dungeon mission.

228908.description: The leader of the Ekalrath Carillon.

228909.description: A cat fairy. He calls Mira "Commander" and is also called "Member #1" by Mira.

228910.description: The youngest of the seven Valkyrie sisters that Mira can summon.

228911.description: The vice leader of the famous adventurer's guild, Ekalrath Carillon led by Sero.

228912.description: A mage and member of the Ekalrath Carillon led by Sero.

229665.description: The second daughter of the Amagami household.

229666.description: The first daughter of the Amagami household.

229667.description: The third daughter of the Amagami household.

229668.description: Hard at work studying to become a doctor whilst living at the Amagami Shrine. The current chief priest wants him to marry one of the shrine maidens and become heir to the Amagami Shrine.

229727.description: Seiroku Inukawa is a mysterious Bushi and a member of the Obsidian Eight.

name.native: ヴェレナ・ステラリア

232347.description:
Fena, the protagonist, is a princess who has escaped from Shangri-La and the British Empire. She recruits a group of samurai and ninjas known as the Seven Samurai to help her on her journey and becomes their captain. She is known for her pale skin and platinum hair, hence her nickname White Marginal.

She has a cheerful and optimistic personality despite her traumatic past. She will later show her courage and leadership by recruiting [Yukimaru](https://anilist.co/character/232355/Sanada-Yukimaru) and his group of samurai ninjas to join and help Fena in her quest. She is kind and caring and often worries about the safety of others.

Fena can have a wry but shy personality, as well as seriousness, grit, and compassion for her friends and comrades during their journey. Her impetuous nature often leads her to act irrationally and regret it later. She is very persistent. She brightens the lives of all those around her as they grow closer.
