Naturally clumsy and less graceful than her shipmates, she tries to be a useful member of the crew. She tries to learn at least one weapon to be useful. She can become unusually quiet when she remembers something from her past, which worries the others.

232348.description:
Shitan is one of the seven samurai who help and join Fena in his quest.

He is portrayed as aloof, but easygoing, with a strong feeling for his friends. Shitan also shows loyalty and devotion to his companions when he joins Fena's crew with his comrades.

He initially decides to abandon Fena and her friends before being persuaded to betray them and help rescue her. He is more loyal to his friends than to his sense of nationalism as a descendant of the Japanese expedition that sought the Kusanagi sword.

232351.description: Kaede's elder twin. They both use a spear and wakizashi in battle, they're both friendly and mischievous, but Enju feels he's more dependable than his younger brother.

232353.description: This mountain of a boy prefers fighting in close quarters with brass knuckles. When he's not fighting, he's kind-hearted and mild-mannered.

232354.description: An older knight who was once called "Salman the Onslaught" for being so deadly with a spear. He's known Fena since she was a girl as he served the Houtman family for some time.

232355.description:
Yukimaru is the leader of the Seven Samurai who helps and joins Fena in his quest. 

Yukimaru is an introverted and stoic individual. He is extremely protective of Fena Houtman, whom he has known since childhood. He also shows leadership towards his fellow samurai ninjas when they are together, even during combat.

Although he has never been seen to smile before, his ears blush when teased about his apparent feelings for Fena. Although he feels that her protection is paramount, he is not afraid of death to protect her.

232356.description: Raised by a family of blacksmiths, Karin geeks out over technology like her rifle, which she uses to great effect in battle.

232357.description: Enju's younger twin. They both use a spear and wakizashi in battle, they're both friendly and mischievous, but Kaede feels he's more manly than his elder brother.

232360.description: An older knight who served the Houtman family and possessed an intimidating nickname in his younger days—"Otto the Blitz" for his quick swordplay.

232361.description: The oldest and most mature member of the group, he manages everyone's wild energy. He's also the cook, but when he fights, he uses a short ninja sword.

232926.description:
Lakan is a renowned strategist known for his nonchalant disregard of proper manners. His plotting ability causes fear even in the Emperor himself. He sees people's faces as a piece of shogi representing their worth, with a few exceptions like the woman he loved and his daughter. Currently heads the La clan.

~!He is [Maomao](https://anilist.co/character/126824/Maomao)'s biological father and the nephew of [Luomen](https://anilist.co/character/261968/Ruomen)!~

233970.description:
__Height:__ 183 cm

Yoi Takiguchi's senpai. The male prince of the school.

235135.description: One of the Nine Wise Men who, like Mira, has moved to the world of Arc Earth Online. He is the Wise Man of the Tower of Necromancy.

237249.description:
**Height:** 170 cm

Mitsuru is an average student who admires Masahiro Setagawa and says that he should not be pushed around by Kousuke Ohshiba. It was stated that he wanted to be closer to him and wanted him to talk about problems with him. He wants to take care of someone and be taken care of.

237250.description:
Jirou joins the friend group when it is discovered he is tagging along after Masahiro without him knowing. He hangs out with the group of friends and comes for dinner served at the Ohshiba home often.

Later, he is the last student at school while Masahiro and Kousuke are together and think they are alone. He believes the two are fighting and hides in a broom closet, only to see them kiss. This results in Jirou revealing their secret love affair to the other guys, and drama ensuing between Masahiro and Fukushige.

237251.description: Ayaka Houjou is the wife of Tsunehito Houjou and the older sister of Asaya Hasekura.

237252.description: Natsuo is a bartender. While he always keeps an emotionless face, he has shown kindness towards his customers. He doesn't sugar coat anything and is always seen as emotionless.

237253.description: Tsuyoshi is sweet and nice. Nothing is very special about him, he acts like your regular guy and has a preference of female partners, though other relationships seem to not bother him.

237254.description: Tsunehito is married to Ayaka Houjou. Tsunehito has a happy and carefree personality who cares deeply about his friends and he interrogated Masahiro Setagawa about his relationship. Unlike him, Tsunehito thinks his wife is scary. He has a strange underwear fetish and he makes Ayaka think he is a pervert and a player. He is a detective.

237464.description: Mona, in her own words, has got the looks, the personality and is the "complete package". She is like the queen bee of the school and is idolised by the entire student body - except for Medaka who is totally indifferent towards her. This annoys her and she decides to make Medaka fall for her through her charms.

237558.description: Saria is a level 700 beast-kin gorilla but after evolving with the help of the Fruit of evolution she becomes a woman, and from then can change back to her human form or the gorilla form easily, with also partial transformation.

240542.description:
__Type:__ Eco-Friendly Giantess
**Occupation:** First-Year High School Student
**Debut:** Chapter 64

**Girlfriend No. 014**

Yamame is a very kind and gentle girl who speaks like she is from the country. She is self-conscious about her height, but is proud that she can protect others with it. She is afraid of fire due to its destructive nature. When working in the fields, she often wears stilts to avoid crushing the crops. In addition to the stilts, she wears an apron, a backpack, and keeps her tie in her breast pocket.

241563.description:
Hana is Shuu's classmate from elementary school who moved out from the town. After coming back to the town for high school, she falls in love with him.

~!After confessing her feelings to him publicly, Shuu accepts her feelings, but decides to put a status quo on their relationship since he wants to focus on the election, though they end up properly dating. She helps him a lot by managing his campaign speeches and schedule.!~

241577.description:
Gen Narumi is the Captain of the First Division of the Defense Force. He is known to be Japan's strongest anti-kaiju combatant, hence his position.

Gen has a rather lazy and child-like personality, obsessing over followers on social media and video games as well as his action figures. He appears informal and rude when confronting other people. Despite this, he is serious about his work, valuing skills above all else, and demanding results from all those serving in his division.

name.native: ブラッド・ブラックストーン

241788.description: A highly skilled combatant whose motives are unclear. He's an old acquaintance of Izzy and a defector from both U.S. and the Kingdom. He also possesses a Void Maker Power Crest.

242553.description:
The male protagonist of the show, Kuroiwa is a monk-in-training that enlisted to a Tokyo public school in an attempt to "steel his heart" and get himself rid of all worldly desires, in line with his religion. This attempt is later conflicted by Kawai Mona, however, as she continually shows him affection in order to make him fall for her.

Typically stoic, he ripostes to Mona's usual charms with a cold scowl, not to give in to desire, but his struggles and true emotions are often revealed as he blushes and reacts love-struck away from Mona's view.

Because of his time as a monk, he gets easily excited from things others around him might consider normal, such as a school festival or a concert, often staying around and losing focus when he admires such activities.

243465.description: He is Cayna's third child and youngest son, who was placed into public service through the Foster System

243466.description: Mai-Mai is Cayna's second child and eldest daughter, who was placed into public service through the Foster System.

243467.description: Skargo is Cayna's eldest son, who was placed into public service through the Foster System.

243478.description: Asumi is Minato's little sister. They fight and bicker like most siblings but she is haunted with the memories that Minato lacks of the night that changed their family forever.

243828.description: A third-year student at Tokyo Jujutsu High who is currently suspended for clashing with authority. While away from the school, Kirara has partnered with [Kinji](https://anilist.co/character/197584) while running his fight club. Their cursed technique is Interstellar Flight (Love Rendezvous), a complex technique whose motif is based on the Southern Cross constellation.

244319.description: Meimei is one of the Three Princesses of Verdigris Hall. She started as Fenshen's apprentice and, being somewhat cunning herself, inherited Fenshen's taste for strategy board games. She is the most attached to the brothel and the people within.

name.native: アベル・ブルーフィールド

244369.description: A mysterious lord who is after Fena for his own reasons and searches for her on his ship called the Blue Giant. One of them is that he fell in love with Fena's late mother Helena and knows what her family can do. He allies with the Rumble Rose to find Fena which lasts until O'Malley retaliates upon not getting the reward she was promised. Before the Rumble Rose can attack, Abel orders his men to use the Blue Giant's Wellington Cannon on their ship which was meant to be used to deal with a siege. Abel is shown to be a good marksman as seen when he shot Yukimaru with his tri-barrel gun. When in Eden, Abel engaged Yukimaru who sliced off Abel's right arm. Before dying from bleeding out, Abel managed to wound Yukimaru with his sword. Helena's spirit appeared to take Abel to the afterlife upon him fulfilling his vow.

244658.description: Housemother and live-in doctor at the Residential Child Care Facility Kiseki-en

244995.description: The (new) Pure consort, residing in the Garnet Palace within the inner court. She makes a big show of her exorbitant and ever changing clothing, jewellery and make up. Despite that, she doesn't talk any more than she needs to, keeping her distance.

245519.description: Taishi Gotanda is a movie director, and the "mentor" of [Aquamarine Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183885/Aquamarine-Hoshino). He still lives with his [mother](https://anilist.co/character/302910).

245534.description: [Uka's](https://anilist.co/character/182176/Uka-Ishimori) first friend with a cheerful and friendly personality. She has had a crush on [Satoru](https://anilist.co/character/245535/Satoru-Seto) since kindergarten.

245535.description: [Kai's](https://anilist.co/character/162041/Kai-Miura) friend and a mood maker. He is close childhood friends with [Ayumi](https://anilist.co/character/245534/Ayumi-Endou) and is oblivious to romance.

245536.description: [Kai's](https://anilist.co/character/162041/Kai-Miura) friend. He is always smiling, but has a mysterious side where no one knows what he is thinking.

245537.description: [Kai's](https://anilist.co/character/162041/Kai-Miura) ex-girlfriend. She became famous starting from the entrance ceremony, with an amazing physique everyone wants.

245664.description: Vivi is the spirit of the lake in the middle of the woods that Reiji, Noela, and Mina visit.

246503.description: A high school sophomore aspiring to become a flower accessory creator. His dream of owning his own store leads him and Himari to share a common destiny.

248024.description: A female captain who leads the pirate group "Rumble Rose". A beautiful woman with good looks, she is strong-willed, competitive, and proud. At the request of a certain person, she is targets Fena.

248079.description:
A High Elf and Shin's first support character, Schnee is an NPC from the Game Era. Currently, she is the acting manager of the Moon Shrine.

Created by Shin early in the game, Schnee was modeled by combining Shin's preferences. Due to her association with High Humans, she was revered by the inhabitants of the world.

248143.description: Hajime Kashimo is a sorcerer from 400 years ago, currently inhabiting the body of someone Kenjaku prepared as a vessel, and has served as a player in the Culling Game, seeking to find and consequently battle Sukuna

248818.description: A defense lawyer who deems the Japanese justice system as unfair. After losing another case, he realizes his client was going to be ruled guilty from the beginning. With these negative emotions, he awakened his cursed power in the courtroom demanding a retrial. He is currently the top player of the Culling Game.

name.native: シャーロッテ・ベリー

248919.description:
A female pirate belonging to the Rumble Rose. She uses a rapier and a crescent moon sword, and despite her cute appearance, she has a black heart. She adores [O'Malley](https://anilist.co/character/248024) more than any other member of the crew.

(Source: Official Site)

248920.description:
A female pirate belonging to the Rumble Rose. Although she is quite small, she is a highly skilled sniper. She wears an eye patch because she admires O'Malley.

(Source: Official site, translated)

248922.description:
A female pirate belonging to the Rumble Rose. She is the mood maker and trouble maker of the crew. She is good at physical training and has a cheerful and optimistic personality, but her temper becomes fierce during battle.

(Official site, translated)

248925.description:
A female pirate belonging to the Rumble Rose. She is always calm and is considered to be O'Malley's right-hand woman as well as her chief strategist. She is good at physical attacks and has a large sword wound in her left eye.

(Source: Official site, translated)

249141.description: Lan was a male individual of a multi-torsoed species and drummer for the band Star Waver. Lan played the versatile cluster drums. Lan was a male individual of a multi-torsoed species and drummer for the band Star Waver. Lan played the versatile cluster drums.

249154.description: Kara Lah was a Force-sensitive human female who was the daughter of the legendary sabersmith Zhima Lah.

249156.description: Zhima Lah was a Force-sensitive human sabersmith who was the father of the Ninth Jedi Kara Lah. When Margrave Juro attempted to revive the long-gone Jedi Order, Zhima was tasked with forging several lightsabers.

249157.description: Margrave Juro was a human male Jedi who ruled the Outer Rim Territories planet Hy Izlan.

249191.description: Mofu Usaki is world-renowned neurosurgeon who does surgeries on a microscopic scale and undertakes at least 800 surgeries a year. She also stars in the liveshow "Lie or Truth? ESP!!"

249192.description: Amamiya is the leader of the First Investigative Division of the Metropolitan Police Department and Totomaru Isshiki's superior.

name.native: シュピッツ・ファイア

249195.description: A police detective at the Aichi Prefectural Police and the detective with the highest number of solved cases in the entire country. Because of this, he is already considered for police superintendent general.

name.native: ウィンター・モリアーティ

249197.description: Fourth child of the M. Family.

name.native: マイロ・モリアーティ

249198.description: Current head child and first child of the M. Family.

249338.description:
Shin Karino is a mangaka and resident of Room 202. He is a neighbor of Kotaro.

~!He becomes the guardian of Kotaro later in the series.!~

249339.description:
A 4-year-old boy who moved to Room 203 of Apartment Shimizu.

He cleans, cooks, and lives alone for some reason. He imitates his favorite anime character, Tonosaman.

249375.description:
Blade is a transfer student at Rosewood Academy.

He is the great hero, a unique existence in the world, destined to defeat evil. Due to this immense burden, Blade was never able to relate to other people nor form bonds of friendship with anyone, this being the reason for his obsession with being a normal person.

name.native: アーネスト・フレイミング

249376.description: Earnest Flaming is the eldest daughter and the next head of the House of Flaming. She is also the top student of Rosewood Academy and the current wielder of the demon sword [Asmodeus](https://anilist.co/character/306086/Asmodeus).

name.native: ティエラ・ ルーセント

249623.description: Tiera Lucent is an Elf and the salesclerk of the Moon Shrine. An aspiring alchemist, she was expelled from her village at a young age when her hair turned black due to a curse.

250763.description: Kannazuki Karen one of the "heroes" along with Hiiragi Seiichi that were transferred into a different world.

252073.description: She's a classmate and friend of Ruby Hoshino. Minami is a Gravure model who uses a fake accent.

name.native: ティロリロ・リリリ・ルー

252732.description: She is an A class adventurer, due to her bad luck curse she was given the name of calamity.

254931.description:
__Type:__ Overenthusiastic Masseuse
**Occupation:** Third-Year Middle School Student
**Debut:** Chapter 69

**Girlfriend No. 015**

Momi is somewhat stoic and blunt, blatantly admitting to her love of massaging (especially women) without concern for how perverse it may sound. She loves touching things, especially things that are soft, including women and character-based mousepads. Momi is able to give massages that are so good, the receiver will pass out and lose all memories of the massage itself. This leads to a rumor circulating the school of a girl who gives amazing massages and disappears. When confronted with this rumor, she says that it is "probably her".

254932.description:
__Type:__ Old Loli
__Occupation:__ Pensioner
__Debut:__ Chapter 75

**Girlfriend No. 016**

[Kusuri](https://anilist.co/character/173763/Kusuri-Yakuzen)'s grandmother.
Yaku comes off as a calmer and more mature version of Kusuri. She tends to act rather grandmotherly towards the others and seems to enjoy the youthful antics of the younger members of the family. She also is rather coy and tends to tease Rentarou. Yaku is also easily confused by modern technology and refers to smartphones as planks. She also seems to be afraid of cars. Yaku seems to have been born in the early 20th century (though there are references that make her sound older). Yaku's interest in the making of drugs and medical treatments seem to go back to World War II where she appears to have treated Imperial Japanese soldiers. During this time she met her husband, though she coyly refuses to go into detail.

254968.description: A scout who belongs to the guild Ekalrath Carillon.

254970.description: A warrior who belongs to the guild Ekalrath Carillon.

name.native: エウリペデス・リッツラン
スカーレット・エル・ヴァンディミオン

255701.description: Eldest daughter of the Duke of Vandimion, from a young age Scarlett was known for her overly violent behavior - to the point where others called her the Mad Dog Princess. While she now normally bottles up her emotions to please her family, sometimes she still needs to let loose...

256330.description: She was a donkey before her evolution.

256940.description: A hero who hates crime, not the criminal.

257308.description:
He lives in Apartment Shimizu Room 102.

He looks scary, but he loves kids. He loves Kotarou.

257309.description:
An older sister who lives in Apartment Shimizu Room 201.

She is always cheerful and often has a tea party with Kotarou.

257340.description:
__Height:__ 190 cm

Isao Shinomiya is the Director General of the Defense Force and Kikoru Shinomiya's father.

Isao is a very authoritative and serious man, being also very demanding towards both his subordinates and his daughter. As the Director General of the Defense Force and serving many years in its ranks, Isao is a far-sighted man who gives his orders firmly in sight of future threats. Isao is not above using living kaiju as weapons to empower the Defense Force.

Despite is apparent cold and serious behavior, Isao shows a more human side when he remembered Kikoru's words about Kafka Hibino and when he personally informed the latter about his decision towards him, going against his high-ranked colleagues to give Kafka a chance to prove himself to them.

258200.description: A former office worker who was forcefully summoned to another world and gained the Class of "Tamer" and "Sage".

258618.description:
Oliver attends Kimberly Magic Academy to better refine his vast skills. Upon arriving, he meets the likes of [Nanao](https://anilist.co/character/258620/Nanao-Hibiya), [Chela](https://anilist.co/character/258624/Michela-McFarlane), [Katie](https://anilist.co/character/258626/Katie-Aalto), [Guy](https://anilist.co/character/258621/Guy-Greenwood), and [Pete](https://anilist.co/character/258623/Pete-Reston), their tight-knit bond eventually leading to the formation of the Sword Roses alliance.

Oliver is a gentle, rational, thoughtful and caring boy. Although less outwardly emotional than others, he’s intelligent, brave and cares for his friends. Oliver generally takes every situation calmly but can quickly lose his temper when someone he's close to is harmed.

~!In reality, his goal in attending Kimberly is to systematically eliminate every Kimberly instructor involved in the torture and murder of his mother, [Chloe Halford](https://anilist.co/character/341944/Chloe-Halford). To achieve this, he uses the powerful Fourth Spellblade Chloe originally possessed.!~

258620.description: Hailing from Tourikueisen in the distant country of Yamatsukuni, Nanao is a samurai girl who was offered a second chance at life by Theodore McFarlane. She attends Kimberly at his behest and finds a new purpose in life in crossing blades with [Oliver Horn](https://anilist.co/character/258618/Oliver-Horn). She is a noble and cheerful person who holds honor in high regards, and a good fight even moreso.

258621.description:
A friend of [Oliver](https://anilist.co/character/258618/Oliver-Horn)'s and a member of the Sword Roses. Guy is cheerful and friendly, with a frank and pleasant personality and great thoughtfulness and concern towards his friends. He's unusually talented with the use of magical flora.

~!Guy later awakens as a curse user and has to temporarily leave the Sword Roses until he is able to control his powers, which upsets his friends, particularly [Katie](https://anilist.co/character/258626/Katie-Aalto).!~

258623.description:
A friend of [Oliver](https://anilist.co/character/258618/Oliver-Horn)'s and a member of the Sword Roses. Pete is a mage born into a nonmagical family that enters Kimberly after scoring well on their difficult entrance exam. he forms a strong bond with the Sword Roses, who support him in his learning about the magical world and becoming stronger in it.

~!It is later revealed that Pete is reversi. This means that his body can change sex.!~

name.native: ミシェーラ＝マクファーレン

258624.description: A friend of [Oliver](https://anilist.co/character/258618/Oliver-Horn)'s and a member of the Sword Roses. Chela is a proud young lady and the eldest daughter of the noble house of McFarlane, one of the five oldest families in Yelgland, and among the elite in the Magical World. She is an incredibly skilled mage, and often serves as the Sword Roses' voice of reason alongside Oliver as the two most mature members of the group.

name.native: オフィーリア＝サルヴァドーリ

258625.description:
An upperclassman at Kimberly Magic Academy. Ophelia is a mysterious witch from a family of succubi who lives in the depths of the academy's labyrinth. She was once a normal student who, after enduring distressing events, left the academy to perfect her magical arts in the labyrinth. She is on the verge of being consumed by the spell and creates chimeras to kidnap new students.

~!As a child, Ophelia suffered from unwanted advances as a result of her succubus trait of "Perfume". She grew up distrusting of people before meeting [Carlos](https://anilist.co/character/304175/Carlos-Whitrow), who was unaffected by her Perfume due to their nature as a Castrato. Later she meets [Godfrey](https://anilist.co/character/267388/Alvin-Godfrey), who was affected by her Perfume but constantly cast spells to hurt himself when this happened, eventually training his body to overcome the effect. This effort caused Ophelia to open up and fall in love for the first time, though she never told Godfrey about her feelings.!~

258626.description: A friend of [Oliver](https://anilist.co/character/258618/Oliver-Horn)'s and a member of the Sword Roses. Katie has very strong ideals compared to the typical mage, desiring to reform magical society's treatment of demi-humans. She appears to have a crush on Oliver and in contrast often finds herself at odds with [Guy](https://anilist.co/character/258621/Guy-Greenwood), although they remain close friends and seem to have a slight cooking rivalry amongst themselves.

258659.description: The Surrogate Wiseman of the Necromancy Tower.

259237.description: Aoshi Sanada is a member of the Takeda Bushi and it's Blue Sword of the First Company.

259238.description: Shunrai Yamamoto is a member of the Takeda Bushi and the vice captain of it's Green Sword Special Company.

alternative: シュバルツ・フォン・リヒテンシュタイン・ローエングラム

259598.description:
The main antagonist in the manga Kaiju No. 8. Kaiju No. 9 is a humanoid numbered Daikaiju who goes around reviving the kaiju killed by the Defense Force. He previously infiltrated Professional Kaiju Cleaning Company Monster Sweeper.

~! In his fused form with an Ant-type kaiju, No. 9 has the lower part of his body replaced by an Ant kaiju which he controls and uses to move around. In this form, No. 9 lacks forearms and hands. !~ ~! After fusing with Kaiju No. 2, No. 9 is now much larger than before, keeping his darker skin tone, with a long tail, three sets of eyes, and only protuberance on his head instead of two. !~

261259.description:
__Height:__ 183cm

A young Faunus from Vacuo with a monkey tail. He jokes a lot and doesn’t take too much seriously. Sun was a stowaway and a thief which was made easier by his light and agile abilities. On the other hand, he is compassionate and quickly bonds with Blake when cooperating with her.

261439.description:
__Height:__ 189 cm

He Xuan is a ghost of Supreme rank and one of the Four Great Calamities. He bears the title Black Water Submerging Boats and his domain is the Black Water Demon Lair.

261968.description: Ruomen is a physician of the Inner Court, a physician in the red-light district, and Maomao's father.

name.native: イビン・グレニス・メープル

261990.description: She is the older sister of [Ariane](https://anilist.co/character/194353/Glenys-Maple-Ariane) and is considered one of the finest swordsmen in all of Canada Forest.

261997.description:
He is the Pontiff of Holy Hilk Kingdom, and the mastermind behind the suppression and eradication of the Elves and Beastmen, along with destruction of many Kingdoms.
~!
He is actually a Wanderer just like Arc who had arrived in the Other World over 100 years ago, and believes that the World he is in now is a "PACC" based virtual world.!~

name.native: セリアーナ・メリア・ドゥ・オーラヴ・ティシエント

261998.description: She is the Eldest Daughter of the King of Rhoden Kingdom, Karlon Delfriet Rhoden Olav and the Queen, and the older sister of Yuriarna Merol Melissa Rhoden Olav. She is married to Duke Ticient in the Grand Duchy of Limbult.

262662.description: An old doctor from Zari-Bars village.

262765.description: The Surrogate Wiseman of the Tower of Summoning.

263685.description: An employee of the accounting departmenf of Tsuda sweets. He's methodical, industrious, and a bit of a pushover. He loves Mitsuya way too much.

263686.description: A coworker who started working at the same time as Tateishi. She works in the planning department. She has an unyielding spirit and a sharp tongue... at least it seems that way, but in truth she loves Tateishi way too much.

263823.description: Considered one of the school's most beautiful girls, Shirakawa is easygoing and friendly with most people, earning her even more popularity. Since she is so popular, bad rumors tend to go about her, like how she dates guys for two or three months at best, and how easily she switches from guy to guy at the drop of a hat. All those rumors are false though. Despite her gal appearance, Shirakawa is sincerely devoted to whoever she is dating (to the point of being called "Heavy" or "Annoying"). She reaches the point of putting her boyfriend's happiness first or enduring a lot to keep the relationship going. This ends up backfiring as guys dump her once they "get what they wanted." She is called the school year’s number one most beautiful girl. Although being called that, she has fake rumors that she only stayed with one person for three months at most, and the taste of people she was dating varied from older to the same age, and from athletic to cultural, resulting in boys calling her a "bitch".

263824.description: Kashima has admired Shirakawa since the first year and got the lucky break of moving to the same class as her during the second year, turning simple admiration into a one-sided crush. Kashima never hoped to get more than that and was happy with keeping the status quo.

264023.description:
__Relatives:__ [Shinta](https://anilist.co/character/264106/Shinta-Arakawa) (Father), [Masaki](https://anilist.co/character/264105/Masaki-Ousaki) (Mother), [Arakawa Shiguma](https://anilist.co/character/264107/Arakawa-Shiguma) (Rakugo Master)
__Affiliation:__ Arakawa School
__Occupation:__ Rakugoka (Zenza)
__Height:__ 158cm (5'2")

She is the protagonist of Akane-Banashi series. She is an apprentice of [Shiguma Arakawa](https://anilist.co/character/264107/Shiguma-Arakawa).

She is usually unconcerned about her studies preferring to use that time to improve her skills, she is determined to achieve her goals. It has been shown that she is very kind to the people around her, taking affection for them despite only having known them for a short time.

~!She is later given Futatsume Recommendation by [Arakawa Taizen](https://anilist.co/character/371794/Arakawa-Taizen) and is promoted to Futatsume soon after.!~

264106.description:
__Relatives:__ [Masaki](https://anilist.co/character/264105/Masaki-Ousaki) (Wife), [Akane Osaki](https://anilist.co/character/264023/Akane-Ousaki) (Daughter)
__Affiliation:__ Arakawa School (Former) 
__Occupation:__ Rakugoka (Futatsume) (Former)

He is [Akane Osaki's](https://anilist.co/character/264023/Akane-Ousaki)  father and [Masaki's](https://anilist.co/character/264105/Masaki-Ousaki)  husband. He was [Shiguma Arakawa's](https://anilist.co/character/264107/Shiguma-Arakawa) pupil.

~!He met [Shiguma](https://anilist.co/character/264107/Shiguma-Arakawa) 13 years ago (currently 19 years) since then he has been practicing and studying the basics of rakugo, he practiced for years until reaching Futatsume rank. During his exam to be promoted to Shin'uchi he was expelled by [Issho Arakawa](https://anilist.co/character/278459/Isshou-Arakawa) , after that he got a job selling cement.!~

264107.description:
__Relatives:__ [Shinta Arakawa](https://anilist.co/character/264106/Shinta-Arakawa)  (Pupil) (Former), [Kyoji Arakawa](https://anilist.co/character/280941/Kyoji-Arakawa)  (Pupil), [Maikeru Arakawa](https://anilist.co/character/280942/Maikeru-Arakawa) (Pupil), [Koguma Arakawa](https://anilist.co/character/280944/Koguma-Arakawa) (Pupil), [Guriko Arakawa](https://anilist.co/character/279367/Guriko-Arakawa)  (Pupil), [Akane Osaki](https://anilist.co/character/264023/Akane-Ousaki)  (Pupil)
__Affiliation:__ Arakawa School
__Occupation:__ Rakugoka (Shin'nuchi)

He was Shinta Arakawa's Master. He is one of four Shin'nuchi rank in the Arakawa School. He currently is the master of 5 pupils: [Kyoji Arakawa](https://anilist.co/character/280941/Kyoji-Arakawa), [Maikeru Arakawa](https://anilist.co/character/280942/Maikeru-Arakawa), [Koguma Arakawa](https://anilist.co/character/280944/Koguma-Arakawa), [Guriko Arakawa](https://anilist.co/character/279367/Guriko-Arakawa) and [Akane Osaki](https://anilist.co/character/264023/Akane-Ousaki).

He is a serious person with his work, he is usually very kind to people and very strict with his students, despite that he has great affection for them.

266529.description:
__Type:__ Knight / Spoiled Baby
__Occupation:__ Third-Year High School Student, Kendo Club Captain
__Debut:__ Chapter 81

**Girlfriend No. 017**

On the surface Kishika is polite but highly discipline person speaking and carrying herself like a knight. She tends to strict on herself and others and seems to be an addition straightman in the Rentarou family. This all conceals the real Kishika that wants to be spoiled and even outright babied, especially by [Rentarou](https://anilist.co/character/173758/Aijou-Rentarou) and [Hahari](https://anilist.co/character/173812/Hanazono-Hahari). After she indulges in her desire to be babied she usually is embarrassed to the point of begging for death.

266759.description: Kuusetsu is one of the Eight Thunder Gods, consisting of the so-called Gods who rule over the Shuuki.

266870.description: A lawyer who takes on the job of delivering money weekly to Kotarou.

267548.description:
First year at Shinju High School, Miku's childhood friend and one player of "Aishiteru Game" (I love you).
He has romantic feelings towards Miku.

267549.description:
First year at Shinju High School, Yukiya's childhood friend and one player of "Aishiteru Game" (I love you).
She has romantic feelings towards Yukiya.

268031.description: An upperclassman and a friend of [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/208618/Saku-Chitose)'s. Asuka is looked up to by Saku greatly, with the two often meeting at a park near Fuji High. She's mature and often gives Saku advice, but has a mischievous side to herself as well.

268032.description:
A shut-in boy that hasn't attended school for months on end. Kenta is bitter and depressed, locking himself away in his room, with [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/208618) being chosen by his teacher to bring him back to class by any reasonable means necessary.

~!After reinventing himself with Saku's help, Kenta joins Saku's friend group and becomes good friends with everyone in Team Chitose.!~

268033.description: A boy in [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/208618/Saku-Chitose)'s friend group. Like Saku, Kazuki is highly athletic and a popular student at Fuji High, being an excellent soccer player. He's laid-back and casual with his friends in Team Chitose, but unlike Saku he maintains a more no-nonsense mindset.

268034.description: A girl attending Fuji High School. Nazuna is a former basketball player that used to look up to [Yuzuki Nanase](https://anilist.co/character/208619/Yuzuki-Nanase) before entering high school. She's friends with [Atomu Uemura](https://anilist.co/character/268036/Atomu-Uemura) and has known him since middle school.

268035.description: [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/208618/Saku-Chitose)'s casual and carefree homeroom teacher. He makes note of Saku's talents and, using Saku's class president role as an excuse, occasionally has him solve issues for him. Despite his roughness he's very attentive to the issues of his students.

name.native: クロード・ジャンヌ・エルメイア

268053.description: The demon king and oldest prince of Imperial Ellmeyer. The source of Aileen's death flags.

name.native: リーゼロッテ・リーフェンシュタール

268329.description: The daughter of a marquis. In the game Love Me Magically! (Magikoi), her inability to express herself dooms her to a fate of ruin.

name.native: バルドゥール・リーフェンシュタール
ジークヴァルト・フィッツェンハーゲン

268333.description: Liselotte's fiancée and the main character in "Magikoi". He is the crown prince of the Fitzenhagen Kingdom and the student body president of the Magic Academy, a true "prince". He takes the suddenly heard live commentary of the game as guidance from Lilena, the goddess of light, and worships it as the voice of God.

268340.description:
__Height:__ 198cm

The headmaster of Beacon Academy, he scouted Ruby and permitted her to enroll at Beacon based on her talents. He is typically both stoic and affable towards studnets, and fosters trust from those he speaks to. However, while he seems to have the best intentions, there are hints he's hiding things.

268373.description: He is an ordinary high school boy who can be found anywhere. One day, however, he suddenly finds himself caught in a love storm with five transfer students.

268374.description: Bai has a calm and easy-going personality. To her students, she is more like an older sister than a teacher. She is a strong person at school, but when she goes home, she can be a bit childish and a bit of a screw-up. She also has a clumsy side. She is a teacher from China.

name.native: イリヤ・イリューヒン

268375.description:
Ilya Ilyukhin is a transfer student from Bulgaria (Russia in the manga from chapter 2 onwards).

In anime episode 4/manga chapter 8: ~!her true gender is revealed as female when she undresses at a ryokan.!~

268376.description: Aoi is a cheerful and honest yet reticent girl with a knack for household work. She is also a bright, energetic and straightforward girl who transferred to the Asahi's class. Being a modest person, she is the leader of the class. She is also a jealous type.

name.native: アメリア・アーヴィング

268377.description: Amelia is an innocent, but also clumsy and selfish girl. She expresses her affection directly and tends to go out of control. She has a personality that makes it difficult for her to speak her mind, making her a "tsundere". She is a transfer student from the United States.

268378.description: Karin is sometimes self-conscious, but she has a cheerful personality and is well-liked by everyone around her. She is also active as a model and is gaining popularity in Japan. She is a transfer student from Germany.

268561.description: An heir of the Shimazu Bushi, which is part of the Uesugi Alliance.

269682.description: Misha Academy student council president. The final boss of Regalia of Saints, Demons and Maidens 2.

269687.description: A demon who idolizes Claude and has pledged to obey him.

name.native: キース・エイグリッド

269689.description: Claude's childhood friend and human attendant.

270360.description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4’11’’)
__Occupation:__ Accountant
__Affiliation:__ Uesegi Bushi

He is a senior vassal in charge of the Uesugi Bushi. He likes to have "people, things, and money in their proper places," and is usually busy with a lot of paperwork. His small stature and dull appearance at first glance do not suggest that he is a samurai, but he is well-liked by his subordinates and trusted by his master, Tatsuomi. In fact, he has been divorced by his wife seven times.

name.native: キャロル・ナスターシャ

270431.description: She is Rinslet's personal maid who is be a bit clumsy at times.

270703.description: Hana is an anthropomorphized anatomical model that resides with Ayase and Seiko.

270704.description: Taro is an anthropomorphized anatomical model that resides at Ayase's and Takakura's school.

alternative: Dover Demon (ドーバーデーモン)

270705.description: Peeny-Weeny, also known as the Dover Demon, is a Dover Demon's Race, he works for the Serpo in order to earn money for [his son's](https://anilist.co/character/270706/) blood transfusion.

270706.description: The son of the [Dover Demon](https://anilist.co/character/270705/Penny-Chinkosu), also known as the Mantisian. He needed to ingest new blood every day, but his life was saved thanks to [Seiko](https://anilist.co/character/234824/Seiko-Ayase) and crew giving them a cow. Currently lives on Earth with his father.

270810.description:
__Daemons:__ [Kai](https://anilist.co/character/398964/), [Inyou](https://anilist.co/character/397635/) (Ohagi and Daifuku)
__Affiliation:__ Kagemori Family

The younger of the twins. A tall, masculine girl who embodies the Day. Although she displays a very tough character and a readiness for violence in critical situations, she is also a reliable friend to [Jin](https://anilist.co/character/321814/) and [Gabby](https://anilist.co/character/321813/), and has a pronounced brother complex towards [Yuru](https://anilist.co/character/270811/) due to their long separation. She actually left the village at a young age with her parents, and a ["False Asa"](https://anilist.co/character/270809/) with a more idealized personality and the ability to regenerate lived in the settlement in her place.

270811.description:
__Daemons:__ Sayuu-sama ([Hidari](https://anilist.co/character/287182/) and [Migi](https://anilist.co/character/324638/))~!Later, Zashiki-Warashi ([Danji](https://anilist.co/character/395406/) and [Kiri](https://anilist.co/character/270809/))!~

The elder twin. A blond-haired boy who embodies the Night. Rescued from the village by [Dera](https://anilist.co/character/334313/) and [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/334316/) during the massacre, his primary goal is to find [his younger sister](https://anilist.co/character/270810/), parents [Mine](https://anilist.co/character/395408/) and [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/395409/), and uncover the cause of the conflict unfolding around them. Including finding out why his sister's comrades killed adults in his village and taking revenge on them. As someone who has spent his entire life in a village preserving the Edo-period way of life, Yuru acts like a traveler from the past, unprepared for modern life, yet quickly navigating complex situations thanks to his advanced hunting skills.

272276.description: He is the brother of Homi Moegi.

273560.description: A mermaid who was trapped by a strange magical portal in an underwater vein near the village where Cayna was reborn in Leadale. Cayna ends up rescuing her and offering her quarters in the village.

name.native: ロンティ・アバレスト

273561.description: Felskeilo's prime minister's granddaughter, a shy marquess, a first-year student at the Royal Academy of Felskeilo.

274186.description: Xiaolan is a servant in the inner court of the palace. Carefree and easy to please, she looks at her sale to the inner palace as a good thing, since at least she now has proper bedding and meals. She loves gossiping and constantly serves as a source of possibilities for Maomao to brainstorm over.

274189.description: Pairin is the oldest of the Three Princesses of Verdigris Hall. She loves men's bodies and dreams of being taken away by a muscular prince.

274194.description: Suirei is a court lady, doing menial tasks in the outer court.

276597.description:
Dedicated and hard-working, Al is a diligent farmer who always prefers farming the most above anything else. He is quite an oddball since he thinks of himself as a typical farmer; even his surrounding people notice that his skills are not just of "farmer". This farmer craze drives him to the extreme to the point where he'd rather die if he were to offer a job other than farming.

He is a kind and helpful person as he always tries to help people if they're in need. Even with his high stats and valuable skills, he never acts arrogant, wanting to keep a low profile as he does not want to stand out much for anything.

name.native: ファル・イース・メイギス

276598.description:
She is the crown princess of Meigis. While a knight-class man was abducting her, Al Wayne saved her, causing her to be infatuated with him.

As a crown princess, Fal is a dignified beauty who puts her citizens and beloved before her. She treats everyone with equality and compassion. Nevertheless, she is a qualified future queen for her wisdom. But, while being such a person, she is unusually stubborn and does not tolerate discrimination.

276599.description: Helen is a kind and friendly person who gets along well with others. As a result of the trauma from Ouroboros's attack on her village and the curse he placed on her, Helen suffered amnesia save for her name. After recovering her memory, she became consumed with despair until Al delivered a message from her brother's ghost urging her to live. After making peace with her grief, she decides to use the power she inherited from Ouroboros to protect others and starts to adventure herself in addition to her receptionist job.

276600.description:
Ruri is the descendant of the hero, who is on a journey to become a full-fledged hero.

Despite being a descendant of the Hero, Ruri failed to manifest his power and was frequently bullied by others as being a failure. Despite encouragement from her parents to walk her own path, Ruri considered herself a disappointment and struggled with her self-esteem. After encountering Al and being reminded of what it means to be a hero, Ruri finally found the confidence to tap into her ancestor's power as well as falling in love with Al.

name.native: グリンダ・グッドウィッチ

277886.description:
__Height:__ 196cm (in heels)

A no-nonsense professor at Beacon Academy and [Ozpin](https://anilist.co/character/268340)'s assistant. She is skilled as a Huntress who utilizes the Dust and her weapon The Disciplinarian, a thin, black riding crop, to protect her students and the school. Her Semblance Telekinesis allows her to levitate, move, and manipulate objects.

name.native: タイヤン・シャオロン

277889.description: The father of both [Ruby](https://anilist.co/character/126569/Ruby-Rose) and [Yang](https://anilist.co/character/132223/Yang--Xiao-Long). He was also a teacher at Signal Academy. Since he raised the girls on his own, he tends to be a bit overprotective of them. He used to be an active Huntsman in Team STRQ and has a history with [Ozpin](https://anilist.co/character/268340/Ozpin).

277890.description:
__Height:__ 173cm

An experienced Huntsman and professor at Beacon Academy. He teaches about Grimm as well as combat. He sometimes talks about his heroism and past quests during his classes. His weapon Blowhard is a combination flintlock blunderbuss (trumpet gun) and an axe with twin blades.

278459.description:
__Relatives:__ [Kaisei Arakawa](https://anilist.co/character/283884/Kaisei-Arakawa) (Pupil) 
__Affiliation:__ Arakawa School 
__Occupation:__ Rakugoka (Shin'nuchi) 

He is one of four Shin'nuchi rank in the Arakawa School. He currently is [Kaisei Arakawa's](https://anilist.co/character/283884/Kaisei-Arakawa) master.

name.native: ハナバタ・ノーキンス

279367.description:
__Relatives:__ [Shiguma Arakawa](https://anilist.co/character/264107/Shiguma-Arakawa) (Master)
__Affiliation:__ Arakawa School

He currently is [Shiguma Arakawa](https://anilist.co/character/264107/Shiguma-Arakawa)'s pupil.

Despite his appearance he is a kind person who helps other people, being the youngest of [Shiguma](https://anilist.co/character/264107/Shiguma-Arakawa)'s students he has respect for his teacher and his superiors.

280467.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Occupation:__ Comedian

He is a failing comedian who was turned into a sorcerer by [Kenjaku](https://anilist.co/character/289584/Kenjaku) in order to participate in the Culling Game.

Fumihiko is an exceptionally goofy individual whose jokes aren't funny, but he still lives to entertain above all else. He found himself failing as a comedian and was down on his luck. A co-worker encouraged him to keep going because there's always a demand for comedians who think they're funny. Takaba acts on those words and has a very energetic attitude. He's very outspoken and comedy-focused in everything he does.

280468.description:
__Species:__ Human 
__Occupation:__ Jujutsu Sorcerer

He is a jujutsu sorcerer from the past who was incarnated by [Kenjaku](https://anilist.co/character/289584/Kenjaku) to participate in the Culling Game as a player.

Ryu is a classic hotshot that both men and women admire. In his past life, he enjoyed both a good fight and the company of ladies. Even though Ryu has no regrets, he likens his previous life to a "moderate eater" with no "dessert" to satisfy him. Ryu intends to use his second life to seek a worthy opponent to fulfill his insatiable hunger. Despite his persistent desire for combat, he appears calm and rational. [Yuta](https://anilist.co/character/129571/Okkotsu-Yuuta) further speculates that his point score in the Culling Game is a result of Ryu's choice not to target ordinary citizens but also his indifference to their deaths due to collateral damage in his fights.

280560.description: Current CEO of Schnee Dust Company, the world's largest dust company. Husband to Willow Schnee and father to their three children, [Winter](https://anilist.co/character/280561/Winter-Schnee), [Weiss](https://anilist.co/character/126143/Weiss-Schnee), and [Whitley](https://anilist.co/character/280564/Whitley-Schnee).

name.native: ウィンター・シュニー

280561.description:
__Height:__ 173cm

[Weiss](https://anilist.co/character/126143/Weiss-Schnee)'s older sister and the eldest daughter of the Schnee family.

name.native: ウィットリー・シュニー

280564.description: [Weiss](https://anilist.co/character/126143/Weiss-Schnee)'s younger brother and the eldest son of the Schnee family.

280874.description: Former Assistant Director on the online variety show "Dig Deep! One Chance!" Currently works as [Ruby](https://anilist.co/character/183884/Ruby-Hoshino)'s manager.

alternative: The Magistrate of the Shiguma School

280941.description:
__Relatives:__ [Shiguma Arakawa](https://anilist.co/character/264107/Shiguma-Arakawa) (Master) 
__Affiliation:__ Arakawa School 

He currently is [Shiguma Arakawa's](https://anilist.co/character/264107/Shiguma-Arakawa) pupil.

He is very serious and polite when talking to people, he is usually very strict when teaching his inferiors about rakugo. Despite this, he often helps people and their inferiors to improve their skills. He is also very observant as he can see the flaws in a person's rakugo.

280942.description:
__Relatives:__ [Shiguma Arakawa](https://anilist.co/character/264107/Shiguma-Arakawa) (Master)
__Affiliation:__ Arakawa School  
__Occupation:__ Rakugoka (Futatsume)
 
He currently is [Shiguma Arakawa's](https://anilist.co/character/264107/Shiguma-Arakawa) pupil.

He is usually arrogant when dealing with people since he feels that when a woman is with him she will fall in love.

280944.description:
__Relatives:__ [Shiguma Arakawa](https://anilist.co/character/264107/Shiguma-Arakawa) (Master) 
__Affiliation:__ Arakawa School 
__Occupation:__ Rakugoka (Futatsume) 

He currently is [Shiguma Arakawa's](https://anilist.co/character/264107/Shiguma-Arakawa) pupil.

He is usually shy and usually thinks a lot about things making him indecisive. According to [Guriko](https://anilist.co/character/279367/Guriko-Arakawa), he is usually pessimistic most of the time, due to this nature he usually learns everything related to the story he wants to interpret, making his attitude change during his presentations to a more self-confident personality.

name.native: クリス・レッドグレイヴ

281394.description:
__Height:__ 182 cm
__X-Playing Card:__ Calorieʼs High (♥ 5)

Chris Redgrave is a member of High Card. He is a flirty, street-smart man who knows his way around women. He is able to operate any vehicle, including cars, with his unmatched driving skills. He has got a sweet tooth and eats “Fudgees”, which are sticks of traditional confectionery fudge. He drinks but has a low alcohol tolerance. 

He is a sales representative at Pinochleʼs Old Maid branch and becomes [Finnʼs](https://anilist.co/character/281395/Finn-Oldman) mentor.

name.native: フィン・オールドマン

281395.description:
__Height:__ 176 cm
__X-Playing Card:__ Neo New Nambu (♠ 2)

Finn is a recently scouted member of High Card. He is a mischievous, spirited, and reckless young man. Born with nerves of steel, Finn is able to maintain his cool disposition in even the most nerve-racking situations. Having lost his family in a tragic accident at a young age, Finn spent a majority of his formative years living in the Sun Fields orphanage. His sharp focus allows him to lock on his targets, as if time has stopped. This talent allows him to be an excellent pickpocket. 

Finn is now working as a sales apprentice at Pinochle's Old Maid branch.

name.native: バーナード・シモンズ

281397.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm
__X-Playing Card:__ Love & Peace (♠ A)

Wendy is a member of High Card, becoming a member of the society through the connections she had from her father, a master swordsman. She is often serious and is therefore frustrated by the way [Finn](https://anilist.co/character/281395) and [Chris](https://anilist.co/character/281394) work. She enjoys eating and drinking more than any of the other High Card members. When she drinks, her mood improves, and her coldness is replaced by a sunnier disposition. 

She is part of the accounting and clerical staff at Pinochle’s Old Maid branch.

name.native: ヴィジャイ・クマール・シング

281398.description:
__Height:__ 185 cm
__X-Playing Card:__ Green Green (♣ 3)

Vijay Kumar Singh is a member of High Card. He has a calm personality, loves plants, and is a great chef. Though he is an intelligent man that can complete any task flawlessly, his rationality prevents him from being able to “read the room,” so the others think of him as a bit of an “airhead.” He is a part-time lecturer and a Ph.D. student at the University of Cribbage. 

He oversees systems management and sales at Pinochle’s Old Maid branch.

name.native: レオ・コンスタンティン・ピノクル

281400.description:
__Height:__ 164 cm
__X-Playing Card:__ Never No Dollars (♦ 7)

Son of [Theodore Constantine Pinochle](https://anilist.co/character/281399), manager of Pinochle’s Old Maid branch, and the leader of the High Card society. Possessing a king’s temperament, Leo is sharp tongued, sadistic, and unable to admit to his faults. Despite his abrasive nature and young age, people acknowledge that his refined tactics are unmatched. 

He attends the public school, Rummy College, where he has an entourage. He loves to spend money.

281625.description: Mikado Momodera is a Momotarou and a former Deputy Commanding Officer of the Momotarou Corporation's 13 Units, serving under Commanding Officer [Shinya Momoiwa](https://anilist.co/character/376051/Momoiwa-Shinya).

282074.description: Kanan’s childhood friend and loyal maid. As a succubus, she often takes… snack breaks daily.

282075.description: A high school boy one year Kanan's junior. Kanan has chosen him as a target to devour his soul, but he mistakenly believes that she's confessing to him and becomes her boyfriend. Aggressively in love with Kanan.

282076.description:
Kanan Takakiyo, at first glance, is an ordinary teenage girl who is president of her high school's public morals committee. However, this is all a facade - her true identity is Kanan Zebel, a thousand-year-old demon who is the daughter of [Beelzebub](https://anilist.co/character/321160/), the Great Demon of Gluttony. Eager to consume human souls, she descended to the human world and used hypnotism to convince an ordinary family that she was their firstborn - all so that she could find a student to consume. 

Her search brought her to [Youji Kyougi](https://anilist.co/character/282075/), her kohai in school who mistakenly believes she wants to go out with him. Unfortunately, there is one caveat to her plan... she has never been in a relationship before.

282236.description: The most "popular" girl in Kuroe's school, Rairi is shown to be heavily into makeup. She becomes friends with Kuroe and the two form a trusting bond when she helps her gain confidence in herself. Kuroe later learns that Rairi has also been keeping a secret about the way she really looks.

282716.description:
__Debut:__ Chapter 11 
__Occupation:__ Teacher 

She is usually a serious person due to her work as a teacher, she usually helps students by supporting them and giving them advice for the future.

282717.description:
__Occupation:__ Student 
__ Debut:__ Chapter 1 (Child), Chapter 11

As a child he used to be annoying and made fun of his classmates. During his youth he is usually more friendly and respectful with people.

282718.description:
__ Affiliation:__ Monthly Rakugo 
__Occupation:__ Writer 

He is a writer for the Monthly Rakugo Magazine.

282748.description: Cosplayer and VTuber under the name Komimi Suzune. [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/280874/Shun-Yoshizumi)'s sister.

name.native: レオーネ・オルファー
リーゼロッテ・アールシア

283884.description:
__Relatives:__ [Issho Arakawa](https://anilist.co/character/278459/Isshou-Arakawa) (Master) 
__Affiliation:__ Arakawa School 
__Occupation:__ Rakugoka (Futatsume)

He currently is [Issho Arakawa's](https://anilist.co/character/278459/Isshou-Arakawa) pupil.

He is a proud person who wants to be the best rakugoka, when he talks about his goals he is usually serious. He usually acts in a nice way to please people.

283885.description:
__Occupation:__ Rakugoka 
__Height:__ 190 cm (6'3")

He is the two-time champion of the Karaku Cup.

He usually has a confident attitude which makes him feel superior to others. He has a cocky attitude due to being the current champion.

During his years at university, he became interested in rakugo, which made him enter a rakugo club to learn, but when he observed that the stories they told were boring and did not excite people, he developed his own style. He participated and won the Karaku Cup two years in a row being the current champion, thanks to that he has received offers from major companies.

283886.description:
__Height:__ 167 cm (5'6")

She is a famous voice actress known for her role as Saruel in the anime Eden's Nova.

She participates in the anime Eden's Nova for which she is recognized, she entered the Karaku cup to boost her popularity.

283887.description:
__Affiliation:__ Monthly Rakugo 
__Occupation:__ Writer 

She works with [Kashio](https://anilist.co/character/282718/Kimihisa-Kashio) on covering the Karaku Cup.

283888.description:
__Affiliation:__ Arakawa School 
__Occupation:__ Rakugoka (Shin'uchi) 

He is one of four Shin'nuchi rank in the Arakawa School and member of Arakawa Arch Four.

He sat for the exam for Shin'nuchi 6 years ago. He is currently a famous personality in the world of rakugo and outside of it, since he usually shoots movies and television series. He is the judge for the Karaku Cup alongside [Issho](https://anilist.co/character/278459/Isshou-Arakawa) and [Ryujaku](https://anilist.co/character/283889/Ryujaku-Sakaki).

283889.description:
__Occupation:__ Rakugoka (Unknown) 

Due to his work as a rakugoka, he works in Osaka and often travels to Tokyo for the Karaku Cup where he takes the opportunity to eat ramen. He is the judge for the Karaku Cup alongside [Issho](https://anilist.co/character/278459/Isshou-Arakawa) and [Ikken](https://anilist.co/character/283888/Ikken-Arakawa).

alternative: Woodman Rintarou (ウッドマン林太郎)

284496.description: Asuna Kisaragi is introduced in the 2nd episode, she works for the projects department of the Favion Media Group.

alternative: Setsu Suzaki (須崎雪)‚ Yuki-kun (ユキくん)

284884.description: The daughter of Enome. Due to her father cheating too many times on her mother, she is plotting a plan so her mother and Kikuru can get married.

285221.description:
__Affiliation:__ Goblin Community, Parabellum 
__Rank:__ Major/3rd in the Goblin Community
__Corp:__ Tirard

Joined Rou's party after Kichi. She is the head of the Tirard Corps, dealing with long range weapons such as slingstaffs, bows, and cross-bows. Mi has an easy-going personality and has always wanted to be with Rou. She has been praising and complimenting Rou ever since they first spoke.

285222.description:
__Affiliation:__ Goblin Community, Parabellum
__Rank:__ Lieutenant Colonel/2nd in the Goblin Community

Kichi is Rou's first goblin friend. He lacks intelligence but makes up for it with brute strength.

name.native: アイザック・ロンバール

286332.description:
**Height:** 165 cm (5'5")

Satsuki is a blunt, serious, and headstrong person. Despite her beautiful appearance, she has a cold personality and an unapproachable aura that makes it difficult to connect with her.

~!Satsuki lives in a run-down apartment and works part-time to support her single mother.!~

287182.description:
__Master:__ [Yuru](https://anilist.co/character/270811/)

Formerly the left statue in the settlement, she now takes the form of a muscular, tall woman reminiscent of an oni. Like [Right](https://anilist.co/character/324638), she values strength and communicates in an old-fashioned manner, but in contrast, she has a more phlegmatic personality.

289163.description: She is one of the Four Heavenly Kings of the Demon Lord's Army. She is extremely terrified of Marika when she is angered.

289255.description: Manjirou is a spirit medium, and the priest of a shrine that worships a "Tsuchinoko." What is actually enshrined there, however, is the skin left behind by the Great Serpent, which was traditionally worshipped in the area. He has a secret desire to become a BooTuber.

289584.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 183 cm
__Occupation:__ Curse User
__Cursed Technique:__ Cursed Spirit Manipulation

Kenjaku is one of the primary antagonists of the Jujutsu Kaisen series. He is an ancient sorcerer who pursues the goal of "evolving" humanity via cursed energy, thereby ushering in a new golden age of jujutsu sorcery paralleling the Heian Era.

~!Using his cursed technique that allows him to transplant his brain into different bodies to possess them, he has inhabited different people throughout the centuries, assuming different identities.!~

name.native: システィア・ルージュ

290570.description: Touma Taiga is a member of Tokyo Branch HxEros. He is described as the feminine male member of the Tokyo branch.

292108.description:
A tomboyish girl and Aika Natsukawa's best friend, also a member of the Kōetsu High Volleyball Club. She's often seen wearing hoodies during High School.

She has a cheerful personality and secretly supports the relationship that has been going between Aika and Wataru. Although Wataru didn't seems to notice this, it has been proven by her actions. She is a typical best friend who always watching Aika and comforts her whenever she faced undesired circumstances.

292109.description: She is the older sister of Wataru and also the vice president of the student council.

292110.description: She is the head of the public morals committee.

name.native: アルトゥル・リヒター
テレスティア・テラ・エスフォート

293533.description: The third-born daughter of Rex Terra Esfort, and is the third crown princess of Effort Kingdom. After being rescued by Cain von Silford, she falls in love with him and becomes engaged to him.

name.native: シルク・フォン・サンタナ
レイネ・フォン・シルフォード

294184.description: Uryuu Kamihate's childhood friend from the orphanage.

name.native: ペイストリー=ミル=モルテールン

294307.description: A promising pâtissier meets his demise and leaves the world without ever having achieved his dream of making the world's greatest pastry. But when he is given another chance, he reincarnates as nine-year-old Pastry Mille Morteln, determined to be successful this second time. The eldest son of the Knight Morteln. His nickname is Pace. The memory of the previous life, the magic, and the passion for sweets have caused turmoil in the Kingdom of Proulich.

name.native: ルミニート=アイドリハッパ
リコリス=ミル=フバーレク
招き猫の姿をした“それ”

294907.description: **Race:** Oni Ann is an Oni and represents the Oni Maids who now live in the village with Flora. Formerly working for Loo and Flora, she now also looks after Hiraku and his family in the forest.

294908.description: **Race:** Vampire Flora is a skilled witch who arrived at Hiraku's house searching for Loo. She is also a researcher interested in fermentation, which led her to move to the village. She contributed to the farm by introducing the first two heads of cattle and her knowledge of potion making.

name.native: ノエル・シュトーレン

295642.description:
__Job:__ Talker
__Cluster:__ The Blue Beyond

~!__Job:__ Tactician
__Cluster:__ Wild Tempest!~


Following in the footsteps of his heroic grandfather, he aims to be the "Strongest Seeker". However, his job is "Talker" which is regarded as the weakest. Knowing that, Noel worked hard persistently to fulfil his ambition. Despite the merciless methods he employed for the sake of his ambition, which is considered "evil". Noel’s distinct talent attracted many powerful people and they began to gather under him.

name.native: ファビアン・オルテンブルク

297195.description: The Maiden of the Kou clan and niece to the empress. Intelligent and beautiful, she is dubbed "His Highness's favored butterfly" and is loved by all. Physically delicate from a young age makes her seem frail, but has grit to not be disheartened by any obstacle as well as a steel will.

297196.description: Maiden of the Shu clan. She has a strong sense of inferiority, dubbed a villainess for her mean behavior and is hated by all. Envies [Reirin](https://anilist.co/character/297195/Kou-Reirin) who is the opposite and is loved by those around her. Using her specialty of forbidden magic, she swaps bodies with Reirin on the night of the Double Sevens Festival.

297201.description: The crown prince of the kingdom of Ei. Accomplished in both literary and military arts, handsome, sincere, and responsible. Born with dragon's qi. He loves his intelligent cousin [Reirin](https://anilist.co/character/297195/Kou-Reirin) from the bottom of his heart.

297202.description: She is the Empress of Ei and Reirin's aunt. She possesses a bold and open-hearted personality.

297410.description: Ryouta is a salaryman who has suddenly been transferred to a mysterious world where everything is dropped from monsters. All of his stats, including his physical and magical strength, are the weakest "F". In addition, his level is fixed at "1", the lowest. However, he has a unique skill "Drop Skill, All S", which makes him the strongest even though he is level 1..!

297412.description: Emily is an adventurer girl who uses a large hammer that does not match her petite frame. She meets [Ryouta](https://anilist.co/character/297410/Satou-Ryouta), after he defeats a slime in a dungeon. She is honest and kind, but her low drop skill means that she earns little money and lives in the dungeon alone. She has good life skills such as cooking and cleaning.

alternative: Yanagi no Ken no Soujirou (柳の剣のソウジロウ)

298248.description: An all-powerful master swordsman from another world. In addition to his skill with the blade, he possesses superhuman intuition, granting him the ability to discern, through a single glance, the perfect way to kill any enemy who appears before him.

alternative: Tooi Kagizume no Yuno (遠い鉤爪のユノ)

name.native: ソフィティア・フェムト
チェルシー・ハモンド

299249.description:
~!He is the father of Aqua and Ruby.!~

~!He is later revealed to also be Taiki Himekawa's biological father, having been molested by Airi Himekawa when he was a child before allegedly having her murdered as well by telling her husband about the affair.!~

299366.description: Adonis is a human raised by a witch named Chloe.

299367.description: A young girl who was imprisoned in a prisoner's camp in the Lydia Empire. She is kind and has a noble spirit.

name.native: クラウス・フォン・ボーゼス
イリス・フォン・ボーゼス
エンリルタ・リースハイド・ベルトラン

299758.description:
__Gender:__ Male ~!Female (Currently)!~

He was a knight who belonged to the Imperial Guard.

name.native: イヴ・カルスリーダー

300004.description: Eve Callusleader is an adventurer famous for her bunny ears and bunny suit. She is a lover of carrots, she puts them above all else.

300005.description: Reception staff of the purchase shop "Tsubame no Ongaeshi". She is cheerful and kind, and gives Ryota, who knows nothing about this world, a variety of information.

alternative: Ancient Dragon (エンシェントドラゴン)

300444.description: **Race:** Dragon Hakuren is the older sister of Doraim and Rasuti's aunt. She initially attacks the village upon hearing that her niece, Rasuti, has a boyfriend, but is eventually repelled by Hiraku and decides to settle down in the village.

alternative: Mad Scientist (マッドサイエンティスト)

name.native: アレン・クロフォード
シャーロット・エヴァンズ

302354.description: A student in Shiki's class. He is extremely averse to all uncomfortable situations, a result of him losing his oni girlfriend to an illness. His Blood Eclipse Release manifests as paper fans and a dancing outfit, having been a dancer in the oni village he grew up in.

302946.description: A girl sleeps in a cemetery that "should not exist" in an "overwritten" world. She is a being called a "heavenly demon" who transcends all races.

name.native: カイ・サクラ=ヴェント

302947.description: A young man working as a soldier for the Humanitarian Protection Agency. He witnesses the world being rewritten before his eyes.

303432.description: Mona's childhood friend. She has a mature and fun personality.

304726.description:
Doraim is the dragon tribe's leader. Royalty and defender of his domain which lies south of the Taiju Village in the western mountains. His lands, acts as a defensive post for civilization, since its situated between the Forest of Death & the lesser known Iron Forest. 
While a powerful being, his personality quite a normal being, with taste for drink (such as the Taiju Village in particular). After the defeat of the rare firebreathing wild Wyvern at the hands of Hiraku Machio, he felt such a being must be befriended (he also fears). After becoming fast friends, and discovering the fantastic food & drink the village had to offer. His personal assistant Guchi, must drag him back to his duties as the Gate Keeper in the mountains or he would never leave.

He was such a frequent visitor his own daughter, Lastismun, became gravely concern that he was cheating on his wife, Graffalun, only to find he was over indulging at the Taiju Village, now having a guest home.

After his daughter, attempted to attack the village, he ordered her to remain there to get better acquainted with them and cool down her temper.

304727.description: Fraurem Chrome is a demon and daughter of Demon King advisor, Bizel Chrome, she is hard working girl. She was sent to Taiju Village by her father as his representative. Originally thought to be spy, she turned out to be normal resident.

name.native: エルーカ・クロフォード
シャーロット・レイス

305391.description: An orphan girl who lived without relatives in the castle city of Canare. She was on the run from slave traders when she was rescued by [Ars](https://anilist.co/character/305390/Ars-Louvent) and [Rietz](https://anilist.co/character/305393/Rietz-Muses).

305720.description:
__Height:__ 168 cm

Hikari Shinomiya was a former Captain of the Second Division of the Defense Force and Vice-Captain of the First Division. She was also the wife of [Isao Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/257340/Isao-Shinomiya) and mother of [Kikoru Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/183889/Kikoru-Shinomiya).

Hikari used to be very strong yet understanding and caring individual, as well as being more jovial and lively than her husband Isao.

305754.description: Yuki's goal is to win ninety-nine death games while also attempting to keep as many of her fellow participants alive as possible.

305763.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm
__Occupation:__ Platoon Leader in the First Division of the Defense Force

Rin is a serious woman who follows Captain [Gen Narumi](https://anilist.co/character/241577/Gen-Narumi)'s order without question, despite letting her guard down sometimes. She is a calm individual who faces things correctly, still managing to have fun while doing so. Rin also seem to take a liking in brave people. Her brave and rigid behavior, however, is sometimes a shield to hide her deep emotions of joy and excitement. She also seems to secretly cultivate her physical appareance and beauty.

~!Behind her strong and menacing demeanor, Rin hides a huge admiration for Gen Narumi's strength, feeling this emotions ever since her first battle with him in the First Division. During the years, the desire to be acknowledged by him brought Rin to strive to become stronger and more beautiful, just to impress Narumi. To this day, she holds dear the memory of when Gen promoted her to Platoon Leader, and still struggles prove her worth and follow Gen's footsteps. In fact, Rin's hidden closeness and deep link to her division comrades even pushes her to fight with her life on the line to fulfill her duty.!~

305775.description: Nyagosuke is a "cat" who lives in Mikazukiji Temple. She is often with [Kurage](https://anilist.co/character/162135/Kurage-Aoba).

305869.description: E is the Head of the logistical support group Pleasure and leader of the mining group. She was the first goblin to ask [Rou](https://anilist.co/character/133061/Rou) to train them. She was also placed 4th in the very first hierarchy tournament.

305952.description:
__Job(s):__ Peddler, Alchemist, Item Creator

Spinel Fean is an alchemist and a former member of the merchant association The Star God's Pavilion. She joined Parabellum as their chief alchemist and as one of [Rou](https://anilist.co/character/133061/Rou)'s lovers.

Intellectual type that works diligently on the tasks at hand. She was the first to express her feeling to Rou and sincerely thanked him for saving her from being raped.

305955.description:
__Job(s):__ Peddler, Cook, Tailor

Felicia Timiano is a cook and a tailor like her twin younger sister [Alma Timiano](https://anilist.co/character/305960/Alma-Timiano). She is a former member of the merchant association Star God Pavilion.

She is gentle and a worrywart, however, she becomes scary when she gets angry.

305960.description:
__Job(s):__ Peddler, Cook, Tailor

Alma Timiano is a cook and a tailor like her twin older sister [Felicia](https://anilist.co/character/305955/Timiano-Felicia). She is a former member of the merchant association Star God Pavilion.

She is gentle and shy. However, she becomes scary when she gets angry.

305962.description:
__Job(s):__ Farmer, Warrior, Noir Soldier

Rubellia Walline is a member of Parabellum and one of [Rou](https://anilist.co/character/133061/Rou)'s lovers, as well as Opushii's mother.

Rubellia was initially a rather shy and introverted young woman. She starts to become more assertive after joining Rou.

306048.description:
**Height:** 158 cm (5'2")

She is sometimes referred to as an "angel" because of her easygoing personality.  Sena's parents frequently leave her home to care for her two younger brothers, Kou-kun and Kii-kun. Although she loves her brothers, she grows resentful of the restrictions it places on her freedom as she is left to look after them on a more regular basis.

306777.description:
**Height:** 153 cm (5'0")

As the group's mascot, Kaho has a playful and fun personality. She enjoys making jokes and has the ability to control the mood of the group. She is referred to as "everyone's little sister" because of her childish personality.

~!Renako is later revealed to be Kaho's childhood friend. Renako was unable to remember who she was because her surname had been changed from Minaguchi to Koyanagi.!~

308020.description:
__Height:__ 177 cm

Iharu Furuhashi is a young officer of the Third Division of the Defense Force.

~!After the destruction of Tachikawa Base, he was transferred to the Fourth Division.!~

~!Back when Iharu was still in middle school, he was saved from a kaiju by [Mina Ashiro](https://anilist.co/character/180693/Mina-Ashiro). This event would later inspire him to become a Defense Force member.!~

308033.description:
Kaiju Juu-gou is an Identified Kaiju who attacked Tachikawa Base. It is created by [Kaijuu Kyuu-gou](https://anilist.co/character/259598/Kaijuu-Kyuugou) and is considered a "prototype". ~!It was then weaponized into Numbers Weapon 10, currently used by [Soushirou Hoshina](https://anilist.co/character/205579/Soushirou-Hoshina).!~ 

~!Its fight with Soushirou Hoshina managed to excite it so much that, even after being defeated, it still felt linked to Soushirou and wished to be turned into a weapon for him, to fight with him once more. Kaiju Juu-gou seems to be a rather independent individual, easily betraying its progenitor Kaijuu Kyuu-gou just to get closer to Soushirou.!~ 

Kaiju Juu-gou is a extremely powerful Identified Kaiju, with a fortitude level of 8.3 when it first appeared, ~!and 9.0 after growing larger in size.!~

308290.description: She is Renako's younger sister. She is a second-year junior high school student and a member of the badminton club. She is naturally extroverted and athletic, unlike her older sister.

name.native: ティガー・ヒルデブラント

alternative: Shieki no Majo Guririgura (使役の魔女グリリグラ)

308632.description: She's Juuzou Ougami's ex-wife and the head of the Science Department.

308634.description: A 39-year-old legendary assassin, stung by a mysterious wasp, is transformed into a 13 year-old. Under orders from the Boss of the assassination organization, he attends a Middle School. Though initially bewildered by his sudden school life, he soon finds himself engrossed in the joys of learning. His marksmanship is top-notch.

308635.description: Noren is a student and part of Mitsuoka Pharmaceuticals.

308636.description: Kotatsu is a subordinate of Juuzou Ougami.

alternative: シアトリヒ・ニューリアル・チェイモス

308639.description: Noah's older half-brother and the king of Chamos. One of his legs is completely paralyzed. He is a womanizer and has a meddlesome and talkative personality. While he seems careless, he is quite cunning.

308680.description:
Veor is a barbarian warrior and is the heir to the barbarian settlement, and the son of Uldyn, "the One-Eyed."

He meets Serafina in battle, during the war between the barbarians and the Kingdom of Illdoren.

name.native: セラフィーナ・ド・ラヴィラン

308681.description:
A female knight who served the Illdoren Kingdom as Commander of the Eastern Expeditionary Force, she is the eldest daughter of the noble Lavillant family.

Skilled in combat, she can even fight multiple opponents at once, and hold her own against opponents with greater physical strength than her. Her family attempted to arrange marriages for her, but she grew frustrated at the role she was expected to take as a married woman, and beat all of her would-be husbands in duels.

308806.description: She is a seemingly supernatural being apparently aware of everything that transpires within the story.

name.native: フェイ・テオ・フィルス
