アリス・ワンダーランド

309809.description: Jashi is a yokai who has spent years bound to the [Tsuchinoko](https://anilist.co/character/309811/Tsuchinoko) sacrificial house and is known for cursing humans to commit suicide with his gaze.

310192.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

A young receptionist at the Iffole Counter, having worked there for three years. She has a first-class license, given to the top 10% of those with powers. Though she herself doesn't understand why she can use her divine realm skills, she has the power to destroy relics with one hand, which makes her an extremely powerful fighter.

In order to live a carefree life, she finishes overtime work the same day, as she grew tired of rolling it over to the next day.

311278.description: Kaijuu Juugo-gou was one of the many Identified Kaiju created by [Kaijuu Kyuu-gou](https://anilist.co/character/259598/Kaijuu-Kyuugou). It was created to defeat [Kikoru Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/183889/Kikoru-Shinomiya).

311586.description: Yuuri is a demon and the daughter of the current reigning demon king, Gargard. She holds the rank of Princess. She is considered to be the most important ranking member of the royal family (She is not the heir, since Demon Kings are appointed). Like all Demons, she has incredible magical powers.

name.native: テオドール・フォン・ボーゼス
ベルトール＝ベルベット・ベールシュバルト

313983.description: Demon Lord who ruled over all the immortals 500 years ago. He was defeated by the Hero Gram and got reincarnated 500 years later in the year 2099 of the Fused Era.

314498.description:
Naomi is an agent with the Department of Truth, whose job is to oversee android activity. While she seems lighthearted, she has a calm and rational approach.

~!It is later revealed that she is a nean created by the visitors.!~

name.native: ルジュ・レッドスター

314499.description: A ten-year-old android who appears to be 17. Due to her actual age, she can be naive and have difficulty socializing, but she has a kind heart.

315207.description: Jun is a bartender for bounty hunters.

alternative: Rankai Ryoureki Nihilo (濫回凌轢ニヒロ)
Akai Shisen no Elea (赤い紙箋のエレア)
Sekai Shi no Kia (世界詞のキア)

315337.description: Transferred from the rural Tsukinose to a city school. Skilled at cooking, he makes dinner for himself and his younger sister every day.

315338.description: [Hayato's](https://anilist.co/character/315337) childhood friend who lived in tsukinose until seven years ago.

315929.description: Edel is a second-class mage in the Seventeenth Party, alongside Blei and Dunst, of the First Class Mage Exam. She specializes in Hypnosis Magic.

316334.description: Jeanne is a childhood friend from the world where Kai lived. In the “overwritten” world, she is called the “Knight of Spiritual Light,” the hope of mankind.

name.native: レーレーン・レイル・レーチェリエル

316335.description: Reiren is an elven priestess living in an elven forest

317194.description:
Mother of Utsutsu and Yume.
~!Shortly after giving birth to Yume she attempts to kill her baby, but is unsuccessful because Yume is infected with Pupa.!~

318692.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")

Tamon is the "Sexy and Wild" member of the popular idol group F/ACE. He moved to Tokyo at 16 to audition as an idol with the dream of wishing to make people all over the world smile. His image color is red.

~!His personality drastically switches between being in "Hottiehara" idol heartthrob mode to his fans versus "Gloomyhara" low self-esteem mode in private. Despite this, his feelings towards being an idol and his fans are genuine. [Utage](https://anilist.co/character/318789/Utage-Kinoshita) discovers his true personality after being sent to work for him, and decides to stick to his side to support him. Tamon grows to value Utage and starts to become conscious of Utage's life; sometimes becoming possessive of her. He has an older brother, [Daiki](https://anilist.co/character/392745/Fukuhara-Daiki), who was his inspiration to pursue an idol career.!~

318789.description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'1")

Utage is a high school student who lives and breathes for her favorite idol, Tamon Fukuhara. She works part-time as a housekeeper so she can afford her fangirl lifestyle.

~!She was initially assigned to Tamon's house to cover the absence of her co-worker before officially hired as his housekeeper. She would do anything to keep Tamon retaining his idol job; this includes scolding him every time Tamon says any negative remarks about himself. One of the running gags is that she frequently drops her hand-fan and somebody else ends up picking it up for her.!~

318829.description: Jeanne is one of the Lord's servants who descended from Heaven and is on a mission to protect Kyougi from demons.

318830.description: Lilim is the mother of [Kanan](https://anilist.co/character/282076/Zebul-Kanan), [Miel](https://anilist.co/character/318831/Zebul-Miel), and [Milch](https://anilist.co/character/318832/Zebul-Milch), as well as the wife of the [Great Demon Beelzebub](https://anilist.co/character/321160/Beelzebub). She is afraid of men who are not her husband.

318831.description: Miel is one of Kanan's younger sisters and the youngest child of the Zebel family. She is deeply fond of her oldest sister but gets a rush whenever she witnesses moments of proximity between Kanan and Youji. ~!In her free time, she streams online under the alias Honey Bunny.!~

318832.description: Milch is one of Kanan's younger sisters and the middle child of the Zebel family. She’s always interested in Kanan’s things, including her new boyfriend. The brattiest of the bratty little girls.

318931.description: Amaterasu is the goddess of the sun in Japanese mythology.

319884.description: The older brother of the twins. He is very strong.

319885.description: The younger of the twins. She is very strong.

319954.description:
__Occupation:__ Agent of Spring
__Power:__ Life Stimulation

Hinagiku went missing for around ten years, taking the season of spring with her.

~!She's been in love with [Rosei](https://anilist.co/character/319955/Rosei-Kantsubaki) since childhood.!~

~!She later reunites with Rosei and enters a relationship with him. Because she sees herself as a different person from before her kidnapping, Rosei begins calling her 'Hina'—a nickname only he is allowed to use.!~

319955.description:
__Occupation:__ Agent of Winter
__Power:__ Life Coagulation

A young man who's heart was hardened after [Hinagiku](https://anilist.co/character/319954/Hinagiku-Kayo)'s kidnapping. His Guard is [Itecho](https://anilist.co/character/319957/Itechou-Kangetsu), a trusted older brother figure of his since childhood. He is known to be rash with his powers, using them to protect others rather than to solely bring Winter.

~!Rosei begins a relationship with Hinagiku after reuniting with her. Out of consideration for Hinagiku's assertion that she is different from her old self, he begins to call her 'Hina', a nickname she only allows Rosei to use.!~

319956.description:
__Occupation:__ Guard of Spring

A young woman who cherishes [Hinagiku](https://anilist.co/character/319954/Hinagiku-Kayo) greatly as her best friend and retainer. She falls into despair after Hinagiku's kidnapping and cuts ties with the Agent of Winter, [Rosei](https://anilist.co/character/319955/Rosei-Kantsubaki), and his Guard, [Itecho](https://anilist.co/character/319957/Itechou-Kangetsu), soon afterwards, despite her lingering feelings for Itecho.

~!After Hinagiku's return, Sakura gradually lets the Winter duo back into her and Hinagiku's lives once the four reunite, internally accepting her feelings for Itecho and becoming closer to him in the process.!~

319957.description:
__Occupation:__ Guard of Winter

A calm and gentle young man who been at [Rosei](https://anilist.co/character/319955/Rosei-Kantsubaki)'s side since he was a teenager. He treats Rosei like his own younger brother and cares deeply for [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/319956/Sakura-Himedaka), a girl he once tutored in the duties of a Guard before [Hinagiku](https://anilist.co/character/319954/Hinagiku-Kayo)'s kidnapping.

~!Itecho later realizes his feelings for Sakura after mistakenly believing that she intended to marry a Spring Administration Official.!~

320096.description:
__Occupation:__  Agent of Summer
__Power:__ Life Operation

She is cheery and sweet but always argues with her elder twin sister, Ayame.

320097.description:
__Occupation:__ Guard of Summer

Ruri's elder sister and retainer. She plans on quitting as a Guard once she marries. Ruri has pushed her around since they were kids, but she wishes her only the best.

320098.description:
__Occupation:__ Guard of Autumn

He thinks he sees his Guard role as only a job, but it doesn't look so from the outside. Obliviously overprotective of [Nadeshiko](https://anilist.co/character/320099/Iwaizuki-Nadeshiko).

320099.description:
__Occupation:__ Agent of Autumn
__Power:__ Life Putrefaction

The newest and youngest of the Agents. She is greatly fond and trusting of [Rindo](https://anilist.co/character/320098/Azami-Rindo).

320299.description: A young Japanese man. He lost his life due to the carelessness of [Sylphyleel](https://anilist.co/character/330065/Sylphyleel), the God of Wind, and was subsequently reincarnated in Etherdia. He becomes the guardian of a pair of twins he encountered in the forest.

320890.description: She is Ryo Shiraishi's older sister and the leader of the Home Economics Club, which Juzo is a member of.

320892.description: She's a middle school student who has a double personality, while her normal version is more shy and has a hard time speaking, her other version is more extroverted and more physically attractive. She is known as "Unicorn" due to her incredible physical abilities and for specializing in marine sports.

320893.description: He's a middle school student who stands at least six feet tall and is known as a standout on his school's baseball team. He's often called an "Unicorn" of the team because of his remarkable abilities. Notably, he's a versatile athlete who excels in Junior League Baseball, Youth Soccer, and Youth Basketball. He's the star player on all three teams, and every year he's been on those teams, they've won the National Championship.

name.native: パール・ダイアモンド

321568.description:
Eden is a young man conducting investigations on war ruins on Mars. Although he claims it's research, it's unclear what he actually does with the items he acquires from the ruins. He has a carefree and light-hearted personality. 

~!He is one of the Immortal Nine, and is known as Jet Black Noir.!~

name.native: ジーン・ユングハルト

321569.description: Gene is the Deputy Chief of the Ministry of Truth. He is Rouge's older brother.

321570.description:
Giallon is a member of the nean-lead organization "Alter", which aims to overthrow human society. He is one of the Immortal Nine.

Prioritizing hedonism and personal enjoyment over the organization's beliefs, Giallon is a pleasure-seeker possesses the ability to mimic and transform into a yellow gladiator.

name.native: サラ・フィッツジェラルド

321571.description:
Sarah is a well-known singer on Mars.

~!She is one of the Immortal Nine, and is known as Purgatory Viola.!~

321572.description:
Jill is a freelance journalist with strong communication skills and a cheerful personality.

~!She is actually one of the Immortal Nine, and is known as Flash Silvia.!~

321573.description: Noid 262 is an investigator nean working alongside Ash Stahl for the Guardianship Bureau. He is highly clever and extremely efficient in handling tasks, though there are still aspects of humanity that he hasn't fully grasped.

name.native: アフダル・バシャール

321575.description:
Afdal is a doctor who specializes in neans, known as a "tuner." He has a sharp tongue and an unsociable demeanor. However, he has solid skills and a strong sense of responsibility, earning trust from the neans.

~!He is one of the Immortal Nine, and is known as Phantom Verde.!~

321591.description: Chiho's friend. She likes good-looking guys.

name.native: ナタリア・エヴァンズ
ドロテア・グリ＝ム・ヴァレンシュタイン

321657.description: A popular novelist. When she tried to write a romance novel, she fell into a slump and holed up underground for 30 years to escape from her editor.

321659.description: [Dorothea's](https://anilist.co/character/321657/) editor. His expression never changes. He can transform into a giant black dragon.

name.native: ハーヴェイ・クロフォード
リーゼロッテ・クロフォード

321718.description: Second-class mage in the Eighth Party, alongside Wirbel and Scharf, in the First Class Mage Exam. Fern feels that she is the strongest within both the Fourth and Eighth parties.

321813.description:
__Daemon:__ [Gabriel](https://anilist.co/character/394436/) (Joe William Frederic Gabriel I and Kirk Douglas Auldglaive Gabriel II)
__Affiliation:__ Kagemori Family

A blonde teenage girl with a Daemon shaped like a floating pair of teeth with eyes named Gabriel. Although she is initially introduced as a cynical and cruel killer who kills anyone regardless of gender or threat, she is also shown as convincingly not harming children, and acting like a normal teenager when interacting with her friends.

321814.description:
__Daemons:__ Sukabenjaa "The Scavenger" ([Ai](https://anilist.co/character/396609/) and [Makoto](https://anilist.co/character/396610/))
__Affiliation:__ Kagemori Family

Jin is a Tsugai user and member of the Kagemori Family. He's first seen picking up [Asa](https://anilist.co/character/270810/Asa) and [Gabby](https://anilist.co/character/321813/Gabby) from the raid on Higashi Village.

321815.description: Mahoro is a high school student who [Arajin](https://anilist.co/character/321700/Arajin-Tomoshibi) is deeply in love with. She is the sister of [Marito Jin](https://anilist.co/character/321818/Marito-Jin), and is completely obsessed with him, wanting him all for herself. She doesn't care for Arajin and his advances, and frequently sees him as weird or gross, only keeping him around so she can manipulate him into doing what she wants from him. While she tends to keep a cutesy, sweet look on the exterior, especially around her brother, she isn't afraid to get serious and show her more manipulative, intimidating side around people she dislikes.

321818.description: The current leader of Siguma Squad, who is known to have incredibly powerful kicks, and is the direct rival of [Kenichirou Douman](https://anilist.co/character/321816/Kenichirou-Douman). He is close friends with his right hand man, [Outa Tahide](https://anilist.co/character/321820/Outa-Tahide), the two of them having dominated every middle school in Honki City, giving the two the nickname of "The God Kings". He also has a younger sister, [Mahoro Jin](https://anilist.co/character/321815).

322471.description: The cool gal in [Takuya's](https://anilist.co/character/322478/Takuya-Seo) class. One of the top beauties in her grade. Has strong likes and dislikes, especially dislikes vegetables. Tall and skilled at basketball, but not part of any club activities. Despite her intelligent looks, she's not particularly good at studying. As for Kiramon, she insists she only likes it for her little sister-like friend [Sayu](https://anilist.co/character/392458/Amamiya-Sayu) and isn't an otaku... but...?

322472.description: A cheerful gal who is [Takuya's](https://anilist.co/character/322478/Takuya-Seo) classmate. She has excellent communication skills and is good at studying, but not so good at sports. She tends to get close when talking. She is the third of five siblings, with two older brothers and two younger brothers. Because she has so many siblings, she often acts as a mother figure and takes care of her younger brothers.

322478.description: A socially awkward, unassuming otaku high school boy who loves the girls' anime “Kiramon.” Nicknamed “Otaku-kun.” He tends to speak rapidly when talking about Kiramon. He's good at drawing but struggles with academics and communication. He has an aversion to gals. Through a series of unexpected events, he becomes involved with his classmates, the gals [Kei Amane](https://anilist.co/character/322471/Kei-Amane) and [Kotoko Ijichi](https://anilist.co/character/322472/Kotoko-Ijichi).

alternative: ユリエン・ド・チャイルド
ミンチェスター・ド・ロマノフ
グレアム・ド・ファロン

323378.description:
Aes is Alice's twin brother. He's a calm, timid boy who enjoys reading.

~!He and Alice share a body, and together are known as Double-Headed Aerkos, one of the Immortal Nine.!~

323379.description:
Alice is Aes's twin sister. She's strong-willed and sharp-tongued. Although she looks down on her timid brother with disdain, she does care for him.

~!She and Aes share a body, and together are known as Double-Headed Aerkos, one of the Immortal Nine.!~

name.native: シアン・ブルースター

323382.description: Cyan is a young nean who claims to be Rouge's little sister.

323383.description: A renowned scientist who created Rouge.

323675.description: A male high school student at Funato High School. Since he was young, he wanted to be a detective, but his penchant for putting himself into other's matters led to others becoming more distant from him.

323676.description: A high school student at Funato High School, who has been Jougorou's friend since they were in junior high school. She likes sweets.

324638.description:
__Master:__ [Yuru](https://anilist.co/character/270811/)

Formerly the right statue in the settlement, he now takes the form of a large, very muscular man reminiscent of an oni. He possesses the mentality of an old-fashioned, communicative warrior who relishes battle, but is completely devoted to his master's commands.

324639.description:
__Daemons:__ Magatsuhi ([Daikyo](https://anilist.co/character/403335/) and [Shokyo](https://anilist.co/character/403336/))
__Affiliation:__ Nishino Village

A bloodthirsty assassin affiliated with Nishino Village and the alleged murderer of [Mine](https://anilist.co/character/395408/Mine) and [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/395409/Kinjou-Nagisa).

name.native: ラーファエル・ヒュランデル
ミレーユ・グランジオン

327299.description:
An old friend of Denken. First Class Mage and Serie's apprentice. Rarely acts directly, preferring stealth.
~!Helped in the extraction and transfer of information necessary for the liberation of Denken's hometown.!~

327413.description:
__Height:__ 173 cm

Krai is the leader of Grieving Souls, a party he started with his gifted childhood friends when they all strived to be the strongest party ever. Krai quickly realized he was not gifted like his childhood friends, he's in fact very weak only being able to fight with relics he has collected.

He's a level 8 hunter and is considered one of the strongest hunters in the city. Everyone thinks he's the smartest person in the city, thinking every word he says has a meaning, even if he's just joking around. Whatever he says is always taken very seriously and when the enemy knows he's nearby they always try to escape. But despite all this, he's unmotivated, sloppy, regular human being and doesn't want to get dragged into troublesome events. Generally, Krai always brings disasters along with him, much to the woe of the many.

alternative: Harver Koushaku Fujin (ハーバー侯爵夫人)
エル・ド・クロレンス
エミリー・ド・クロレンス

name.native: ユリウス・レインバーグ

327990.description:
__Height:__ 174 cm (5'9")

An ice mage and one of the top three students in Will's year. He is a typical noble, with pride and self-assurance to spare. Since the incident at the magic festival, he has been forced to work at Gina's bar.

328089.description:
A lonely girl who lost her mother and was torn far from her homeland.
Taken in by a family of scholars, she lives peacefully while gaining wisdom—only to lose everything when the Mongol Empire invades.

328153.description: He is a member of the newspaper club and full of strength and creativity.

328452.description: A national, famous idol with over 10 million subscribers. Yamii is introduced to Sonoka by Maya and her agency after gaining weight post-break up, afterwards showing appreciation to her and the Survival Game Club upon receiving their help.

alternative: ダークス・ギア・シミター

ヴィルヘルム・ エイビス

329704.description: Allen's father. He branded Allen, who did not receive any gifts, as a "failure" and expelled him from the household.

329705.description:
Allen's younger brother and the next head of the family.
He looks down on everyone other than himself and his father and makes fun of them.

329706.description: A boy who calls himself Anriette's younger brother.

name.native: ウィリアムズ・アリシア

330063.description:
Having been reborn as the villainess, she strives to be the best she can be at it; especially as the king has hired her to bully Liz in order to push her out of her comfort zone. She gets more invested in the job as Liz has fans who pick fights and bully anyone who isn't following blindly.

Alicia is very compassionate to the less fortunate, having taken in a child from a village who was banished as her retainer.

330064.description: The first prince of Durkiss. He is known to have a cool demeanor and and rarely smiles at anyone.

330065.description:
The God of Wind of Etherdia. 

He accidentally caused the death of the protagonist, [Takumi](https://anilist.co/character/320299/Takumi-Kayano), due to a blunder while attempting to repair a rift in space-time. Driven by guilt, he reincarnated him into another world and granted him a new body along with several "cheat" skills as compensation. Though generally gentle and approachable—with a somewhat ditzy side—he watches over the adventures of Takumi and the twins from the Divine Realm. 

However, he appears to be harboring a grave secret deep within regarding the twins' origins and the Water Goddess.

330262.description:
__Height:__ 110 cm

She used to work as a nurse at a hospital, but later changed jobs and was hired as a guild employee to support the busy and overworked Enome, but her clumsiness tends to drag her boss down even more.

330723.description: Saki is a colleague of Kai's. She is a friendly mercenary whose personality remains the same in the “overwritten” world.

330724.description: A colleague of Kai's. In the “overwritten” world, he is a tough mercenary.

name.native: ハディス・テオス・ラーヴェ

330800.description: On the night of her execution, when she was 16, she was transported back in time to when she was 10 years old.

330953.description: Natsuko works as an anime director and animator. She gets easily immersed and obsessive with her work, and thinks it is faster to do everything herself rather than rely on others. She also has trouble communicating with those around her.

name.native: ルーク・ブレイブハート

330954.description: Luke is the protagonist of A Tale of Perishing and the legendary hero. He was born in the Land of Light to a family of heroes who trained him with swords from a young age. He became a member of the Nine Soldiers in order to fulfill his duty to protect the Soul Futures from the Voids. He enjoys cooking and dislikes groups of young women.

330955.description: Unio is a member of the Nine Soldiers in the movie "A Tale of Perishing." He is from the Land of Beasts and is [Luke](https://anilist.co/character/330954/Luke-Braveheart)'s guardian beast. He was born on the same day as Luke and will do anything to protect him, as he considers Luke his best friend. He enjoys flirting with women, and thinks he is popular but actually isn't popular at all. He has a positive personality and will gossip about secrets to everyone in town.

330956.description: Memmeln is a member of the Nine Soldiers in the movie "A Tale of Perishing." She is an elf from the Land of Wind who has lived for hundreds of years. Among the elves, she had the most advanced magic and uses her bow for support in battle. She never shows her emotions and is a member of the choir, where she is close with the other elves.

330957.description: QJ is a member of the Nine Soldiers in the movie "A Tale of Perishing." They come from the Land of Machines and can detect both the presence of Voids and the weather, but isn't always accurate. QJ can fire a beam from their head to help in combat, but mainly acts as an analyst. [Unio](https://anilist.co/character/330955/Unio) calls them a piece of junk, and they enjoy vegetable gardening.

name.native: ジェイド・スクレイド
イグノール・リンドール

331144.description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")

An elf who transferred to the academy from Alfswood, located in the far north Urbus region. In accordance with elven customs, he only permits physical contact with those he has deemed worthy. Shares the same dream as a certain no-talent. He specializes in wind and illusion magic.

331267.description: The Hero of the South is a Hero who fought on the front lines against the demons for mankind before Himmel met Frieren. He was said to be mankind's strongest.

alternative: Kamiwaza no Revolte (神技のレヴォルテ)

331269.description: Revolte, also known as Divine Revolte, is a demon general. Revolte wields four swords made of magic.

331425.description: An Elf acquaintance of Frieren and the creator of the inscription that names Boshaft as the finest spirit in the world.

name.native: アルマ・イウディカーレ

333969.description:

__Cluster:__ The Blue Beyond
~!
__Job:__ Assassin
