She is the granddaughter of the legendary paid killer, "Assassin." She has been training as an assassin since childhood and has outstanding abilities.

333970.description:
__Job:__ Blademan
__Cluster:__ The Blue Beyond

~!__Job:__ Samurai
__Cluster:__ Wild Tempest!~ 

The undefeated Swordman from an island nation in the Far East. His swordsmanship is outstanding, and his slashing skills are top-notch. However, he is bound by a slave contract and cannot disobey his master's orders.

334313.description: A middle-aged man with slightly gray hair, initially portrayed as a traveling merchant, who serves as a link between the villagers and the outside world. In reality, he is a member of a long line of skilled warriors, capable of defeating a group of soldiers unarmed, and sent by his family to rescue and protect [Yuru](https://anilist.co/character/270811/Yuru) from hostile or dangerous individuals seeking to exploit him. He works in tandem with [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/334316/Danno-Hana), and occasionally flirts with her, half-jokingly convincing her to marry him as part of the cover story of his new young wife and stepmother to Yuru.

334315.description:
__Daemons:__ Kinugyokuto "Sun and Moon" ([Yozakura](https://anilist.co/character/401078/) and [Asagiri](https://anilist.co/character/401063/))
__Affiliation:__ Kagemori Family

[Jin](https://anilist.co/character/321814/)'s older half-brother. Asuma is an ominous person who usually gives the wrong impression since he acts suspiciously and attracts a lot of attention.

334316.description:
__Daemons:__ Zenko Kourou ([Kotetsu](https://anilist.co/character/397198/) and [Jirou](https://anilist.co/character/397199/))

A young woman who helps [Dera](https://anilist.co/character/334313/) protect [Yuru](https://anilist.co/character/270811/). Although she sincerely helps protect the boy, she reluctantly accepts the cover story of being Dera's young, new wife, even though she actually dreams of Jason Statham as her ideal man.

335283.description: Miiko is the best friend and classmate of Momo Ayase and Kei in high school.

335284.description: Best friend and classmate of Momo Ayase and Miko in high school.

name.native: ソフィア・シルフィード

335929.description:
Yuu is a 17-year-old boy with a short stature. He possesses striking red hair and red eyes. Despite being described as average, his most notable feature is his handsome and beautiful face, which he inherited from his mother, Subaru Ayase.

Yuu is a naturally kind and caring boy, always willing to help the Mikadono Sisters and those in need, even if it means butting into their business. He approaches life with extreme positivity and proactivity, often going above and beyond to lend a hand. However, the sisters sometimes see his kindness as a weakness and tease and scold him for it, yet still find it appealing and fascinating.

Since childhood, Yuu has been scorned for being talentless despite being the son of Subaru Ayase. As a result, he is very self-aware of his capabilities and incompetence. Despite his low self-esteem, he strives to excel in housework and cooking, where he can shine. His cooking skills are unrivaled, and he accommodates the sisters' extreme diet choices with ease, much to their astonishment. However, he occasionally pushes himself too hard and ends up getting sick.

335930.description:
Miwa is the youngest of the Mikadono Sisters. She is a high school girl with a unique two-tone short cut, with the top of her head being blonde and the rest of her hair being green. Like her sisters, she also has golden eyes.

Miwa is a genius shogi player with an IQ exceeding 180, occasionally winning in shogi and chess competitions and leading her team to victory in international mathematics competitions as the youngest female representative. However, her outstanding genius often isolates her from others, as she lacks interest in mundane conversations and people tend to keep their distance from her. Moreover, her genius is predominantly focused on her intellect, so her physical abilities are mediocre compared to Yuu's.

335931.description: Kazuki is the eldest of the Mikadono Sisters. She possesses outstanding acting and singing skills, capable of flawlessly portraying roles that are deemed impossible by others, and she also has incredible ticket-selling power, as every performance she appears in is sold out. Despite being part of an all-female theater group, she specializes in male roles due to her deep voice and polished appearance, which makes her extremely popular among women as a prince figure. However, she internally feels a compulsion to lead and help others without relying on anyone, in order to live up to her image as everyone's prince. Despite her perfectionist image, she surprisingly has a picky eating habit.

335932.description: Niko is the second eldest of the Mikadono Sisters. Despite her small stature of 150cm, Niko is a karate athlete who overwhelms her opponents with immense strength, winning numerous medals. She has exceptional physical abilities since childhood, dominating various martial arts competitions, and her robust and charismatic personality reflects her strict attitude towards herself and others. However, she also has a shy side and has a tendency to enjoy cute and bright things.

name.native: ワークナー・ノーグラム

336095.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10)

Professor of Magizoology. As one of the few people who understands Will, he always worries when Will pushes himself too hard. Though he tends to show his love for his students by being strict with them, this has made him an object of terror at the academy. He has earned various nicknames, including "Remedial Teacher from Hell," "Four-Eyed Fiend," "Magical Creature Nut," and "Immortal Workner," and is feared by friend and foe alike.

336652.description: A young spy and slave for Godwin, who was sent to pose as a maid for House Vandimion. Nanaka is a male beastkin who is often confused as a girl due to his androgynous figure and gender-neutral name. After Scarlet removes his enslavement curse, he sides with her in return.

name.native: アイリス・X・ステラマリス
alternative: Iris Churchill (アイリス・チャーチル)

337446.description:
A female watcher whose true identity remains unknown, even to most people in the Tower. She attends the academy as a student, and when she discovers someone with exceptional talent (especially those who are deemed unworthy by academy standards), she scouts them for the Tower. While at school, she goes by the alias of Iris Churchill. 

Although she often works behind the scenes, her magical abilities are on par with those of high mages.

name.native: ゼオ・トルゼウス・ラインボルト

337476.description: Is one of the Magia Vander and leader of the Thunder Faction: Thorzeus Fasce

name.native: エルノール・リヨス・アールヴ

337477.description: One of the Magia Vende. Leader of the Elf Faction.

337681.description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10")

Ouri is a member of the idol group F/ACE with a princely persona. His image color is blue. He is the youngest member of the group and was born into a family of entertainers, starting his career at 7 years old as a child actor and has many long-time fans. His refined appearance and delicate nature create a unique feeling of transparency within the group.

~!His true personality is that of a proud, arrogant, and violent man. He sees through Tamon's timidity and looks down on him, though both of them eventually become closer. Hostile towards Utage at first, he eventually falls in love with her and has been trying to win her over.!~

337682.description:
__Height:__ 174 cm (5'9")

Natsuki is a member of the idol group F/ACE with an angelic persona. He is the lead rapper and dancer of the group, and his image color is yellow. Fans love him for his cute and energetic personality, along with his great conversation skills. He is also multi-talented, composing and writing lyrics for F/ACE as well as producing his own cosmetics.

~!His true personality is that of a lazy downer who likes cigarettes, alcohol, and pachinko. Being from Kansai, he speaks in Kansai dialect in private. As a teenager, he indirectly caused injury to his then-girlfriend [Asuka](https://anilist.co/character/392740/Inoue-Asuka), which forced her to withdraw from an important martial arts match. Despite his growing success as an idol, he feels guilty and is unable to fully devote himself to his activities.!~

337683.description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10")

Keito is a member of the idol group F/ACE. He's known for his 'calm and collected' personality in his idol persona. His image color is green.

He's the leader, lead vocalist and the eldest member of F/ACE. Keito is popular for his good personality and friendliness. He doesn't show it, but even if discord breaks out among the members, he criticizes them with a harsh tone of concern. Before his debut, he was a coffee shop clerk famous for being too good-looking. He's also a good cook and shows off his culinary skills on F/ACE's video streaming channel.

~!His true personality is that of a ruthless miser who only sees his fans as a source of income. He wears glasses in private. In order to make money, he is strict against scandals, and is wary of Utage at first, though eventually comes to accept her as Tamon's emotional support. His intense obsession with money stems from his desire to send his five younger siblings to college and to make things easier for his parents.!~

337684.description:
__Height:__ 187 cm (6'2")

Rintarou is a member of the idol group F/ACE with a cool personality. He is F/ACE's main rapper and lead dancer, and his image color is purple. He has a quiet poker face and a mysterious aura, but he also uses his tall and muscular physique to work in modeling and appear in sports entertainment programs. His fan name is "Protein."

~!His true personality is that of a talkative otaku who can't help but talk nonstop about his favorite anime, "Sushi Musume" and his favorite character Kanpyo Roll. He became an idol because, like anime, he can evoke "emotions and stories that wouldn't happen in normal life." Unlike the other members, he doesn't consciously create an idol persona; he just doesn't talk much when he's nervous.!~

339095.description: Shinobu is a member of Fuurin high school's broadcasting club. She dreams of becoming an announcer

339096.description: Iko is a member of Fuurin high school's broadcasting club. She dreams of becoming a Vtuber.

339097.description: Arisu is a transfer student at Fuurin high school. He enters the broadcasting club because he's looking for the host of a radio show he used to listen to years ago, who he believes to be one of the club members.

339098.description: Rikka is the president of Fuurin high school's broadcasting club. She dreams of becoming a singer.

339099.description: Nene is a member of Fuurin high school's broadcasting club. She dreams of becoming a voice actress.

339318.description: One of the thirteen heroes who set out to slay the lord of Dark Beasts, [Clevatess](https://anilist.co/character/339319/Clen). She was bestowed the sacred treasure "Rock Swallow" by [King Haiden](https://anilist.co/character/359337/Haiden-Ou). She is the daughter of the hero [Margo](https://anilist.co/character/366646/Margo-Glenfall), who was once granted the title of "Sword Saint."

339319.description:
One of the Four Great Demon Beast Kings, he dwells upon the Moon Mountain of the South. He is also known as "Clevatess of the Moonlight." He possesses a massive, jet-black body resembling that of a wolf, with a single long horn protruding from his forehead and seven sharp tails.

Deeming that he could not walk the human world while retaining his colossal form, Clevatess assumed a human guise. It is modeled after the appearance of the pageboy who entrusted him [Luna](https://anilist.co/character/355949/Luna).

339477.description: A friend of [Yoi's](https://anilist.co/character/205878/Yoi-Takiguchi) since middle school. She is a fan of Boy's Love and handsome men, but until recently the closest thing in her life has been Yoi, until another "Prince" appears.

339478.description: [Kohaku's](https://anilist.co/character/233970/Kohaku-Ichimura) friend and classmate. He is a voice of reason compared to Kohaku and [Sentarou](https://anilist.co/character/379526/Sentarou-Akane).

name.native: アルティリア・レイ・オルティリーゼ

339905.description: One of the four princesses of the Integrated Empire. She was the youngest daughter of House O’ltriese, one of the three royal factions that led the Integrated Empire.

340828.description: A small hawk that can control lightning and attack with great speed.

340829.description: An S-rank monster that can control wind and run through the air.

name.native: アイザック・リスナー

340832.description: Issac Risner is a high-ranking knight in Etelldia, bearing the title of "Vice Captain of the Shireen Branch of the Knights of Guadia".

341153.description: He is a Hero who defeated the demon lord 500 years ago.

name.native: フィノッキオ・バルジーニ

341306.description: The person who serves as one of the advisors to the Sub-Leader of the Luciano Family and also is the Don of one of their affiliates, the Bargini Family. The entire of his life is comprised of extreme dual natures.

name.native: ブランドン・シュトーレン

341307.description:
__Job:__ God of destruction
__Cluster:__ Bloodblade Federation

Noel's grandfather. Once a famous and strongest Seeker in the Imperial Capital. He was known as "Over Death" and feared by the others. He was Noel's mentor and trained him to become a better Seeker.

341405.description: The original protagonist of the game. She is a commoner and the only daughter of a baker. Despite being a commoner, she is able to use all the different types of magic. She is very kind and prefers to avoid conflict. However, she is also very naive and idealistic, though no one dares challenge her thinking. She is quite charismatic and wildly popular, as many noble boys are constantly falling in love with her.

name.native: ウィリアムズ・アルバート

341406.description: Alicia's oldest brother and one of the love interests in the otome game. He is a member of Liz's group.

name.native: ウィリアムズ・ヘンリ

341408.description: The second of Alicia's older brothers and Alan's twin. He is a love interest in the otome game.

341409.description: Alicia's servant. He was born in the penal colony Roana, which was made for criminals. He was abused and treated poorly by the villagers there.

342213.description: She is a Shin'uchi rakugoka and the representative of the Ransaika School in the Rakugo Federation and she has a strong sense of justice because she states that nothing is more upsetting for her than seeing others given preferential treatment.

name.native: スフィア・デ・ベイル
ジェラルド・デア・クレイトス
エリザ・ノスフェラート

343062.description:
__Height:__ 169 cm

A professor at the academy who was one year below Workner and the others. Her skills place her in the top ranks of even the academy's fighting forces. As a pure insomniac, her self-deprecating jokes about the big dark circles under her eyes basically never fail.

name.native: エヴァ・レンフィード

343195.description:
__Job:__ Healer
__Cluster:__ The Blue Beyond

She is mild-mannered and also likable. She cares about Noel. Coupled with the Job of Healer, she's very popular with men.

She is in a romantic relationship with Lloyd.

name.native: リーシャ・メルセデス

343196.description:
__Job:__ Archer
__Cluster:__ Lightning Bite

She is an elf with distinctive ears. She cares about Noel in many ways.

344118.description: Yuuri is the spirit of the Yggdrasil.

344565.description: Beautiful and well mannered, she is the daughter of Kijuro Kurogane of the Kurogane family, which has produced many prime ministers since the Meiji era and whose influence extends to politics and business. She is a drummer.

344566.description: Lilisa was formerly from a commoner background. [Her mother](https://anilist.co/character/366741/Yuka-Suzunomiya) remarried Suzunomiya Tadashi, a real estate magnate in Kanto. She hides the fact that she was from a commoner background who liked rock and guitar only a month ago, and pretends to be a first-class lady, becoming the object of envy at school.

name.native: フェイリス・デア・クレイトス

344607.description: First Princess of the Kingdom of Kratos. Gerald's younger sister.

name.native: エリンツィア・ラーヴェ
リステアード・テオス・ラーヴェ

345062.description:
__Job:__ Mimic
__Cluster:__ Informant

The Imperial Capital's best informant breaker. "Mimic" allows Loki to change his appearance into anything he wants. He is good at disguising himself as other people.

name.native: ルルリ・アシュフォード

346657.description: Member of the Finn tribe, who serve as guides in the dungeon. Claims to be forever 7 years old.

name.native: ライト・アンダーウッド
ドラテナ・ベルベッリ

348830.description: Makoto, together with his older sister, Ai, is the human partner of Impmon in Digimon Tamers.

348837.description: Ai, together with her younger brother, Ai, is the human partner of Impmon in Digimon Tamers.

348838.description: Cyberdramon is an Ultimate Level Digimon, and is the partner of Ryo Akiyama. Feral in personality, his mission is to annihilate any Virus-type Digimon that have invaded the network. However, Cyberdramon is a lone soldier not affiliated with the "Virus Busters" group. His partner, Ryo, has been shown to use a unique whip generated from his D-Ark to restrain him if he gets out of control.

349224.description:
Zenos is a young healer who's been kicked out of the party of adventurers for being deemed useless. He now runs a secret clinic in the slums as he doesn't have a healer's license. Having never received formal training, he is unaware of the magnitude of his power.

(Source: Official Site)

349225.description: Lilly is a young elf girl who was saved from the brink of death by [Zenos](https://anilist.co/character/349224/Zenos). She decides to help Zenos and moves in with him at the clinic.

349226.description: Carmilla is a wraith who reigns over the undead, yet her true nature remains a mystery. She lives on the second floor of the clinic and enjoys all the chaos that befalls [Zenos](https://anilist.co/character/349224/Zenos).

name.native: 山田・レイナード＝緋月

351980.description:
The D-Reaper, also known as the "True Enemy", is a digital lifeform which appears as the central antagonist in Digimon Tamers. It is referred to as "Matador" (Por: Killer) in Brazilian Digimon Tamers materials.

Unlike most inhabitants of the Digital World in Tamers, it is not a Digimon; while Digimon descend from the virtual wildlife system created by the "Monster Makers", the D-Reaper was allegedly created in the late 1970s by the United States Department of Defense, as an antiviral program for the "Creeper" virus. It is possible it is only a descendant of this program, though, which was then known as the "Reaper", and other theories place its origin with the security program used by the United States Department of National Security in the 1980s for their "ECHELON" project. The D-Reaper's only purpose is to purge the Digital World once the number of lifeforms within it surpasses a certain number, and it pursues this goal with deadly efficiency.

351981.description: Zhuqiaomon is a Holy Bird Digimon. It is the "Digimon Sovereign" that guards the South, and commands the Deva Sandiramon, Indramon, and Pajiramon.

351982.description: Qinglongmon is a Holy Dragon Digimon. It is the "Digimon Sovereign" that guards the East, and commands the Deva Mihiramon, Antylamon, and Majiramon.

351985.description: IceDevimon is a Fallen Angel Digimon. In Digimon Tamers, IceDevimon is a serial killer who killed and absorbed many Digimon in order to become more powerful.

352988.description:
Zophia is the leader of the lizardmen: one of three major demi-human factions that control the slums.

(Source: Official Site)

352989.description:
Lynga is the leader of the werewolves: one of three major demi-human factions that control the slums.

(Source: Official Site)

352991.description:
Loewe is the leader of the ocs: one of three major demi-human factions that control the slums.

(Source: Official Site)

353208.description: A student in Shiki's class. Though usually appearing brash and tough, she has a motherly fetish that causes her to uncontrollably dote on people she sees as weak and is attracted to. Sazanami soon forces Kiriyama into a relationship under this pretense, much to his dismay. Her Blood Eclipse Release manifests as kickboxing gloves.

name.native: デステニー • ハートウォーミング

353789.description: Daughter of the mayor of the Last Village, and original heroine of A Tale of Perishing. She would frequently appear in unexpected places and cause conflict in the plot.

name.native: ヘルフレイムドラゴン

353934.description: Yachiyo is a hardworking hotelier robot working at the hotel “Gingarou”. Serving in an acting manager role, she upholds her duties with quiet determination even after humanity vanished from Earth. Ever hopeful, she awaits her owner’s return and dreams of the day when humanity comes back as guests. Ever so serious and dedicated, she approaches her work with unwavering determination.

353975.description: The head of the Ashia Family.

354435.description: Reina is a kind-hearted girl who helps organize the elves. She follows Liam around. She is usually a firm person, but when it comes to Liam, she has a childish side that gets excited

354436.description: Guy is the leader of the Gigaars.

354437.description: Bruno is the fourth son of the Earl of Hamilton. He is the only one in the Hamilton family who gets along well with Liam.

354438.description: Chris is a girl who is the leader of the werewolves. She is a tomboyish and headstrong girl who loves Liam like a dog. In battle, she is nimble and uses her speed to her advantage.

354439.description: Albrecht is the eldest son of the Earl of Hamilton. He is full of pride and ambition as the eldest son of a noble family and is toxic to his brothers.

354440.description:
__Height:__ 152cm (4’11)

Haunted by past relationships, bullying, hostility, family issues, and the weight of her own expectations, she often erects emotional walls—rejecting others before giving them a chance to truly understand her

354445.description: Kurohime is the protector and mother figure of Pina, the World Tree. She appears to be calm, but has a sharp side.

354446.description: Alice is one of the spirits of the World Tree. She is a beautiful girl with a quiet personality who is a recluse in the forbidden library as a librarian.

354450.description:
She seems to be one of the spirits of the World Tree, but everything is a mystery.

(Source: Official Site)

355053.description: Justice is a former member of the Nine Soldiers but is currently living in the District of Despair. [Luke](https://anilist.co/character/330954/Luke-Braveheart) used to admire them but his feelings changed after they left the Nine Soldiers.

355576.description:
[Yuu Natsume](https://anilist.co/character/246503/Natsume-Yuu)’s childhood friend and first crush; also grew up alongside [Shinji Makishima](https://anilist.co/character/355579/Makishima-Shinji) and [Himari Inuzuka](https://anilist.co/character/215388/Inuzuka-Himari).

Her older sister [Kureha](https://anilist.co/character/367538/Enomoto-Kureha), a fashion model, first introduced Rion (and indirectly Himari) to Yuu’s flower accessories back in middle school, leading Rion to reunite with him over a broken bracelet he’d made.

alternative: Subete no Mushi no Joou (全ての蟲の女王)

355713.description: Krishna is the Vice-Commander of the Royal Guard. She performs her responsibilities with a will as strong as iron, making sure the slums remain safe.

355949.description: A newborn infant entrusted to [Clevatess](https://anilist.co/character/339319/Clen), who had attacked Hiderat, the capital of the steel nation of Hiden, by a dying page. He is a pure-blooded Hidenean and holds the right to the Hiden throne.

356657.description: He is an explorer who defeats the magical beasts that lurk in the labyrinth, and was a member of the "Hero Party" that reached the unprecedented 94th floor of the labyrinth, where no one has yet reached the lowest 100th floor. For the sake of his companions, he converted from a "Swordsman" to an "Enchanter" and developed his own unique form of magic. He supported them in many ways, but one day he was suddenly ridiculed as a "Jack of all trades, master of none" and expelled from the party. Since then, he has made a fresh start, aiming to become the strongest explorer, someone who can be called a "Jack of all trades."

name.native: ソフィア・クローデル

356658.description: A new magician in the major clan "Night Sky Silver Rabbits," and [Selma's](https://anilist.co/character/356659/Selma-Clodel) younger sister. She was attacked by a magical beast while secretly infiltrating a labyrinth without the clan's knowledge, but was saved by [Orhun](https://anilist.co/character/356657/Orhun-Dura). She has a gentle personality, but her abilities are genuine, and she is a member of the promising new party "Squad 10." She serves as a rearguard attacker.

356659.description: She is the leader of the S-rank party that reigns supreme within the major clan, "Night Sky Silver Rabbits," and is the continent's greatest "Enchanter." She has had a high opinion of [Orhun](https://anilist.co/character/356657/Orhun-Dura) since his days in the "Hero Party," even entrusting him with accompanying her on "Training Expeditions," a training ground for new recruits. She dotes on her younger sister, [Sophia](https://anilist.co/character/356658/Sophia-Clodel), with all her heart.

356983.description: Tamaki is a 2nd year student at a sister school to Oushin Girls' Academy. She's well known as a skilled guitarist in her local area and repeatedly refuses offers to join bands. She is also [Otoha's](https://anilist.co/character/344565/Otoha-Kurogane) childhood friend.

356984.description: Tina is a 2nd year student at Oushin Girls' Academy. She's referred to as Oushin's Prince due to her tall and androgynous appearance. In actuality, she has low self confidence and acts the way other people want her to be, and she wants to change that about herself.

name.native: アリッサ・マルシアス

358859.description: A court magician serving the Kingdom of Galdana. Although he graduated from magic academy at the top of his class, he was forced to focus on unfamiliar auxiliary magic in order to protect the crown prince. However, the prince treated him as incompetent, and one day he was banished from court.

name.native: ジュリアス ・フォン・パリスタン

359260.description: The first prince of the Kingdom of Pallistan. Unlike his brother, Julius stands calm, charming, and interested in strange things. He does not wish to be a mere figurehead for the masses and desires to understand his people of the kingdom he will eventually lead. He's the first to notice [Scarlett](https://anilist.co/character/255701/El-Vandimion-Scarlett)'s hidden personality and would often tease and observe her to witness this core of her being rise to the surface. In fact, he enjoys watching her beat up those who offend her due to an underlying desire to see the petty and obtuse brought to ruin. He is a free-spirited sort who is not fond of empty flattery from the aristocracy.

name.native: シグルド・フォーグレイブ
レオナルド・エル・ヴァンディミオン

359263.description: [Scarlett](https://anilist.co/character/255701/El-Vandimion-Scarlett)'s older brother as well as [Julius](https://anilist.co/character/359260/Von-Pallistan-Julius)' attendant and best friend. He worries about his sister's well-being and psychological state, often wishing she would act (and live) like a normal woman at her age, and would often have stomach pains and shriek towards the heavens whenever he hears of his sister's vigilante antics. He's also a founder of the Crown Investigatory Office, albeit reluctantly, since he only wants to keep a close eye on his sister.

name.native: カイル・フォン・パリスタン
テレネッツァ・ホプキンス

359325.description:
The eldest daughter of the Tanuki Aliens, this name is a provisional term adapted to the Earth language. Although she disguises herself in a human-like form, her true appearance closely resembles a tanuki, with tail stripes similar to those of a raccoon. She is a curious and energetic girl. She admires Yachiyo, who scolded her, and begins working at the hotel. 

She excels in science and math subjects, and according to herself, she secretly entered the Imperial Capital Pompoko University’s Department of Space Engineering through a backdoor admission and graduated at the top of her class. Influenced by occult magazines left behind by humans, she has a strong love for the occult.

359327.description:
An energetic robot that seeks to monitor and protect the Earth's environment. It found its way to the Gingarou Hotel after detecting a drastic change in the environment of the surrounding area.

Originally one of many Environment Checker Robots left stationed across the Earth when the remnants of humanity fled the planet a century ago, it has gradually lost contact with all of the other Environment Checkers and now believes itself to be the last surviving robot of its kind. It was designed to continue monitoring the planet's environment to determine whether it was suitable for human habitation, regularly transmitting reports out into space.

359337.description: The King of Haiden, the Land of Steel. The only one capable of forging Regalia in the Royal Forge.

359345.description:
A slave woman raised among the bandit clan known as "The Crow." 

~!She nearly loses her life at the hands of a troll kept by [Broco](https://anilist.co/character/366645/Broco), but is subsequently revived by [Clen](https://anilist.co/character/339319/Clen). She becomes [Luna's](https://anilist.co/character/355949/Luna) wet nurse and accompanies him on the journey.!~

359812.description: Golnova is the leader of the hero party “Dragon Fang of Flame”.

359813.description: Bandana is a member of the hero party “Dragon Fang of Fire”.

359814.description: Marlefiss is a member of the hero party “Dragon Fang of Fire”.

360820.description: Leader of a trio of delinquents.

361640.description:
[Ögedei’s](https://anilist.co/character/399632/gedei) sixth wife.

She harbors a deep hatred for the Mongol Empire and sees her husband as an enemy.

After meeting [Sitara](https://anilist.co/character/328089/Sitara), she resolves to stand against the empire alongside her.

name.native: ヴァン・ネイ・フェルティオ

363290.description: [Asa's](https://anilist.co/character/189957/Asa-Takumi) classmate and best friend. ~!Asa eventually learns that Emiri is a lesbian and that Emiri is dating [a girl](https://anilist.co/character/393115) who attends the same preparatory classes.!~

363292.description: [Makio's](https://anilist.co/character/171138/Koudai-Makio) friend from her days at school.

363425.description: The leader of "Lasting Period" and a genius auxiliary magician. After [Alec](https://anilist.co/character/358859/Alec-Huguette) was banished from the royal court of the Kingdom of Galdana, she invites him to become an adventurer. During her time at the magic academy, she was the second most talented magician after Alec, and her auxiliary magic has saved her comrades from many difficult situations.

364408.description: Akuri is a mysterious little girl born from an egg Kurt received as a reward for a job.

364409.description:
Hildegard is Kurt's childhood friend. She is from the demon tribe. 

The daughter of a demon peddler who came to Kurt's home village.

name.native: クラシア・アンネローゼ

365508.description: A member of “Lasting Period” and a formidable talent who graduated third in her class from the Magic Academy. Within the party, she specializes in healing magic while also possessing the versatility to handle offensive spells. She is a cool person who hides a kind side.

366645.description: A man who claims to be the current leader of the bandit group “The Ravens.” He deals in counterfeit magic swords and collects treasures. He commands trolls, the beasts of the West.

366647.description:
__Regalia:__ Black Dragon

An antagonistic general who seeks to obtain arcanacites from the remains of Haiden for his kingdom Boelate.

name.native: ナイエ・シフォンリッツ

366648.description: A High Wizard of the Boelate Army. She possesses the magical ability to manipulate magnetism, allowing her to attract or repel any object made of iron.

366649.description:
__Regalia:__ Ice Flower

A division commander in the army of Eslin, one of the two great nations that divide the Dawn Plains.

366650.description: The Highest Wizard of the Boelate Army. Possessing the power to control all manner of insects, he is reputed to be the Boelate Army's strongest—and most wicked—mage.

366922.description: She  is a member of Illegal Fairy Regulatory Agency Dorothea, Medical Technology Department.

367220.description: A member of "Lasting Period" and ranked fourth at the Magic Academy. A self-proclaimed genius with a reckless drive, he is the most physically fit member of the party. He's [Alec's](https://anilist.co/character/358859/Alec-Huguette) troublemaking buddy and [Clasia's](https://anilist.co/character/365508/Clasia-Annerose) sparring partner.

368143.description: An android in the future who pressures Akira into marriage. She looks exactly like Towasa. She has a wide range of weapons and high combat power that allows her to overwhelm even large numbers of opponents. She has a deep connection with Towasa, but keeps quiet about anything related to her, calling it "taboo."

368144.description: She is the only daughter of the Oumaki family, who adopted Akira. She is a genius scientist developing cutting-edge AI technology, and has attracted attention from around the world. However, because she creates such revolutionary technology, she has been subjected to extreme criticism and interference with her research from some people. She has a crush on Akira, and has been worrying about him lately.

368145.description: A high school boy with excellent grades and good looks. After losing his parents at a young age, he was raised by his father's friend's family. He has a crush on his childhood friend and housemate, Towasa. He is seriously injured in an incident and falls unconscious. After being put into cold sleep, he wakes up in a future world.

368316.description: A former "Noble Maiden" at Sakuragokoro Girls' Academy.

368608.description: A demon who works under the Demon Lord. He is in love with Cecilia and gets flustered when he is around her.

368609.description: A priestess who is part of the Hero's party. She is kind and beautiful, but scolds Youki when his actions get too much. While shocked by Youki's affection for her, Cecilia decided to build up a relationship first. Though the hero and other boys hit on her, Cecilia stays true to Youki.

371382.description: A dark beast serving the dark beast lord Zavthier.

371795.description: He belongs to the Konjakutei School and is the school's representative in the Rakugo Federation.

371796.description: Shomei Tsubakiya is a Shin'uchi rakugoka, the vice-chairman and the representative of the Tsubakiya School in the Rakugo Federation.

371801.description: Zensho Arakawa is a Shin'uchi rank in the Arakawa School and member of Arakawa Arch Four.

372999.description:
__Height:__ 144 cm

A demon girl born into the demon race who wishes to coexist with humans. Inheriting the ideas of her father, the Demon King, she begins to work towards realizing her ideals after meeting [Kagami](https://anilist.co/character/373000/Koji-Kagami), who does not hate demons.

373000.description:
__Height:__ 173 cm

A former weak villager who has reached the "highest level" that no one has ever reached before. Due to a past incident, he believes that demons and humans are the same, and currently spends his days earnestly saving money for a certain purpose.

373001.description: The crown prince of the Kingdom of Galdana. He believes in aristocratic supremacy and dislikes the commoner [Alec](https://anilist.co/character/358859/Alec-Huguette). Unable to recognize Alec's abilities, he fires him.

373003.description: The person who taught magic to young [Alec](https://anilist.co/character/358859/Alec-Huguette). He was originally the court magician of the Kingdom of Galdana, but was banished by the king...

373702.description: Patriarch of the Mikadono household, Mr. Mikadono raised his three daughters under a strict regimen to bring out the best of their abilities. Subaru Ayase is an old friend of his, and because he was indebted to her in the past, he takes in her son Yuu after her passing.

373703.description: An immensely successful actress, Subaru Ayase was lauded as immensely talented in any field she tried her hand at. Unfortunately, her prestige came at a price, as she was unable to spend time with her son Yuu due to her work. On her deathbed, she asked that Yuu create a happy family where she could not.

373958.description: A third year student at Iwayama High, Hayato Tatsumi is known as a genius karateka and Niko Mikadono's senpai.

373959.description: Sakura Yaotome is a first-year high schooler and Miwa Mikadono's self-proclaimed rival in shogi. Unlike other shogi players, who became prodigies, Sakura was a novice who only became skilled at the game through hard work and perseverance.

374074.description: Akira and Yugure meet this girl during their journey. She is searching for a picture book that her parents once drew but that has been banned in the future world. Her dream is to become a picture book author like her parents.

374275.description: An android with the same face as Yugure, she is one of the commanders of the OWEL special forces. She has an honest and inflexible personality. She specializes in attack and uses an extendable sword as her weapon. She is pursuing Yugure for a mission. However, it seems she has other reasons for pursuing Yugure besides the mission...

374276.description: She has the same face as Yugure and is one of the commanders of the OWEL special forces. She is an android specialized in search and support. She works alongside Yoiyami, who is relentlessly pursuing Yugure in an attempt to capture her, but she doesn't seem to be pursuing Yugure very seriously. She has a warm and gentle demeanor and is sensitive to smells.

374277.description: A large man who runs a wholesale store. He is a kind-hearted person. He travels from place to place for work and appears wherever Akira and his friends go.

374278.description: A historian with an adult aura. A former OWEL employee. He once saw Towasa's name in documents at OWEL. A feminist who doesn't wear an "Elsie" name.

374762.description: He is the hero of the Hero’s Party. He's cheerful and kind-hearted but often fails to read the atmosphere, which can unintentionally cause trouble. He naturally attracts the attention of women, resulting in a large female following, and is also prone to frequent “lucky perverted” situations.

374763.description: The mage of the Hero’s Party, she has a sharp personality and brusque manner, but her words and actions are usually guided by consideration for others, revealing her caring nature. She has long harbored feelings for her childhood friend Yuga, though he has yet to notice them.

name.native: ローザリア・レイ・マドレーヌ

375050.description: Rosalia is Scarlet's friend from the Royal Noble Academy.

375232.description: Advisor to the broadcasting club who yearns to be called "Lemon-chan." She tries not to rock the boat or stand out but still helps the club.

375279.description:
A female administrator at OWEL. She is related to Ajisai as "Sierra," Elsie's partner. For certain reasons, she prioritizes work over Ajisai, which causes tension between them.
She has also not kept her promise to help out at the hot spring inn.

375280.description: She is a potential heir to the Lontano family, a mafia that controls the town of Aomori. She is competitive and loyal. She is fighting for the succession with her younger brother, Kalkram. She shows extreme disgust when Kalcrom occasionally uses the words "true love." She is desperately searching for a partner for "Elsie" in order to fulfill the conditions to become the next boss. She trusts her beloved horse, Kenshin.

375281.description: A girl who discovers Akira waking up in the future world. She is curious and friendly. She lives in Hakodate Village. Her father is the village chief, Weir, and her mother is Taberina. She is not intimidated by Akira, who is worshipped as a god, and is interested in what happened to him and the past. Vogt, who lives with Weir and Taberina, is Idhi's Elpa (the name given to someone who is not her biological father in the Elsie system).

375282.description: She is the proprietress of the hot spring resort, Kizunoyu. She and Haniyama are "Elsie's" partner, "Sierra." She values ​​the time she spends with Haniyama and the hot springs above all else. She hopes to run the inn together with Haniyama.

375283.description: An OWEL employee ordered to move to Omiya. He is large and has a loud voice. His family consists of Casta, a "Sierra," and her twin children, Louv and Caero. He shows more consideration for Casta than necessary, but...

375284.description: He is a potential heir to the Lontano family, a mafia that controls the town of Aomori. He has a cheesy personality. He is actually brother to Fides, his rival in the fight for the throne. As a condition for becoming the next boss of the Lontano family, he must "leave behind a successor," so he is searching for a partner. He believes that temporary love is meaningless, and is searching for "true love" for himself.

375285.description: A slender woman who excels at sewing and painting. She is a "Sierra" of Vale and the mother of twins. Her voice is so quiet that it is difficult to hear even at close range. She is a good "Sierra" and a good mother who cares for others.

375632.description: Manager who handles all five members of F/ACE single-handedly from a small and understaffed office. He is always exhausted from the workload.

375633.description: The president of the company which manages F/ACE and their producer. She treats them harshly in order to make the group into a hit.

375787.description: He is the general administrator of the North H4-27 district of OWEL. He manages Hakodate Village and the surrounding area. He instills unreasonable fear in the low-ranking residents. He is always on the lookout for opportunities to advance in his career. He is proud of his large physique and superhuman strength.

375788.description: She is the head librarian of the library managed by OWEL in Sendai. She loves books, devotes herself to them, and is faithful to her job. She loves all the books in the library with all her heart. It seems that she has her own private space in the closed stacks room at the back of the library.

375789.description: He is an administrator who oversees the people known as "Letogia," who have given up their human rights in society under OWEL's control for various reasons. He is a germaphobe and cannot forgive those who do not follow OWEL's laws. He is the type of person who will not hesitate to hurt others in order to achieve his goals. In the past, he aspired to be a rock singer. He is Canis's second cousin.

375790.description: He is the boss of the Lontano family, a mafia that controls the town of Aomori. He is also the biological father of Kalkram and Fides. He is strict and brutal, and values ​​unity and trust above all else. He has many children, including Elsie, and pits them against each other to fight for the succession.

377659.description: A support magician for the S-rank party "Rechroma." He confuses enemies with skillful support magic and tactics.

name.native: ローザ・アルハティア

377660.description: A former faculty member of the Magic Academy and homeroom teacher for “Lasting Period.” While exasperated by their reckless dungeon raids, she watched over their growth.

name.native: レヴィエル・スタンツ

377661.description: The master of the adventurers' guild to which “Lasting Period” belongs. Rumor has it that during his active adventuring days, he was a formidable mage.

name.native: パナメラ・カレラ・カイエン
アルテ・オン・フェルディナット

378092.description:
__Height:__ 165cm

A suspicious boy who loves tinkering with machines and inventing things. He swore to create an age of electricity with his admired [older brother](https://anilist.co/character/391469/), and painted his dreams in the "20th Century Electric Catalog."

But when his brother and the catalog vanished, he gave up on his dream, and his timid and cowardly personality has become even more pronounced.

378093.description:
__Height:__ 162cm

The second daughter of the long-established Hyakukawa Sake Brewery in Fushimi, Kyoto. She's clumsy and lacks self-confidence, but she's a sweet girl who's good at trusting others.

She secretly dreams of becoming a master brewer, like [her late mother](https://anilist.co/character/401115/).

name.native: エンヴィ・メル・シャンパーニュ

378574.description: Envi is Scarlet's friend and rival from the Royal Noble Academy. She is a count's daughter and often teased by Rosalia.

name.native: ヴァンディミオン公爵
ゴドウィン・ベネ・カーマイン
アルフレイム・レア・ヴァンキッシュ

378594.description: Aflame is the first prince of the Vankish Empire.

name.native: ディオス・ウエストウッド

378971.description: A mysterious girl from the Moon. Looking for fun, she decided to become a livestreamer in Tsukuyomi. She's energetic, outrageous and loves [Iroha](https://anilist.co/character/378972/Sakayori-Iroha).

378972.description: A 17-year-old high school girl. A model student who excelles in both academics and sports. She works hard to pay her living expenses and tutition fees. She's a fan of [Yachiyo](https://anilist.co/character/378973/Runami-Yachiyo), Tsukuyomi's top livestreamer. She's also a talented musician, but doesn't compose anymore.

378973.description: The top livestreamer of the virtual world "Tsukuyomi." A mysterious 8,000-year-old (allegedly) AI who can sing, dance, and even create clones.

379525.description: One of Yoi's friends from school. She has a cheerful personality.

380691.description: A talented oil painter and the daughter of kimono makers from Yokohama, Japan. Her mother has given her six months to become the top student at Saint Thomas Art Academy, or else face abandoning her artistic ambitions permanently.

380692.description: A mysterious student who consistently ranks first in assignments. Despite his scruffy nature and eccentricities, he is actually the younger son of a duke.

380694.description: Another student from Japan, a talented sculptor who befriends and lives across the street from Lili and Dorothy during their time in London.

380696.description: Lili's first English friend, housemate, and fellow painting student, a friendly girl who hails from the Cotswolds.

name.native: ピーター・アンソニー

380697.description: Another of Kit's friends, an artist from Delhi, India.

name.native: ジョフリー・オブライエン

380699.description: One of Kit's friends, the son of an old, lower aristocratic family. He is in the sculpting department.

name.native: キャサリン・アスター
リチャード・チャーチ

380702.description: Kit's older brother, who urges him to accept his responsibilities.

name.native: チャールズ・ブラント

380703.description: The academy's exacting oil painting teacher. He is a fan of William Shakespeare and regularly quotes the playwright.

380761.description:
Son of Emperor [Genghis Khan](https://anilist.co/character/403366/) and the fourth prince of the Mongol Empire.
Possessing the greatest share of the empire's military strength, he uses this power to invade other nations.

381120.description: A Dullahan and former subordinate of Youki. He speaks bluntly but is a reliable ally who deeply respects Youki as his captain. He is always seen wearing his armor.

381121.description: A harpy and former subordinate of Youki, she is a quiet girl who carries an enigmatic presence. Concerned for Youki’s well-being, she comes to human society alongside Duke and Seek.

381122.description: A swordsman of the Hero’s Party and the current captain of the knight order, he's often perceived as cool and reserved due to his quiet nature. He has a reason for rarely speaking, and typically communicates through writing.

381123.description: A pixie and former subordinate of Youki, she's cheerful and innocent, with a childlike charm. She is knowledgeable about plants and flowers and is well-versed in herbal medicine.

381203.description: Utage's younger sister and Yamato's twin. She doesn't understand Utage's obsession with idols, since she prefers to be admired rather than admire others. She becomes a fan of Keito.

381221.description: A fluffy sea slug who serves as Yachiyo's companion and guides the girls through Tsukuyomi. For some reason, it views Kaguya and the Inudoge as enemies.

name.native: キャロライン・イングロット

381806.description: A member of the promising newcomer party "Squad 10" belonging to "The Silver Rabbit of the Night Sky," she aims to become an evasive "Defender." For some reason, she has a tendency to charge headfirst into magical beasts, causing constant concern for those around her.

name.native: ルーナ・フロックハート

381810.description: A member of the "Hero Party" Golden Dawn, she holds the position of Healer. She values ​​[Orhun's](https://anilist.co/character/356657/Orhun-Dura) abilities more than anyone else, and went to personally ask him to return to their party. Orhun also has a deep trust in her.

381920.description: A member of the S-rank party "First Unit" belonging to the Night Sky Silver Rabbits, she is a Magician. She is extremely fast at constructing spells and can cast special-grade magic spells one after another. Contrary to her young appearance, she is the oldest member of the party and is caring and considerate.

name.native: ルクレーシャ・オーティス

381921.description: A member of the S-rank party "First Unit" belonging to the Night Sky Silver Rabbits, she is a Healer. She can track a caster's location by following traces of magical energy. She is the mood maker of the party.

name.native: シオン・ナスタチウム

381923.description: A mysterious girl who belongs to the criminal organization "Amunzers," which attacks advanced explorers without question.

name.native: ヴォガン・フォルネウス

384856.description: Scion of the House of Forneus.

385342.description:
Momotose Ao is a famous VTuber and side character in Tune In to the Midnight Heart. As part of the VTuber group Blue Box, she has over 3 million subscribers and does streaming as well as live shows.

(Source: Tune in to the Midnight Heart Wiki)

385542.description: Leader of Black Onyx. He is a talented and charismatic player, as well as a self-described "egotistical character". He enjoys flashy performances and gives it his all when it comes to entertaining the audience.

385544.description: A member of Black Onyx and Rai's younger brother. He enjoyes wearing cute clothes on his avatar. He's usually quite lazy, but when motivated, he provides good fanservice.

386821.description: A mermaid known for her straightforward manner of speaking, she becomes separated from her friend Shike after being caught in a storm while swimming together at sea.

386824.description: A mermaid with a gentle, easygoing demeanor, she's associated with rumors surrounding a series of thefts in a port town. She is friends with Misaki.

387796.description: A member of the S-rank party "Rechroma." An excellent swordsman who has been training since childhood.

388266.description: A first-year student acquainted with both [Asa](https://anilist.co/character/189957) and [Emiri](https://anilist.co/character/363290), who aspires to be a doctor. ~!She discovers a scandal involving the medical school she was applying to, and reacts angrily.!~

388635.description: Aoteru is a young man from Ehime prefecture, with a deep knowledge of the previous Japanese era and a habit of quibbling. He intends to fulfill his promise to his wife [Saki](https://anilist.co/character/388636/Saki-Higashimachi) to unite Japan.

388636.description: Saki is [Aoteru's](https://anilist.co/character/388635/Aoteru-Misumi) wife and a strong willed woman who hates dishonesty.

390524.description: Yoi's father. He runs a ramen shop.

390525.description: A part-time employee at Yoi's family's ramen shop. He goes to an all boys' high school after being treated as a "prince" by the girls at his middle school. He likes soccer, curry, and hanging out with his friends. He also has feelings for Yoi.

391325.description: A young girl who was rescued by Ephtal while being subjected to unjust treatment as a slave, and who ends up joining him on his journey. She is reserved but strong-willed, and refers to Ephtal—who saved her—as “Lord Ephtal,” placing deep trust in him. She possesses a talent for magic that even he acknowledges, but due to her background and circumstances, she harbors a secret she cannot reveal. She quietly matures as she watches Ephtal’s back.

391326.description:
This is the current Ephtal, who has been reincarnated twice. He has set his sights on the path of magic and is aiming to enroll in a magic academy.

He retains the memories and magical prowess from his previous life 400 years ago as the Sage and Thunder God Emperor Ephtal; his power is so extraordinary that it would be called a “miracle” by modern standards. However, just as in his past life, he lacks a natural aptitude for magic. Yet he possesses a passion more single-minded than anyone else’s, striving to overcome this handicap through hard work and determination.

While kind to others, he detests dishonesty and is a man with a passionate heart, deeply committed to duty and compassion.

391327.description:
After the Demon King was defeated, she was found by Ephtal in the Demon King’s castle—which was on the verge of collapse—and raised by him from infancy. As her background suggests, she is a descendant of the Demon King’s clan. She possesses exceptional aptitude for water and wind magic, and is both hardworking and highly ambitious. As his top disciple, she deeply admires Ephtal and often takes reckless actions out of concern for his safety.

As a faculty member at the Magic Academy, she instructs her students rigorously, yet she understands her master’s ideals and resolve better than anyone else and continues to support him on his path as a mage.

391466.description:
__Height:__ 177cm

He is the heir to the "Mitsuzoe Shoten" company, which made its fortune with steam engines, and a highly skilled engineer. For some reason, he is obsessed with the "20th Century Electrical Catalog."

He is using every means possible to find the catalog, including becoming engaged to [Inako](https://anilist.co/character/378093/).

391467.description:
__Height:__ 190cm

A former soldier and [Noriko](https://anilist.co/character/391468/)'s fiancé. He's sturdy, strong, and has the power of a steam locomotive, earning him the nickname "Land Steam Locomotive."

He's [Seiroku](https://anilist.co/character/391469/)'s classmate and knows about the "20th Century Electric Catalog."

391468.description:
__Height:__ 167cm

[Inako](https://anilist.co/character/378093/)'s older sister and [Kengo](https://anilist.co/character/391467/)'s fiancée. She is a capable and reliable person, skilled in martial arts. She can be scary when angry, but she watches over Inako's growth. She was secretly possessing the "Twentieth Century Electric Catalog."

391469.description:
__Height:__ 175cm

[Kihachi](https://anilist.co/character/378092)'s older brother. He was a charismatic figure who captivated those around him with his passion for inventing electricity. Recognizing Kihachi's ingenuity, he vowed to help him realize his dream.

He went to war with the "20th Century Electrical Catalog" and never returned.

391477.description: A martial artist who owns a club and a bar. She once aimed to defeat the Demon King, but after being saved by the demons, she distanced herself from conflict. She has known [Kagami](https://anilist.co/character/373000/Koji-Kagami) for a long time, and they have built a cooperative relationship.

391478.description: After his parents were killed by monsters, he aspires to become a hero and take on the mission of defeating the Demon King. However, after meeting a mirror, he begins to notice distortions in the world.

391479.description: A young monk traveling for training. Raised in an orphanage in the royal capital, she seeks to repay the kindness of those who supported her by becoming a priest and helping others. She is hardworking and polite, but can't help but make comments when something mysterious happens.

391480.description: The third princess of the Kingdom of Hexaldria, formerly known as Japan. Born as a sage, she underwent rigorous training from an early age to defeat the Demon King. She was raised to believe that demons were evil, but she also possesses the flexibility to believe in the truth she sees with her own eyes.

391481.description: A magician from the royal capital. He is usually carefree, but has the talent to act calmly and swiftly in emergencies. After a certain incident, he harbors a deep hatred for demons.

391997.description:
Born in August of the 39th year of the Yamato era, hailing from the capital of Wakayama. Held the positions of Assistant Armory Officer for the Frontier General's Unit and later Right Lieutenant General. 

Raised under his mother's rigorous "gifted education," he calls her "Mama" and is fiercely devoted to her—to the point of writing her biography. He is the heir to the main branch of the Asama family, a prestigious clan instrumental in the founding of Yamato. Driven by strong ambition and a desire for validation, he aims to end the Three Kingdoms era through his own efforts and become a figure respected by the entire nation.

While skilled in martial arts, he tends to look down on others and seeks to assert his superiority. When meeting new people or in formal settings, he abandons the Kansai-inflected Yamato dialect in favor of the "Eastern language" (standard Japanese) to project an image of superior intellect.

391998.description: The strategist of Yamato's Borderland General Corps. He is a master tactician who always stays one step ahead.

392740.description:
Utage's homeroom teacher. She's a beautiful, cheerful new teacher and is very popular among students. She's a fan of F/ACE and Natsuki.

~!She dated Natsuki in the past.!~

392912.description: The “Sword Saint,” a legendary swordsman of unmatched skill. He seems to have a history with [Olivia](https://anilist.co/character/387796/Olivia)...?

392913.description: A member of the Dark Guild who stands in the way of "Lasting Period." He transforms his own blood into magical power launching attacks with limitless versatility.

393289.description: Yukiya's little sister, just started middle school.

393290.description: Third-year university student, part-timer at Cafe Kanade.

393291.description: Miku's uncle, owner of Cafe Kanade.

393293.description: Miku's best friend from middle school, family runs a Japanese sweets shop.

394361.description: A girl from the gardening club. quiet but has a small-animal-like charm, loved by people of all ages and genders.

394362.description: The only daughter of the Tsukinose shrine, a mysterious and beautiful girl. She likes Hayato but struggles with overly formal email messages due to being too conscious of him.

394596.description:
A young boy captured by the Mongol Empire.
Shrewd by nature, he curries favor with Tolui in hopes of survival and rising in status.

394597.description:
[Fatima](https://anilist.co/character/394598/)'s son and a brilliant young boy in his own right.
He teaches young [Sitara](https://anilist.co/character/328089/) the importance of learning, and sets out on a journey to encounter all kinds of wisdom and to search for the truth.

394598.description:
[Muhammad](https://anilist.co/character/394597/)’s mother and kind-hearted lady of the house.
She takes in the utterly alone Sitara and cherishes her as if she were her own child.

394747.description: [Manatsu Atagawa's](https://anilist.co/character/396044/Manatsu-Atagawa) younger sister. She went to middle school with [Yuki Azumi](https://anilist.co/character/394746/Yuki-Azumi).

394841.description: The Captain of the Eagle Eyes who keeps the morals of the Inner Court in check. Has blue eyes like his mother who was a slave from a foreign country. The half-brother of [Gyoumei](https://anilist.co/character/297201/Ei-Gyoumei). Reticent and cold-hearted in nature.

394843.description: She is the lady-in-waiting of [Keigetsu](https://anilist.co/character/297196/Shu-Keigetsu). She has red hair inherited from her mother, who was a dancer from the Western Lands.

394845.description: The maiden of the Kin clan. She possesses dazzling beauty and takes great pride in her artistic accomplishments.

394847.description: Head lady-in-waiting to [Reirin](https://anilist.co/character/297195/Kou-Reirin). She also carries the blood of the Gen family and possesses a cool, aloof demeanor.

394849.description: The maiden of the Gen family. She possesses a reticent and mysterious air.

394851.description: A maiden of the Ran clan. She is petite and unassuming, with an air reminiscent of a small animal.

395446.description: She is the hostess of a Rakugo Café.

396084.description:
__Master:__ [Oshirasama no Aruji no Mago](https://anilist.co/character/403916/) (current), [Oshirasama no Aruji](https://anilist.co/character/403338/) (former)

A god-like pair of tsugai consisting of a young woman and a stallion.

They are known for their friendly nature, preferring to live peacefully alongside humans. Their human side can communicate with both tsugai and humans and is attentive to children. They are old acquaintances of [Hidari](https://anilist.co/character/287182/) and [Migi](https://anilist.co/character/324638/).

Oshira has been passed down through generations of a family thanks to a blood ritual. This allows her to live freely without worrying about disappearing.

398520.description:
__Height:__ 170cm

[Inako](https://anilist.co/character/378093/) and [Kate](https://anilist.co/character/398522/)'s classmate. Always calm and sharp-witted. Various gadgets come out of her bag.

398522.description:
__Height:__ 151cm

[Inako](https://anilist.co/character/378093/) and [Suzu](https://anilist.co/character/398520/)'s classmate. She's always cheerful and often spends time with Suzu.

She has [a British father](https://anilist.co/character/406142/) and a Japanese mother.

398525.description: Iria is the mother of Ephtal.

398526.description:
The second son of the Duke of Alcott and Ephtal's older half-brother. 

He looks out for Iria and Ephtal—who are treated poorly due to their lack of aptitude—supporting them by providing living expenses and teaching them academics and swordsmanship. Though he is a pleasant and gentle young man, he is also highly capable, having graduated at the top of his class from the military academy; he currently serves in the military as a magic swordsman. 

He is a kind-hearted older brother who remains grounded in reality while deeply concerned for his younger brother's future.

399632.description:
The third son of [Genghis Khan](https://anilist.co/character/403366/), emperor of the Mongol Empire.

Thoughtful and observant, he is known for his calm and generous nature.

With a broad and far-sighted perspective, he strives for the prosperity of the empire.

400778.description: She holds the rank of "Noble Consort", a status second only to the empress. A consort from the Shu clan, she serves as [Keigetsu](https://anilist.co/character/297196/Shu-Keigetsu) guardian. She is dignified and serene, gentle and compassionate.

401156.description: The leader of the prostitutes who works for the Ravens.

401157.description: One of Four Lords of the Dark Beasts, reigning over the frozen northern Dragon’s Snowfield.

401159.description: The princess of Haiden and Luna's birth mother

name.native: リリーヤ・イヴァノヴァ・タネーチカ

403059.description: She is a political officer who just graduated from the academy. Due to the image strategy of the Federation, she was assigned to the liaison officer of Commonwealth Expeditionary Mage Force.

alternative: ヴィルジニオ・カランドロ

403060.description: Calandro was one of the rare Ildoan military officers who had served in small-scale conflicts in the colonies. He belongs to the Center Faction in the Royal Ildoan Army administration.

403287.description: The bass vocalist of celestial. They are a wild, unpredictable character, but possess overwhelming vocal technique.

403707.description: [Tolui's](https://anilist.co/character/380761/Tolui) wife. She believes that "the world is wider than the steppe," and is searching for "Elements," a text containing knowledge from the West. She also possesses great insight, recognizing the danger that comes with imbalances in military strength and authority.

403710.description: [Ögedei's](https://anilist.co/character/399632/gedei) first wife and Empress (the Great Khatun). Always calm, composed, and dignified, she is a woman of unfathomable depth. Believing that "in politics, it is crucial to pull strings beneath the surface," she secretly devises strategies, deeply concerned about the empire's future and the imbalance of power.

404972.description:
__Height:__ 90 cm
__Race:__ Harvin

Charlotta is a Harvin and the beloved captain of the Lumiel Order of Holy Knights. Her sword, a weapon that cleaves evil in twain, is equal to her in both size and power. Generous when it comes to the faults of others, she is exceedingly hard on herself, believing fate cut her from literally too short a cloth.

406173.description: General who undertook the role of the Commander of Southern Continent Expeditionary Corps, which later was upgraded to Army Group Southern Continent.

409109.description: An outstanding military officer and [Reirin's](https://anilist.co/character/297195) eldest brother. According to [Keigetsu](https://anilist.co/character/297196), he’s the more ‘muscle-brained’ one, and a complete fool for his little sister.

409110.description: An outstanding military officer and [Reirin's](https://anilist.co/character/297195) second eldest brother. According to [Keigetsu](https://anilist.co/character/297196), he’s the "stupidly devoted" type when it comes to his younger sister.

409481.description: She holds the rank of "Worthy Consort", the lowest of the Four Consorts. She is a consort of the Gen clan and serves as the guardian of [Kasui](https://anilist.co/character/394849/Gen-Kasui). She is a woman of few words, and it is often difficult to tell what she is thinking.

409482.description: She holds the rank of "Pure Consort", the second-highest of the four consort ranks. A consort of the Kin clan, she is Seika’s aunt and guardian. She is a beautiful woman who possesses both a voluptuous figure and an arrogant demeanor.

409483.description: She holds the rank of "Virtuous Consort", the third-highest among the Four Consorts. A consort from the Ran clan, she serves as the guardian of [Houshun](https://anilist.co/character/394851/Ran-Houshun). Petite and lovely, she views herself as the "eternal little sister" figure of the inner palace.
